acid-base-titration.title: Titireynta Aashitada iyo Xaaladda Saldhiga
acid-base-titration.description: Aashitada hidroklorikada oo la yaqaan xooggeeda ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu titireeyo Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد oo aanay xooggiisu la garanayn, kuwaas oo lagu ogaanayo dhamaadka falcelinta adoo isticmaalaya phenolphthalein, si loo baranno hawlgallada aasaasiga ah ee falanqaynta tirooyinka.
objectives: Fahamka mabda'a titireynta is-dheelitirka iyo sida loo garto dhamaadka
Isticmaalka saxda ah ee burette
Xisaabinta xoogga aan la garanayn

hcl-naoh-neutralization.title: Qiyaasidda Kulaylka Is-dheelitirka ee aashito hydrochloric ah iyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH)
hcl-naoh-neutralization.description: Kalorimitar ah koobtii kulaylka ilaalisa ayaa lagu qiyaasaa kulaylka is-dheelitirka ee ka dhasha falcelinta aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) iyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH), si loo fahmo isbeddelka tamarta ee falcelinnada bixiya kulaylka.
objectives: Qiyaasidda kulaylka is-dheelitirka
Fahamka falcelinnada bixiya kulaylka
Falanqaynta ilo-khaladaadka tijaabada

indicator-color-change.title: Sharciga Isbeddelka Midabka ee Muujiyeyaasha Aashitada iyo Saldhiga
indicator-color-change.description: Isbeddelada midabka ee litmus, phenolphthalein, iyo methyl orange ayaa lagu arkaa xalalkii aashidda ahaa iyo kuwa saldhiga ahaa, si loo koobo xadudda isbeddelkooda.
objectives: Garanshaha muujiyeyaasha caadiga ah
Bartida sharciga isbeddelka midabka
Barasho sida loo ogaanayo dabeecadda aashid ama saldhig ee xalka

vinegar-soda.title: Falcelinta Khall-geed iyo Soodiyamka Bikarbonaadka
vinegar-soda.description: Waxaa la baadhaa muuqaalka ka dhasha falcelinta khall-geed (aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH)) iyo soodiyamka bikarbonaadka ee jikada, taas oo soo saarta carbon dioxide (CO₂), si loo xidho kimistriga nolosha maalinta ah.
objectives: La socodsiinta falcelinta aashidda daciifka ah iyo bikarbonaadka
Garanshaha soo saarista carbon dioxide (CO₂)
Xidida tusaalooyinka nolosha

metal-oxide-acid.title: Falcelinta copper(II) oxide iyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay
metal-oxide-acid.description: Waxaa la arkaa sida copper(II) oxide madow ugu dhalaalaayo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) si uu u sameeyo xalka buluugga ah ee copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), waxaana la baranayaa falcelinta oksiidyada bir-maandheerta iyo aashidda.
objectives: Barasho falcelinta oksiidyada aasaasiga ah iyo aashidda
La socodsiinta isbeddelka midabka xalka
Qorista macaadelada kiimikada

limewater-co2.title: Falcelinta carbon dioxide (CO₂) iyo Biyo gaashaan ah
limewater-co2.description: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) ayaa laguugu nafaynayaa Biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد) oo saafi ah, waxaana la arkaa sida uu u dhufo, taasoo lagu baranayo habka tijaabinta carbon dioxide (CO₂).
objectives: Bartida tijaabinta CO₂
Fahamka falcelinta aasaasiga iyo oksiidyada aashidda ah
La socodsiinta samaynta rasaaста

carbonate-acid-identify.title: Tijaabinta Kaarboonaydka
carbonate-acid-identify.description: aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu aqoonsado sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) adkaatay, iyadoo la xaqiijinayo kaarboonaydka iyada oo ku saleysan gaaska soo baxa ee Biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد) dhufinaya.
objectives: Bartida tijaabinta kaarboonaydka
La socodsiinta muuqaalka soo saarista gaaska
Xidida falanqaynta taariikhda

ph-measurement.title: Qiyaasidda pH ee Xalalkii Caadiga ahaa
ph-measurement.description: warqadda tijaabada pH iyo pH-miis ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu qiyaasayo aashidnimada xalalka kala duwan ee nolosha maalinta ah, waxaana la is-barbar dhigayaa saxnaanta laba haboodba.
objectives: Bartida habka qiyaasidda pH
Fahamka xidhiidhka pH iyo dabeecadda aashid ama saldhig
Is-barbar dhigida saxnaanta qiyaasidda

weak-acid-ionization.title: Kala-soocidda Elektarooleetka Daciifka ah
weak-acid-ionization.description: Barbar-dhig waxqabadka koronto iyo pH-ka aashitada hidroklorikada (HCl) iyo aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) ee isla xoogga ah, si loo fahmo sida elektarooleetka daciifka ah uu qayb ahaan u kala-soocmo.
objectives: Kala-sooca elektarooleetka xoogga ah iyo kan daciifka ah
Faham dheelitirka kala-soocidda
Sharax farqiga waxqabadka korontada

salt-hydrolysis.title: Baaritaanka Hydrolysis-ka Cusbitada
salt-hydrolysis.description: Cabbir pH-ka xalaalada sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃), ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl), iyo sodium chloride (NaCl), si aad u baarto sida hydrolysis-ku u keeno aashitnimada ama alkalinity-ga xalaalada.
objectives: Faham mabaadi'da hydrolysis-ka cusbitada
Go'aamri dabeecadda aashit ama alkaline ee xalaalada cusbitada
Qor xisaabaadka hydrolysis

antacid-stomach.title: Baaritaanka Daawaynta Aashidda Caloosha
antacid-stomach.description: Isticmaal Aluminiyam haydroокsiid iyo sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) si loo demi-galiyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) ee u eg aashidda caloosha, si loo xidho xidhiidhka u dhexeeya daawada iyo dheelitirka aashit-alkaline.
objectives: Garo mabda'a daawada ka hortagta aashidda
La soco hannaanka demi-galinta
Xidh xidhiidhka codsiga caafimaadka

diprotic-acid-titration.title: Titration-ka Aashidda Laba-Aashiyadeed ee Xoogga ah
diprotic-acid-titration.description: Isticmaal sodium hydroxide (NaOH) si aad u titrate gasho aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄), oo adiga oo ku tiirsanaya khadka pH si aad u garto sida laba darajo ee ionization-ka aashidda laba-aashiyadeed ah ay ku dhawaad isku mar la demi-galiyo oo uu soo muuqdo kaliya hal boodo, kadibna tiro-barto Aasidda foosforik.
objectives: Sawir khadka titration-ka
Garo aashidaha badan-aashiyadeed
Xisaabi xoogga

buffer-solution.title: Sifooyinka Xalaalada Buffer-ka
buffer-solution.description: Diyaari xalaala buffer ah oo aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH)-sodium acetate ah, kadibna tijaabi xasilloonida pH-ka marka la daro tiro yar oo aashit ama alkaline ah, si loo fahmo sida buffer-ku u shaqeeyo.
objectives: Faham mabda'a buffer-ka
Tijaabi xasilloonida pH-ka
Xidh xidhiidhka buffer-ka dhiigga

co2-preparation.title: Diyaarinta Laboratoriga ee carbon dioxide (CO₂)
co2-preparation.description: Samee carbon dioxide (CO₂) adiga oo isticmaalaya calcium carbonate (marble) iyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid), oo aad ku bartid qalabka soo saarista iyo uruurinta gaaska.
objectives: Fahmo mabaadi'da diyaarinta CO₂
Baro habka uruurinta oo hawada lagu baddelo oo kor loo qaado
Xaqiiji CO₂

o2-from-h2o2.title: Soo Saarka Ogsijiin (O₂) ee hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂)
o2-from-h2o2.description: Isticmaal manganese(IV) oxide (MnO₂) sidii catalyst si aad uga kala-jabiso hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) oo aad u hesho ogsijiin (O₂), si loo fahmo doorka catalyst-ka.
objectives: Fahmo diyaarinta oksijiin
Faham doorka catalyst-ka
Baro habka uruurinta biyaha lagu baddelo

h2-from-zinc.title: Soo Saarka gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) ee graniyuulada zinc iyo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄)
h2-from-zinc.description: Ku samee gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) adiga oo isticmaalaya graniyuulada zinc iyo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la wasakheeyay, kadibna xaqiiji gubashada hydrogen-ka iyo tijaabada cod-qararka ah.
objectives: Fahmo diyaarinta haidrojiin
Xaqiiji nadiifnimada hydrogen-ka
La soco muuqaalka cod-qararka ah

nh3-preparation.title: Diyaarinta Gaaska Ammonia iyo Tijaabada Biyaha La Buufinayo
nh3-preparation.description: Ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) iyo calcium hydroxide waa la kululaynayaa si loo sameeyo gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas), ka dibna waxaa la fuliyaa tijaabada caanka ah ee biyaha la buufinayo si loo arko sida gaaskan ugu dhaqso badan u milma biyaha.
objectives: Awood u yeelashada diyaarinta gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas)
Fahanka mabaadi'da tijaabada biyaha la buufinayo
Xaqiijinta gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas)

so2-preparation.title: Diyaarinta iyo Sifooyinka Sulfur Dioxide
so2-preparation.description: Sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) waxaa lala falceliyaa aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) si loo sameeyo sulfur dioxide, ka dibna waxaa la xaqiijiyaa awoodda caddaynta iyo awoodda yaraynta ee gaaskan.
objectives: Awood u yeelashada diyaarinta SO₂
Xaqiijinta awoodda caddaynta
Ogaanshaha waxyeelada deegaanka ee gaaskan

h2s-preparation.title: Diyaarinta iyo Xaqiijinta Hydrogen Sulfide
h2s-preparation.description: Birta(II) sulfiiد waxaa lala falceliyaa aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) si loo sameeyo hydrogen sulfide; waxaa la bartaa urta ukunta oo kale iyo awoodda yaraynta xooggan ee gaaskan — si gaar ah waa la fiiriyaa hawada gudaha.
objectives: Awood u yeelashada diyaarinta H₂S
Ogaanshaha sunta gaaskan
Fahamka awoodda yaraynta

co2-baking-soda.title: Kululaynta Sodium Bicarbonate iyo Barbardhigga Soo-saarka Gaaska
co2-baking-soda.description: Waxaa la barbardhigaa falcelinta sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) iyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) si loo fahmo mabaadi'da kiimikada ee loo adeegsado sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) xagga khamiirka cuntada.
objectives: Daawashada dhacdada soo-saarka gaaska
Xidhiidhinta farsamo iyo nolosha maalinlaha ah
Xaqiijinta carbon dioxide (CO₂)

ammonia-fountain-hcl.title: Isdhexgalka Gaaska Ammonia iyo Hydrogen Chloride — Qoobka Cad
ammonia-fountain-hcl.description: Ul dhalo ah oo lagu dhuftay xalliga amooniyaaka oo xooggan (concentrated ammonia solution) iyo ul dhalo ah oo lagu dhuftay hydrochloric acid dhumuc badan (concentrated hydrochloric acid) waa la wada dhawaansiiyaa, ka dibna waxaa la daawadaa sameynta qoobka cad ee ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) si loo garto falcelinta u dhaxaysa labada gaas.
objectives: Daawashada dhacdada qoobka cad
Fahamka falcelinta u dhaxaysa gaasaska
Ogaanshaha sameynta ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl)

carbonate-thermal.title: Baadhitaanka Kala-qaybsanaanta Amooniyam baykaabonayt
carbonate-thermal.description: Amooniyam baykaabonayt waa la kululaynayaa si loo arko sida si buuxda ugu kala-qaybsanayso gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas), biyo, iyo carbon dioxide (CO₂), taas oo lagu fahamayo sifooyinka shilanka aan xasilloonayn ee ah.
objectives: Daawashada gaaska ka soo baxa kala-qaybsanaanta
Xaqiijinta gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) iyo CO₂
Ogaanshaha aan xasilloonaynta shilanka amooniyamka

co2-properties.title: Baadhitaanka Sifooyinka Carbon Dioxide
co2-properties.description: Waxaa la xaqiijiyaa in carbon dioxide (CO₂) uusan taageerinin gubashada, cufnaantiisuna ka badnaatay tan hawada, waxaana la arki doonaa sida uu biyaha kula falceliyo si loo sameeyo carbonic acid kaas oo litmus casaan ka dhiga.
objectives: Ogaanshaha sifooyinka CO₂
Xaqiijinta falcelinta biyaha
Xidhiidhinta adeegsiga demiska dab

o2-properties.title: Baadhitaanka Sifooyinka Ogsijiin
o2-properties.description: Xabo qori oo dhalaal leh, xadhig birta (Fe), iyo Sulfar budo ah waxaa loo adeegsadaa xaqiijinta awoodda ogsijiin (O₂) ee kicinaynta gubashada, waxaana la daawadaa dhacdooyinka gubashada xooggan.
objectives: Ogaanshaha awoodda ogsijiin (O₂) ee kicinaynta gubashada
Daawashada gubashada xadhig birta (Fe)
Fahamka farqiga u dhexeeya kicinaynta gubashada iyo la-gubashadda

chlorine-preparation.title: Diyaarinta Gaaska Chlorine Xarunta Cilmi-baarista
chlorine-preparation.description: Gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) waxaa lagu soo saaraa annagoo kuleylina manganese(IV) oxide (MnO₂) iyo hydrochloric acid dhumuc badan (concentrated hydrochloric acid), ka dibna waxaa la xaqiijiyaa awooda caddaynta iyo saamaynta xanaaqsan (hawlgalka waxaa lagu fuliyaa cabbirada hawada (fume cupboard)).
objectives: Ku xirfadeyso diyaarinta gaaska chlorine (Cl₂)
Xaqiiji awooda caddaynta gaaska
Ku baqdow qaabka loola macaamilaa dhuumashada dambaaliga

agcl-precipitation.title: Baarista Aayoonka Chloride
agcl-precipitation.description: Marka la soo daayo silver nitrate (AgNO₃) xalka sodium chloride (NaCl), waxaa ka dhasha cadaan ah oo aan ku dhalalin aashito naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid), taasoo xaqiijinaysa joogitaanka aayoonka chloride.
objectives: Ku xirfadeyso habka baarista aayoonka chloride
La soco dhalashada cadaanka
Faham shuruudaha falcelinta beddelka labanlaabmaha

baso4-precipitation.title: Baarista Aayoonka Sulfate
baso4-precipitation.description: Xalka barium chloride (BaCl₂) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu baaro aayoonka sulfate ee ku jira sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄), kaasoo soo saara cadaan barium sulfate ah oo aan ku dhalalin aashito.
objectives: Ku xirfadeyso habka baarista aayoonka sulfate
Ka saar aayoonnada kala duwan ee khalkhaliya natiijada
La soco dhalashada cadaanka

cuoh2-precipitation.title: Diyaarinta Naxaas(II) haydrooksiiد
cuoh2-precipitation.description: Marka xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) la falaceliso sodium hydroxide (NaOH), waxaa ka dhasha Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد midab buluug ah leh, oo muujinaya astaamaha dhalashada flocculent ah.
objectives: Diyaari Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد
La soco dhalashada midabka buluugga ah
Qor macaadalada aayoonnada falcelinta

feoh3-precipitation.title: Diyaarinta birta(III) hiidrooksaydka
feoh3-precipitation.description: Marka xalka iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) la falaceliso sodium hydroxide (NaOH), waxaa ka dhasha birta(III) hiidrooksaydka (iron(III) hydroxide) midab cas-bunni ah leh, taasoo caddaynaysa astaamaha birta heerka saddexaad.
objectives: Diyaari birta(III) hiidrooksaydka (iron(III) hydroxide)
La soco dhalashada midabka cas-bunniga ah
Kala gaar heerarka oxidation ee bir (Fe)

caco3-precipitation.title: Dhalashada Calcium Carbonate
caco3-precipitation.description: Marka xalka sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) la falaceliso xalka calcium chloride (CaCl₂), waxaa ka dhasha cadaan calcium carbonate ah, taasoo caddaynaysa u-beddelka walxaha aan si fiican u dhalalin.
objectives: La soco dhalashada cadaanka
Faham falcelinta beddelka labanlaabmaha
Xiri aqoonta sababaha abuurista dheecaanka biyo-kariska

mgoh2-precipitation.title: Diyaarinta magnesium hydroxide
mgoh2-precipitation.description: Marka magnesium chloride la falaceliso sodium hydroxide (NaOH), waxaa ka dhasha cadaan magnesium oxide (MgO) oo u dhigma saldhig aan si wanaagsan u dhalalin, taasoo muujinaysa habka diyaarinta saldhigyada adag.
objectives: Diyaari magnesium hydroxide
La soco dhalashada midabka caddaan ah
Xiri aqoonta habka magnesium laga soo saaro badda

agi-precipitation.title: Dhalashada Silfar(I) aayodiiد iyo Roobka Macmal
agi-precipitation.description: Marka silver nitrate (AgNO₃) la falaceliso potassium iodide (KI), waxaa ka dhasha jaalle Silfar(I) aayodiiد ah, lagana fahmay isticmaalkooda ku saabsan abuurista roobka macmal ah.
objectives: La soco dhalashada midabka jaallaha ah
Is bar bar dhig midabada halide-yada silfar kala duwan
Xiri aqoonta codsiyada maalmaha ah

agbr-precipitation.title: Talintta Silver Bromide (AgBr) iyo Walxaha Xasaasiga ah ee Iftiinka
agbr-precipitation.description: Silver nitrate (AgNO₃) ayaa ku falceliya potassium bromide si ay u samaystaan talin jaalle-cad oo silver bromide (AgBr) ah, taas oo lagu barato xasaasiyaddeeda iftiinka iyo mabaadii'da sawir-qaadista.
objectives: U fiirso talintta jaalle-cad ee la sameeyey
Fahmo xasaasiyadda walxaha iftiinka
Xidh xidhiidhka u dhexeeya cilmiga kiimikada iyo tignoolajiyada fiilimka sawir-qaadista

precipitation-conversion.title: Beddelista Talinnadaha
precipitation-conversion.description: Marka la kudaraa xalka iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) talinnadda magnesium hydroxide cad ah, la eegaa sida talinnadda caddaa u beddeshay midab casaan-bunni, si loo fahmo mabda'a solubility product.
objectives: Fahmo sida talinnadda loo beddelayo
Aqoonso xajmiga kala duwan ee solubility product
Falanqee jihada uu beddelku u socdo

hard-water-softening.title: Jilicsiinta Biyaha Adagta
hard-water-softening.description: Marka sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) lagu daro biyaha adagta, ionada calcium-ka iyo magnesium-ka ayaa loo rogaa talinnado, taas oo lagu fahansan yahay waxyeellada biyaha adagta iyo hababka loo jilicsiyo.
objectives: Aqoonso qaybaha kiimikadeed ee biyaha adagta
Ku xirfadeyso mabda'a jilicsiinta
Barbardhig biyaha adagta iyo kuwa jilicsan

baso4-gravimetric.title: Cabirka Kaabooniga ee Sulfur-ka Adeegsiga Barium Sulfate
baso4-gravimetric.description: Ionada sulfate ayaa loo rogaa talinnado adeegsiga barium chloride (BaCl₂), ka dibna la shaandhayn, la dhaqo, la gubto, oo la miisaamo si loo go'aamiyo xaddiga sulfate-ka ku jira muunada.
objectives: Ku xirfadeyso falanqaynta miisaanka (gravimetric analysis)
Ku dhaqan hababka saxda ah ee dhaqista talinnadda
Xisaabi xaddiga sulfur-ka

double-decomposition-rule.title: Shuruudaha Falcelinta Beddelashada Labanlaabka ah
double-decomposition-rule.description: Adeegsiga kooxo badan oo falcelino ah oo u dhexeeya cusbo iyo salaan, ama cusbo iyo cusbo, ayaa lagu soo koobaa shuruudaha loo baahan yahay ee falcelinta beddelashada labanlaabka ah: in la samaystaa talinnado, gaas, ama biyo.
objectives: Soo koob shuruudaha falcelinta
Barbardhig kiimikada leh talin iyo tan aan lahayn
Qor isla-dhigannada ionic-ka

kmno4-oxalic-acid.title: Oxidation-ka Oxalic Acid adeegsiga Potassium Permanganate (KMnO₄)
kmno4-oxalic-acid.description: Potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) oo aashitaysan ayaa ku falceliya oxalic acid, taas oo keenaysa in midabka guduud-jeermis la waayo, si loo baadho saamaynta xaddiga iyo heerkulka ku leh xawaaraha falcelinta.
objectives: U fiirso waayista midabka sababtoo ah oxidation-ka
Fahmo xoogga sare ee oxidation-ka
Baadh saamaynta xawaaraha falcelinta

kmno4-fe2.title: Titration-ka Ionada Fe²⁺ Adeegsiga Potassium Permanganate (KMnO₄)
kmno4-fe2.description: Xalka cabirka ah ee potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) ayaa loo adeegsadaa titration-ka iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄), halka dhammaadka titration-ka lagu garto marka midabka guduud-jeermis aanu bixin, si loo barto titration-ka oxidation-reduction.
objectives: Ku xirfadeyso titration-ka oxidation-reduction
Adeegsiga xalka naftiisa ah (self-indicator) si loo go'aamiyo dhamaadka
Xisaabi xaddiga ionada Fe²⁺

halogen-displacement-cl-br.title: Gaaska Chlorine (Cl₂) oo Bedelaya Bromine (Br₂)
halogen-displacement-cl-br.description: Marka gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) lagu buufiyo xalka potassium bromide, bromine (Br₂) oo midab oranji ah leh ayaa soo baxa, taas oo xaqiijinaysa dalbalka xoogga oxidation-ka ee halogens-ka.
objectives: Xaqiiji firfirconaanta kiimikadeed ee halogens-ka
U fiirso kala-qaybsanaanta xalka ee extraction-ka
Qor isla-dhigannada ionic-ka

halogen-displacement-br-i.title: Bromine ayaa beddelaysa iodine (I₂)
halogen-displacement-br-i.description: Marka la daro xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood) xalka potassium iodide (KI), bromine (Br₂) ayaa bedelaya iodine (I₂); natiijtadana waxaa lagu xaqiijiyaa xabag (xoogaa) oo u roga midab buluug, si loo barbardhigo awoodda oxidation ee bromine (Br₂) iyo iodine (I₂).
objectives: Xaqiijinta firfircoonida bromine (Br₂) iyo iodine (I₂)
Indho-indheynta midabka buluuga ah ee xabagta (xoogaa) markay la kulanto iodine (I₂)
Fahanka sharciga beddelashada (displacement) ee halogenka

iodine-starch.title: Falcelinta midabka iodine (I₂) iyo xabagta (xoogaa)
iodine-starch.description: La daawo falcelinta astaan ah ee iodine (I₂) markuu la kulmo xabag (xoogaa), taas oo u rota midab buluug mugdi ah; waxaana loo isticmaalaa baaritaanka iodine (I₂) iyo go'aasamida dhamaadka xisaabta iodometric.
objectives: La daawasho midabka buluuga astaan u ah
Fahmida aasaaska cilmiga ah ee muujinta midabka
Ku dabaqida falanqaynta tirada (quantitative analysis)

so2-bromine-water.title: Sulfur dioxide ayaa nadiifiya xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood)
so2-bromine-water.description: Marka sulfur dioxide la buuxiyo xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood), midabka oranjigu way baaba'daa, taas oo xaqiijinaysa awoodda reduction ee sulfur dioxide ee aan lahayn awoodda dhadhan-baabi'inta (bleaching).
objectives: Garan awoodda reduction ee SO₂
Kala soocida awoodda reduction iyo awoodda dhadhan-baabi'inta
Qorista macaamilka jimicsiga (equation)

h2o2-ki-catalysis.title: Potassium iodide (KI) ayaa kiciya burburka hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂)
h2o2-ki-catalysis.description: Potassium iodide (KI) waxa uu ka dhigaa catalyst burburka hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂), taas oo sii daaysa ogsijiin (O₂); waxaana la daawaystaa sida catalyst-ku u soo noqdo caadkiisii ka dib falcelinta.
objectives: Fahmida burburka catalyst-ku kiciyey
Baaritaanka ogsijiin (O₂)
Garan sinaanta catalyst-ka

copper-nitric-acid.title: Falcelinta naxaas (Cu) iyo aashito nitric ah (HNO₃)
copper-nitric-acid.description: Naxaas (Cu) marka uu falceliya aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid) ayaa xal buluug-cagaaran la'eg ah soo saara oo gaas sii daayaa; waxaana lagu gartaa awoodda oxidation ee xooggan ee aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) (hawlgalka waa in si fiican loo hawaynaa).
objectives: Garan awoodda oxidation ee aashito nitric ah (HNO₃)
La daawasho gaaska soo baxa iyo beddelashada midabka
Fahmida sababta hydrogen uusan ka soo bixin falcelinta

fe3-reduction-by-iron.title: Bir (Fe) ayaa u rogaya ions-ka bir(III)
fe3-reduction-by-iron.description: Marka budo birta (Fe) la daro xalka iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃), midabka huruudda-boodhaadku wuu faaydaa ilaa uu noqdo cagaaran-fudud, taas oo xaqiijinaysa in bir (Fe) uu u rogayo ion-ka bir(III) ion-ka bir(II).
objectives: Fahmida heerarka oxidation ee dhexe
Indho-indheynta beddelashada midabka
Qorista isla-macaamilka ion-ka (ionic equation)

kmno4-ethanol.title: Potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) ayaa oxidation-gaynaysa ethanol (C₂H₅OH)
kmno4-ethanol.description: Potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) oo aashito ah markuu oxidation-geeyo ethanol (C₂H₅OH), midabka guduud-jaallaha ah ayaa baaba'aya; waxaana lagu gartaa awoodda reduction ee alcohol-ka iyo natiijada oxidation-ka.
objectives: La daawasho nadiifinta midabka iyada oo la oxidation-gaynayo
Garan sida alcohol-ka loo oxidation-gaynayo
Xiriirinta mabda'a meesha baaritaanka suuxidda wadista (drink-driving test)

iodine-clock.title: Falcelinta saacadda iodine (I₂)
iodine-clock.description: Iodine (I₂) ee ay soo saarto falcelinta hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) iyo potassium iodide (KI) ayaa joogtayn la'aanta u rogaysa sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃); marka sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) dhammaado, iodine (I₂) ayaa si degdeg ah u kordhaa oo la xiriirta xabag (xoogaa) si uu xalku si kedis ah ugu rogo midab buluug, taas oo lagu ogaanayo muddada horumarka (induction period) iyo xawliga falcelinta.
objectives: La daawasho muujinta saacadda iodine (I₂)
Fahmida muddada horumarinta (induction period)
Baadista saamaynta xoogga xalka (concentration) ku leh xawliga falcelinta

chlorine-bleaching.title: Saamaynta Caddaynta ee Biyaha Chlorine
chlorine-bleaching.description: Biyo chlorine ah (chlorine water) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu caddeeyo xarig maro midab leh, taasoo muujinaysa xoogga oksidaynta iyo mabda'a caddaynta ee hypochlorous acid.
objectives: Faham mabda'a caddaynta
Kala saar gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) iyo hypochlorous acid
Xidh xidhiidh caddaynta budo chlorine (bleaching powder)

fe2-fe3-conversion.title: Isbeddelka Labada Xaalad ee Valency ee Birta
fe2-fe3-conversion.description: Biyo chlorine ah (chlorine water) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu oksideeyo ionka ferrous si uu u noqdo ion ferric, halka budo birta (Fe) loo isticmaalo in lagu soo celiyo ion ferric si uu u noqdo ion ferrous, taasoo muujinaysa birta leh valency badan.
objectives: Faham u beddelka xaaladaha valency
Xaqiiji adiga oo isticmaalaya midabka muujinta
Qor equation-ka oxidation-reduction

metal-activity-acid.title: Baaritaanka Tartanka Firfircoonida Biraha
metal-activity-acid.description: Waxaa la barbardhigaa xoogga falcelinta magnesium, zinc, iyo bir (Fe) markay kula falceliyaan aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) iyagoo soo saara gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas), si loo qeexo nidaamka firfircoonida biraha.
objectives: Barbardhig xoogga falcelinta
Qeex nidaamka firfircoonida
Tijaabi gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas)

iron-copper-sulfate.title: Birtu u Beddesho Naxaasta ee ku Jirta Xalka Copper(II) Sulfate
iron-copper-sulfate.description: Musmaaro bir ah ayaa lagu dhex jebiyaa xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄); dusha sare waxaa ka muuqda naxaas (Cu) cas, midabka buluugga ah ee xalku wuu fududaadaa, taasoo xaqiijinaysa falcelinta beddelka biraha.
objectives: Fiiri muuqaalka falcelinta beddelka
Faham farqiga firfircoonida
Qor equation-ka falcelinta

copper-silver-nitrate.title: Naxaasta u Beddesho Lacagta ee ku Jirta Xalka Silver Nitrate
copper-silver-nitrate.description: Xadhigga naxaasta (copper wire) ayaa lagu dhex geliyaa xalka silver nitrate (AgNO₃); dusha sare waxaa ka baxda geed Lacag (silfar) ah oo cad, xalku wuxuu u beddelmaa buluug, taasoo muujinaysa falcelinta beddelka iyo koritaanka uumiyaha.
objectives: Fiiri koritaanka geedka lacagta
Faham falcelinta beddelka
Garo sababta uu xalku u noqdo buluug

sodium-water.title: Falcelinta Birta Sodium (Sodium Metal) iyo Biyo
sodium-water.description: Birta sodium (sodium metal) ayaa lagu ridaa biyo lagu daray phenolphthalein; waxaa la arkaa in ay dul dhacdo, dhalato, socoto, cod samayso, oo midabka casaanka samayso, taasoo muujinaysa falcelinta biraha firfircoon iyo biyaha.
objectives: Fiiri shan muuqaal oo muhiim ah
Garo soo saarista saldhiga xooggan
Faham sida loo keydiyo birta sodium (sodium metal)

iron-rusting.title: Baaritaanka Shuruudaha Sadqanaanta Birta
iron-rusting.description: Waxaa la barbardhigaa sadqanaanta musmaaro bir ah xaaladaha kala duwan sida qalalan, qoyan, iyo meel hawadu ka maqan tahay, si loo ogaado in sadqanaantu u baahan tahay biyo iyo ogsijiin (O₂).
objectives: Baadhi shuruudaha sadqanaanta
Faham mabda'a ka hortagga sadqanaanta
Naqshadeey tijaabo barbardhig ah

aluminum-acid-base.title: Baaritaanka Laba-dhinacnimada Aluminium
aluminum-acid-base.description: Xaashi aluminium ah ayaa kala geliya aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) iyo Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد; labadooduba waxay soo saaraan gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas), taasoo muujinaysa in aluminium uu kula falceliyo labadaba aashitada iyo saldhiga.
objectives: Garo laba-dhinacnimada aluminium
Barbardhig soo saarista gaaska
Qor laba nooc oo equation ah

magnesium-burning.title: Gubashada xariga maqniisiyam ah
magnesium-burning.description: Marka xariga maqniisiyam ah la shito, waxay soo saartaa iftiinka cad ee indha-xanuujiya waxayna abuurataa magnesium oxide (MgO) midabka cad ah, taasoo noo caddaynaysa falcelinta oxidation ee kulaylka badan sii daaysa.
objectives: La socoshada muuqaalka gubashada
Garanaanta magnesium oxide (MgO)
Fahanaanta falcelinta sii-daynta kulaylka

thermite-reaction.title: Falcelinta thermite ee Aluminiyam budo ah
thermite-reaction.description: Aluminiyam budo ah iyo iron(III) oxide waxay si xoog leh u falceliyaan heerkulka sare, waxayna soo saartaan bir (Fe) iyo Aluminiyam ooksiid, taasoo muujinaysa adeegsiga falcelinta beddelka ee kulaylka badan sii daaysa.
objectives: Garanaanta falcelinta thermite
Fahanaanta adeegsiga warshadaha ee weedha birta
Ogaaashada nidaamyada ammaanka

metal-displacement-series.title: Soo-saarka naxaas (Cu) si jilicsan
metal-displacement-series.description: Bir (Fe) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu beddelo naxaas (Cu) ka soo baxa xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), taasoo ku dayacaysa hab-dhaqanka taariikhdiga ah ee macdanta jiliciga ah, si loo fahmo mabaadi'da soo-saarka biraha.
objectives: Fahanaanta metallurgy-ga jiliciga ah
Soo-celinta naxaas (Cu)
Xiriirka taariikhda iyo dhaqanka

aluminum-oxide-film.title: Dhowrista xaashi aluminium ah ee dareeraha oxidation
aluminum-oxide-film.description: Isbarbardhigga xaashi aluminium ah oo la xoqay oo warqadda ciidda lagu diyaariyay marka loo eego mid aan la xoqin, labaduba lagu daray aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl), si loo garto sida lakabka oxidation ee cufan u dhowrto.
objectives: Garanaanta doorka lakabka oxidation
Isbarbardhigga xawaaraha falcelinta
Xiriirka adkaysiga birta aluminium ee alaabta maalinlaha ah

fe3-scn-coloring.title: Baarista ion-ka bir (Fe³⁺) adoo isticmaalaya potassium thiocyanate (KSCN)
fe3-scn-coloring.description: Marka potassium thiocyanate (KSCN) loogu shubo xalka iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃), xalku wuxuu u roonaadaa midabka cas ee dhiiga oo kale, taasoo noo siinaysa hab xasaasi ah oo lagu baaro bir (Fe³⁺).
objectives: Bartashada baarista Fe³⁺
La socoshada muuqaalka midabka cas ee dhiiga oo kale
Garanaanta falcelinta isu-xidhka (coordination)

copper-ammonia-complex.title: Abuurista ion-ka isu-xidhka ah ee naxaas-ammoniya
copper-ammonia-complex.description: Marka xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) si tartiib tartiib ah loogu shubo xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), marka hore waxaa samaysma foorar buluug ah, ka dibna wuxuu ku dhexmilmaa xal buluug gudud ah oo naxaas-ammoniya ah.
objectives: La socoshada milmidda foorarka
Garanaanta ion-ka isu-xidhka ah
Fahanaanta dheelitirka isu-xidhka (coordination equilibrium)

fe3-equilibrium-shift.title: Dhaqdhaqaaqa dheelitirka falcelinta bir-thiocyanate
fe3-equilibrium-shift.description: Xalka bir-thiocyanate ee cas ee dhiiga u eg marka lagu beddesho tirada ion-ka bir (Fe³⁺) ama ion-ka thiocyanate, waxaa la arkaa isbeddel ku yimaada qoto-dheerida midabka, taasoo xaqiijinaysa dhaqdhaqaaqa dheelitirka kiimikada.
objectives: Fahanaanta dheelitirka kiimikada
Xaqiijinta saamaynta tirada
Falanqaynta taariikhiga ah ee midabka

phenol-fecl3-coloring.title: Baarista muuqaalka phenol adoo isticmaalaya iron(III) chloride
phenol-fecl3-coloring.description: Marka iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) loogu shubo xalka phenol, xalku wuxuu u roonaadaa midabka guduud, taasoo noo siinaysa hab gaar ah oo lagu garto kooxda phenol hydroxyl.
objectives: Bartashada baarista phenol
La socoshada muuqaalka guduudka
Garanaanta sifooyinka phenol

silver-ammonia-prep.title: Diyaarinta Xalka Silfar-Ammoniya
silver-ammonia-prep.description: Silfar nitrate (AgNO₃) ayaa lagu shubtaa xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) ilaa dallaaladda ay si buuxda u milmaan, si loo diyaarsado xalka silfar-ammoniya (Tollens' reagent) oo loo isticmaalo hubinta kooxda aldehyde.
objectives: Diyaarinta xalka silfar-ammoniya
Fahamka milmidda xiriirka koordineeshanka
U diyaargarowga falcelinta muraayadda silfar

diammine-silver-test.title: Titraashanka Koordineeshanka Ionka Calcium iyo Magnesium ee Biyaha Adag
diammine-silver-test.description: Nidaamka xasilinta pH≈10 ee ammoniya–ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) ayaa loo adeegsadaa titraashanka ionka calcium iyo magnesium ee muunada biyaha adoo isticmaalaya xalka caadiga ah ee EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid), iyadoo Eriochrome Black T loo adeegsado tilmaamaha; marka midabka ka bedelmo guduud-casaan ilaa buluug saafi ah, taasi waxay muujinaysaa dhammaadka titraashanka.
objectives: Ku xidhiidhinta titraashanka koordineeshanka
Qiyaasista adkaanta biyaha
Aqoonsiga dhammaadka isbeddelka midabka

cobalt-chloride-equilibrium.title: Xaaladda Dheelitirka Midabka ee Cobalt(II) Chloride
cobalt-chloride-equilibrium.description: Waxaa la daawadaa bedelka cobalt(II) chloride u dhexeeya midabka casaan-guduud iyo buluuga marka xalku la dareeyo biyo ama la kululeeyo, si loo garto dhaqdhaqaaqa xaaladda dheelitirka koordineeshanka.
objectives: Garanshaha xaaladda dheelitirka koordineeshanka
Daawashada isbedelka midabka labadda jiho
Fahamka dhaqdhaqaaqa dheelitirka

prussian-blue.title: Sameynta Prussian Blue
prussian-blue.description: Ionka iron(II) wuxuu ku falceliyaa potassium hexacyanoferrate(III) (potassium ferricyanide) si uu u sameeyo rasaas buluug ah, taasoo ogeysiinaysa sameynta tiindhaha caanka ah ee Prussian Blue waxaana loo isticmaalaa hubinta ionka iron(II).
objectives: Garanshaha Prussian Blue
Hubinta ionka iron(II)
Xiriirinta taariikhda tiindhaha

ester-synthesis.title: Sameynta Ethyl Acetate (CH₃COOC₂H₅)
ester-synthesis.description: Aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) iyo ethanol (C₂H₅OH) waxay falceliyaan aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) oo matalaysa katalaysatarka si loo sameeyo ethyl acetate (CH₃COOC₂H₅) oo udgoon udgoon miro ah, taasoo ah tusaale wanaagsan oo falcelinta esterification.
objectives: Ku xidhiidhinta falcelinta esterification
Fahamka katalaysadda iyo bixitaanka biyaha
Garanshaha falcelinta rogrogta ah

silver-mirror.title: Falcelinta Muraayadda Silfar
silver-mirror.description: Acetaldehyde (CH₃CHO) iyo xalka silfar-ammoniya waxaa la kululeeyaa hammaan biyo (water bath) ilaa uu gidaarka tuubo tijaabo ku sameeyo muraayad silfar oo ifaysan, taasoo xaqiijinaysa awoodda kordhinta ee kooxda aldehyde.
objectives: Ku xidhiidhinta hubinta kooxda aldehyde
Daawashada sameynta muraayadda silfar
Fahamka awoodda kordhinta

glucose-fehling.title: Falcelinta Glukoos iyo Naxaas(II) Haydrooxsiid ee Cusub
glucose-fehling.description: Glukoos iyo Naxaas(II) haydrooxsiid (copper(II) hydroxide) oo cusub la kululeeyaa waxay sameeyaan rasaas cas-dhagax ah oo ah copper(I) oxide, taasoo hubinaysa kooxda aldehyde ee ku jirta Glukoos.
objectives: Hubinta Glukoos
Daawashada rasaasta cas-dhagaxda
Xiriirinta tijaabada baaritaanka macaanka sonkorta

ethylene-bromine.title: Ethylene (C₂H₄) oo Caddaynaya Xalka Bromine ah
ethylene-bromine.description: Marka ethylene (C₂H₄) lagu qariyo xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood), midabka oranjigu wuu baaba'aa, taasoo xaqiijinaysa falcelinta ku-darista ee xidhiidhka labanlaabka ah ee carbon-carbon.
objectives: Garanshaha falcelinta ku-darista
Kala-soocidda dheecaanka dabiiciga ah iyo aan dabiiciga ahayn
Daawashada baaba'ista midabka

ethanol-sodium.title: Falcelinta Ethanol iyo Sodium
ethanol-sodium.description: Marka birta sodium (sodium metal) la dhigo ethanol (C₂H₅OH) aan biyo lahayn, ayaa gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) si tartiib ah u soo baxa. Tijaabadani waxay nala barbardhigaysaa xoogga falcelinta biyaha, si aan u fahano firfircoonida hydrogen-ka ku jira kooxda hydroxyl.
objectives: Fahamka falcelinta kooxda hydroxyl
Barbardhigga xawaaraha falcelinta
Xaqiijinta gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas)

phenol-bromine-water.title: Falcelinta Phenol iyo Xalka Bromine ah
phenol-bromine-water.description: Marka xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood) la ku daraa xalka phenol, waxaa soo baxa cirib cad oo tribromophenol ah. Tijaabadani waxay xaqiijinaysaa falcelinta beddelka ee ku dhacda giraanta benzene (C₆H₆) marka kooxda hydroxyl ay firfircooniso.
objectives: Fahamka falcelinta beddelka (substitution reaction)
Daawashada ciribta cad
Fahamka saamaynta kooxaha kala duwan ee molekiyuulka

starch-iodine-test.title: Tijaabada Xabagta (xoogaa)
starch-iodine-test.description: Xalka iodine (I₂) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu xaqiijiyo joogitaanka xabag (xoogaa) cuntada ku jirta. Haddii midabku u beddelo buluug, waxay muujinaysaa in xabag (xoogaa) jirto, taasoo xidid la leh falanqaynta kiimikaadka cuntada.
objectives: Xaqiijinta joogitaanka xabag (xoogaa)
Daawashada isbeddelka midabka
Xiriirka tijaabada iyo falanqaynta cuntada maalinlaha ah

sucrose-hydrolysis.title: Kala-dillaacinta Sukroos
sucrose-hydrolysis.description: Sukroos waxay kala-dillaacday oo u beddeshatay Glukoos iyo fructose marka la isticmaalo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo dildillaacsan oo maaddo-dhexaad ah. Wixii ka dambeeya, xalka silver-ammonia ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu xaqiijiyo walxaha soo baxa.
objectives: Fahamka falcelinta kala-dillaacinta
Fahamka doorka maadda-dhexaadka (catalyst)
Xaqiijinta walxaha ka soo baxa kala-dillaacinta

ethanol-oxidation-copper.title: Oxidation-ka Ethanol oo Maaddo-dhexaad Leh
ethanol-oxidation-copper.description: Xadhigga naxaasta (copper wire) marka la kulaaliyo ayaa falcelinta oxidation-ka ethanol (C₂H₅OH) u dhexaadiya, iyagoo soo saara acetaldehyde (CH₃CHO). Xadhigga naxaasta (copper wire) wuxuu midabkiisu u wareegaa madow ilaa cas oo dib u noqon, taasoo muujinaysa sida maadda-dhexaadku u shaqeyso.
objectives: Fahamka oxidation-ka maaddo-dhexaad leh
Daawashada isbeddelka midabka xadhigga naxaasta (copper wire)
Fahamka wareegga maadda-dhexaadka (catalyst cycle)

soap-saponification.title: Sameynta Saabuunta (Falcelinta Saponification)
soap-saponification.description: Dufanka (shahada iyo dufanka) wuxuu kala-dillaacaa marka la kululeeyaa Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد, oo soo saara sodium-ka fatty acid sare (saabuun) iyo glycerol (C₃H₈O₃).
objectives: Fahamka falcelinta saponification
Baranshaha hawlgalka salting-out (milixaynta)
Xiriirka tijaabada iyo warshadaha kiimikaadka ee maalinlaha ah

solubility-measurement.title: Cabbirka Qalliinka potassium nitrate (KNO₃)
solubility-measurement.description: Qalliinka potassium nitrate (KNO₃) waxaa lagu cabbiraa heerkulyo kala duwan, markaasna waxaa la sawiraa xariiqa qalliinka si loo barto saamaynta heerkulka.
objectives: Fahamka fikradda qalliinka (solubility)
Baadhistaanka saamaynta heerkulka
Sawiridda xariiqa qalliinka (solubility curve)

dissolution-heat.title: Kuleylka la Nuugo iyo la Saaro Marka Walxo La Daray Biyo
dissolution-heat.description: Heerkulka biyaha waxaa lagu barbardhigaa marka sodium hydroxide (NaOH), Amooniyam nayitrееt, iyo sodium chloride (NaCl) kala duwan la daro biyo, si loo fahmo saamaynta kulaylka ee dhirbaaxada.
objectives: Fahamka kuleylka dhirbaaxada (heat of dissolution)
Kala soocida nuugashada iyo saaridda kulaylka
Xiriirka tijaabada iyo baakadaha kulul/qabow ee degdegga ah

neutralization-enthalpy.title: Qiyaasidda kulaylka falcelinta dhex-dhalinta
neutralization-enthalpy.description: Waxaa la qiyaasaa kulaylka falcelinta dhex-dhalinta ee u dhaxaysa aashitada xoogga badan iyo salka xoogga badan, si loo fahmo falcelinta sii-daynta kulaylka iyo ilaalinta tamarta.
objectives: Qiyaasidda kulaylka dhex-dhalinta
Fahamka kulaylka falcelinta
Falanqaynta khaladaadka qiyaasta

endothermic-reaction.title: Baaritaanka falcelinta nuugta kulaylka
endothermic-reaction.description: Markii crystaalada barium hydroxide iyo Amooniyam nayitrееt (NH₄Cl) la isku daro, heerkulka ayaa si degdeg ah u dhaca, taas oo muujinaysa falcelinta caanaha ah ee nuugta kulaylka.
objectives: Aqoonsiga falcelinta nuugta kulaylka
Daawashada ifriidka barafta
Fahamka isbeddelka tamarta

reaction-rate-temperature.title: Saamaynta heerkulka xawliga falcelinta
reaction-rate-temperature.description: Waxaa la barbar dhigaa wakhtiga ay sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) iyo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) khafiifka ah ku tiiraantaan oo muuqaalka daruuruhu ka muuqdaan heerkulyo kala duwan, si loo baaро saamaynta heerkulka xawliga falcelinta.
objectives: Baaritaanka saamaynta heerkulka
Xukumidda doorsoomimahaaga la barbar dhigo
Duubista wakhtiga falcelinta

concentration-rate.title: Saamaynta xoogga shucaaca xawliga falcelinta
concentration-rate.description: Waxaa la barbar dhigaa xawliga soo saarka gaaska markii xariga maqniisiyam ah la galinayo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) xoogga kala duwan, si tiro ahaan loo fahmo saamaynta xoogga shucaaca.
objectives: Baaritaanka saamaynta xoogga shucaaca
Xukumidda doorsoomimahaaga la barbar dhigo
Duubista xawliga soo saarka gaaska

catalyst-rate.title: Saamaynta kataaliisiga xawliga falcelinta
catalyst-rate.description: Waxaa la barbar dhigaa xawliga kala-sooca hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) oo samaynaaya oksijiinka, markii manganese(IV) oxide (MnO₂) jiro iyo markaan jirin, si loo aqoonsado sida kataaliisigu si weyn u dedejinayo falcelinta.
objectives: Aqoonsiga hawsha kataaliisiga
Barbardhigga xawliga falcelinta
Fahamka habka kataaliisiga

surface-area-rate.title: Saamaynta aagga xiriirka xawliga falcelinta
surface-area-rate.description: Waxaa la barbar dhigaa xawliga falcelinta calcium carbonate qaab-jabka ah iyo tan budo ah markay la falceliyaan aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl), si loo fahmo saamaynta aagga xiriirka ee walaxda falcelinta.
objectives: Baaritaanka aagga xiriirka
Xukumidda doorsoomimahaaga la barbar dhigo
Duubista tirada gaaska la soo saaray

chemical-equilibrium-temp.title: Saamaynta heerkulka dheelitirnaanta kiimikada
chemical-equilibrium-temp.description: Iyada oo la eegayo isbeddelka midabka ee nidaamka dheelitirnaanta u dhaxaysa Nayitrojiin daa'ooksiiد iyo Dii-nayitrojiin tetraooksiiد markii la dhigo biyaha kulul iyo kuwa qabow, waxaa la aqoonsadaa saamaynta heerkulka dheelitirnaanta.
objectives: Aqoonsiga guuritaanka dheelitirnaanta
Daawashada isbeddelka midabka
Fahamka mabaadi'da Le Chatelier

instant-cold-pack.title: Mabaadi'da kiis qaboojiyaha kiimikada
instant-cold-pack.description: Waxaa la sameeyaa kiis qaboojiye fudud iyada oo la adeegsanayo kuleylka nuugista ee Amooniyam nayitrееt markii la dhalaaliyo, si loo xidho adeegsiga kulaylka dhalaalisku leeyahay noloshа maalmeedda.
objectives: Adeegsiga nuugista kulaylka dhalaalisku
Cabbirka hoos u dhaca heerkulka
Xididdada kiisaska qaboojiyaha caafimaadka

flame-test.title: Falka Olka (Flame Test)
flame-test.description: Xarig balaatiin ah ayaa lagu qoysaa cusbooyin kala duwan oo birood ah, kadibna waxaa lagu shidaa olka si loo ogaado midabka gaarka ah ee olka: soodiyam wuxuu keenaa huruud, potassium wuxuu keenaa guduud-cirrin, calcium wuxuu keenaa cas-dhagax.
objectives: Ku xirfeyso falka olka iyo habka saxda ah ee la isticmaalo
Aqoonso curiyeyaasha birood ee kala duwan aкато loo eego midabkooda gaar ah
Xidh xiriir u dhexeeya falka olka iyo mabda'a fireworkska

chloride-identification.title: Baarista Tayada Ee Ionka Chloride
chloride-identification.description: Silver nitrate (AgNO₃) iyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu xaqiijiyo joogitaanka ionka chloride xalka, kaas oo lagu caddeynayo cad-cad oo aan ku dhegin aashitada.
objectives: Ku xirfeyso habka saxda ah ee lagu baaro ionka chloride
Baadi-goo waxyaabaha wax ku dheefi kara natiijooyinka baarista
Akhriso oo fahamso dabeecadda cad-cad ee soo baxa

sulfate-identification.title: Baarista Tayada Ee Ionka Sulfate
sulfate-identification.description: Barium chloride (BaCl₂) iyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu xaqiijiyo ionka sulfate, kaas oo lagu caddeynayo cad-cad aan ku dhegin aashitada.
objectives: Ku xirfeyso habka saxda ah ee lagu baaro ionka sulfate
Baadi-goo saamaynta ionka carbonate ee wax ku dheefi karta
Akhriso oo fahamso dabeecadda cad-cad ee soo baxa

carbonate-identification.title: Baarista Tayada Ee Ionka Carbonate
carbonate-identification.description: Aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) iyo Biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu xaqiijiyo ionka carbonate; xaqiijinta waxay ku tiirsan tahay soo bixitaanka gaaska iyo daahitaanka Biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد).
objectives: Ku xirfeyso habka saxda ah ee lagu baaro ionka carbonate
Ogow oo diiwaangeli soo bixitaanka gaaska inta lagu jiro falka
Xaqiiji joogitaanka CO₂ iyadoo la isticmaalayo Biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد)

fe3-identification.title: Baarista Ionka Bir (Fe³⁺)
fe3-identification.description: Potassium thiocyanate (KSCN) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu baaro ionka bir (Fe³⁺); xalku wuxuu u beddelmaa midab cas-dhiig ah, taas oo tilmaamaysa habka baarista tayada ee xasaasiga ah.
objectives: Ku xirfeyso habka saxda ah ee lagu baaro Fe³⁺
Ogow oo fahamso isbedddelka midabka ee soo baxa
Kala sooc xaaladaha kala duwan ee bir (Fe) ee kiimikaadka

ammonium-identification.title: Baarista Ionka Ammonium
ammonium-identification.description: Cusbada ammonium marka lagu daro sodium hydroxide (NaOH) oo la kululeeyo ayaa sii daaya gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas), kaas oo warqadda litmus ee cas (red litmus paper) oo qoyan u beddela buluug, taasoo xaqiijinaysa joogitaanka ionka ammonium.
objectives: Ku xirfeyso habka saxda ah ee lagu baaro ionka ammonium
Xaqiiji joogitaanka gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) iyadoo la isticmaalayo warqadda litmus ee cas (red litmus paper) oo qoyan
Faham shuruudaha kiimikaadka ee gaaska soo baxa

copper-identification.title: Baarista Ionka Naxaas (Cu²⁺)
copper-identification.description: Marka sodium hydroxide (NaOH) lagu daro xal ka kooban ionka naxaas (Cu), waxaa soo baxa cad-cad buluug ah, taasoo xaqiijinaysa joogitaanka ionka naxaas (Cu²⁺).
objectives: Ku xirfeyso habka saxda ah ee lagu baaro ionka naxaas (Cu²⁺)
Ogow oo diiwaangeli cad-cad buluug ah ee soo baxa
Xidh xiriir u dhexeeya midabka iyo aqoonsiga ionka kiimikaadka

copper-electrolysis.title: Electrolysis-ka Xalka Copper(II) Sulfate (CuSO₄)
copper-electrolysis.description: Marka xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) la kala-shaqeeyo korontada, cathode-ka ayaa lagu dalooliyaa naxaas (Cu) halka anode-ka uu sii daayo ogsijiin (O₂), taasoo tusaysa mabda'a electrolysis iyo falka electrode-ka.
objectives: Faham mabda'a electrolysis iyo sida uu u shaqeeyo
Qor oo sharax falka electrode-ka ee labada dhinac (cathode iyo anode)
Ogow oo diiwaangeli muuqaalada jireed ee soo baxa labada electrode

copper-zinc-cell.title: Batarida Naxaas-Zinc
copper-zinc-cell.description: Xaashi naxaas ah, zinc, iyo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la daraysto ayaa loo isticmaalaa in galvanomiter lagu leexiyo, si loo baadho sida tamarta kiimikada loogu badalo korontada.
objectives: Garan batarida
Qeexi cutubka hore iyo kan dambe
Fahmi beddelka tamarta

electroplating-copper.title: Tijaabada Elektropleydka Naxaasta
electroplating-copper.description: Qaybtii la baabi'in lahaa ayaa loo isticmaalaa kathoodka, naxaas (Cu) anoodka, waxaana lagu qalabiyaa xalliga copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), si loo fahmo mabaadi'da iyo codsiyada elektropleydka.
objectives: Fahmi mabaadi'da elektropleydka
Xukun korontada
Kormeer lakabka la dhigay

iron-electrochemical-corrosion.title: Karbaashida Elektrokiimikaadka ee Birta
iron-electrochemical-corrosion.description: Xalliga cusbitada (salt water / brine) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu muujiyo sida birtu (Fe) u nuugto oksijiinta oo ay u cararto, waxaana lagu daabacaa potassium hexacyanoferrate(III) (potassium ferricyanide) si loo eego batarida micro-ah ee karbaashida.
objectives: Garan karbaashida nuugida oksijiinta
Fahmi batarida micro-ah
Xidh fikrada ilaalinta biraha

sacrificial-anode.title: Hab-ilaalinta Anoodka Allwanaanshaha
sacrificial-anode.description: Xabo zinc ah ayaa birta (Fe) lala xidaa si loo gaabiso karbaasheeda, taasoo ka turjumaysa mabaadi'da ilaalinta kathoodka ee anoodka allwanaanshaha.
objectives: Fahmi ilaalinta kathoodka
Barbardhig xawaaraha karbaashida
Xidh fikrada ilaalinta doonyaha

gas-volume-measurement.title: Cabbirka Xajmiga Gaaska
gas-volume-measurement.description: Hab-cabirka biyaha-baakitaanka (water displacement) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu qiyaaso xajmiga carbon dioxide (CO₂) ee ka soo baxa falcelinta calcium carbonate iyo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl), si loo tababaro cabbiraadda tirada ah ee gaaska.
objectives: Ku canaanso hab-cabirka gaaska
Akhri xajmiga gaaska
Xisaabi tirada falcelinta

crystallization-purification.title: Nadiifinta Cusbitada Xoolaha
crystallization-purification.description: Cusbo (sodium chloride) oo dhoobo ku jirta ayaa loo nadiifiyaa dhalaalinayn, shaandheynayn, iyo dhalaalinta-buuxineed, si loo bartaabo hawlaha aasaasiga ah ee soocaanka isku-darka.
objectives: Ku canaanso hawsha shaandheynaynta
Ku canaanso dhalaalinta-buuxineedka
Fahmi mabda'a nadiifinta

electrolysis-water.title: Tijaabada Kala-qaybinta Biyaha
electrolysis-water.description: Biyuhu waxaa lagu kala-qaybiyaa xalliga aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo diiwaangashan; kathoodka ayaa soo saara gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas), anoodka ayaa soo saara ogsijiin (O₂), xajmigooduna yahay qiyaastii 2∶1.
objectives: Xaqiiji qaabka biyaha
Qor falcelinta cutubka
Cabir xad-dhafka xajmiga gaaska

electrolysis-nacl-solution.title: Kala-qaybinta Xalliga Cusbitada Dareenka leh
electrolysis-nacl-solution.description: Markaad kala-qaybiso xalliga sodium chloride (NaCl) oo dareeni ah, kathoodka ayaa soo saara gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas), anoodka ayaa soo saara gaaska chlorine (Cl₂), aagga kathoodkana waxaa ku samaysmaya sodium hydroxide (NaOH).
objectives: Garan warshadaha chlor-alkali
Qor falcelinta cutubka
Hubso aasaasiga aagga kathoodka

electrolysis-cucl2-solution.title: Kala-saarista Dareeraha copper(II) chloride
electrolysis-cucl2-solution.description: Marka dareeraha copper(II) chloride la kala saaro korontada, kathoodka ayaa soo saaraya naxaas (Cu) cas, anoodka ayaana soo daaya gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) oo midab huruud-cagaaran leh. Tijaabadani waxay caawisaa aqoonsiga waxyaabaha kala-saarista korontada.
objectives: Garan waxyaabaha soo baxa kala-saarista korontada
Qorid falcelinta elektiroodka
Daawasho muuqaalka labada electirood

copper-refining-electrolysis.title: Nadiifinta Naxaasta Korontada Iyada
copper-refining-electrolysis.description: Naxaasta xaashida ah (oo aan nadiifnayn) waxaa loo isticmaalaa anood, naxaastana nadiif ah waxaa loo isticmaalaa kathood si loo kala saaro xalliga copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄). Anoodka ayaa ku milma xalliga, kathoodka ayaana ku dhejiya naxaas (Cu) aad u nadiif ah.
objectives: Faham nadiifinta korontada iyada
Aqoonsi hilibka anoodka (anode mud)
Qorid falcelinta elektiroodka

electroplating-silver.title: Tijaabada Dahadhinta Lacagta (Silfarka)
electroplating-silver.description: Shayga la dahadhinayo waxaa loo isticmaalaa kathood, Lacag (silfar) ayaana loo isticmaalaa anood, xalligana wuxuu ka kooban yahay cusbitada silfarka. Tijaabadani waxay sharaxaysaa sida lakabka dahadhinta loo sameeyo.
objectives: Faham mabaadi'da dahadhinta
Xukun cufnaanta lakabka dahadhinta
Aqoonsi isticmaalka dahadhinta Lacagta (silfarka)

fruit-battery.title: Baytariyada Miraha
fruit-battery.description: Marka xaashi naxaas ah iyo xaashi zinc ah lagu galiyo miro sida liinta, waxaa la sameeystaa unug koronteed oo kicinaaya nalayaasha yaryar ama u sababaaya galvanomiter inuu leexdo.
objectives: Aqoonsi qaab-dhismeedka unugga koronteed (galvanic cell)
Garan dhinacyada positive iyo negative
Faham beddelka tamarta

daniell-cell.title: Unugga Koronteed ee Daniell
daniell-cell.description: Xaashi zinc ah ayaa lagu dhejiyaa zinc sulfate, xaashi naxaas ahna ayaa lagu dhejiyaa copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), labadana waxaa ku xidha buundada cusbitada (salt bridge) si loo samaystaa unug koronteed caanka ah, kadibna waxaa la qiyaasaa xoogga koronto-kicinta (EMF).
objectives: Aqoonsi unugga koronteed ee laba-dareerood ah
Faham hawsha buundada cusbitada (salt bridge)
Qiyaas xoogga koronto-kicinta (EMF)

iron-carbon-galvanic-corrosion.title: Cunsuridda Unugga Koronteed ee Bir-Carboon
iron-carbon-galvanic-corrosion.description: Marka bir (Fe) iyo carboon lagu daro aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid), waxaa la sameeystaa unug koronteed oo bir (Fe) ku shaqaynaysa anood, taasina waxay dedejisaa milmida birta. Tijaabadani waxay sharaxaysaa cunsuridda hydrogen-saarista ee xadidka.
objectives: Aqoonsi cunsuridda hydrogen-saarista
Faham unugga koronteed ee micro ah
Is-barbardhig xawaaraha cunsuridda

oxygen-absorption-corrosion.title: Baaritaanka Cunsuridda Ogsijiin-Nuugista ee Xadidka
oxygen-absorption-corrosion.description: Musmaaro bir ah ayaa lagu dhejiyaa xalliga cusbitada (salt water / brine) oo aan aashito lahayn, kadib muddo ka dib, dareeraha ku jira tuubo gaadhsiinta gaaska ayaa kor u kacaya, taasina waxay caddeynaysaa in cunsuridda ogsijiin-nuugista ay isticmaasho ogsijiin (O₂).
objectives: Aqoonsi cunsuridda ogsijiin-nuugista
Is-barbardhig cunsuridda hydrogen-saarista
Xidh xidhiidhka ilaalinta biraha

impressed-current-protection.title: Ilaalinta Kathoodka Korontada Dibadda Laga Keenay
impressed-current-protection.description: Shayga bir (Fe) ah ee la ilaalinayo waxaa lala xidha dhinaca negative ee ilaha korontada tooska ah (DC), anoodna waxaa loo isticmaalaa maaddada inert ah oo lagu daayo koronto, si birtu aanay cunsurin.
objectives: Faham ilaalinta korontada dibadda laga keenay
Is-barbardhig habka anoodka la huriyo (sacrificial anode)
Xidh xidhiidhka ilaalinta tuubooyinka

dry-cell-dissection.title: Baaritaanka Dhismaha Baatarida Engegan
dry-cell-dissection.description: Waxaa la bixiyaa baatarida zinc-manganese ee engegan si loo baaro; waxaa lagu gartaa kutubta zinc ee anoodka taban, usha kaarboonka (carbon rod) ee katoodka togan, iyo cajiinka elektirooleedka, si loo fahmo mabda'a baatarida hal-isticmaalka ah.
objectives: Garan dhismaha baatarida engegan
Aqoonsiga maaddooyinka anoodka iyo katoodka
Fahmida baatarida hal-isticmaalka ah

electrolysis-electrode-products.title: Baaritaanka Badeecadaha Elektiroodka Inert-ka ah
electrolysis-electrode-products.description: Waxaa la kala elektrolise-garaa xalaalada sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄), potassium nitrate (KNO₃), iyo kuwa la mid ah; waxaa litmus lagu hubiyaa isbeddelka aashitooyinka iyo asalka labada qudhunba, si loo soo koobo nidaamka kharashka ioniga.
objectives: Soo koobida nidaamka kharashka ioniga
Hubinta badeecadaha labada qudhuun
Qorista falcelinta elektiroodka

conductivity-electrolyte.title: Gudbinta Korontada Xalaalada Elektirooleedka
conductivity-electrolyte.description: Waxaa qalabka gudbinta korontada (electrical conductivity apparatus) lagu barbar dhigaa gudbinta korontada xalaalada sodium chloride (NaCl), aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl), iyo Sukroos, si loo garto elektiroleetka iyo aan-elektiroleetka.
objectives: Kala soocida elektiroleetka
Garanshaha gudbinta ioniga ee korontada
Barbar dhigida iftiinka laambadaha

molten-salt-electrolysis.title: Elektrolisiska Milicsan ee Sodium Chloride (NaCl)
molten-salt-electrolysis.description: Waxaa heer-kulul sare lagu elektrolise-garaa sodium chloride (NaCl) ee milicsan; katoodka waxaa laga helaa birta sodium (sodium metal), anoodkana waxaa ka soo baxa gaaska chlorine (Cl₂), si loo fahmo habka refinaynta biraha firfircoon.
objectives: Garanshaha elektrolisiska milicsan
Fahmida refinaynta sodium
Qorista falcelinta elektiroodka

aluminum-electrolysis.title: Refinaynta Aluminium-ka Adoo Elektrolise-garaaya Aluminiyam ooksiid
aluminum-electrolysis.description: Waxaa la elektrolise-garaa Aluminiyam ooksiid ee milicsan (cryolite (Na₃AlF₆) oo u adeegta dhaliye), katoodka waxaa ka soo baxa aluminium, anoodkana kaarboonka waxaa lagu shubo oksijiin, si loo fahmo refinaynta warshadaha aluminium.
objectives: Garanshaha refinaynta aluminium
Fahmida doorka cryolite (Na₃AlF₆)
Qorista falcelinta elektiroodka

lead-acid-battery.title: Baaritaanka Baatarida Rasaas-Aashito
lead-acid-battery.description: Waxaa la baaraa isbeddelada maaddada elektiroodka iyo xoojinta aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) xilliga shidaalinta iyo shuqulinta baatarida rasaasta (lead), si loo fahmo baatarida dib-u-shuqulinta ah.
objectives: Garanshaha baatarida dib-u-shuqulinta ah
Fahmida mabda'a shidaalinta iyo shuqulinta
Xiriirinta baatarida baabuurta

concentration-cell.title: Unugga Korontada ee Kala-Xoojiinta
concentration-cell.description: Laba elektirood lacag ah (silver electrode) ayaa lagu dhex gelin karaa xalaalado silver nitrate (AgNO₃) oo kala xoog duwan, kuwaas oo ay buundada cusbitada (salt bridge) isku xiddo, si ay u soo saarto faragelin korontadeed, loona fahmo unugga korontada ee kala-xoojiinta.
objectives: Garanshaha unugga korontada ee kala-xoojiinta
Fahmida saamaynta xoojiinta ee korontada
Cabbirida xoogga kiniiniga

electrolysis-copper-anode.title: Barbar Dhigida Elektiroodka Firfircoon
electrolysis-copper-anode.description: Waxaa la barbar dhigaa farqiga u dhexeeya elektrolisiska copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) adoo isticmaalaya anood naxaas (Cu) iyo anood kaarboon ah, si loo fahmo sida elektiroodka firfircoon uu uga qaybgalayo falcelinta.
objectives: Kala soocida elektiroodka inert-ka ah iyo kan firfircoon
Barbar dhigida falcelinta anoodka
Qorista xisaabaadka falcelinta elektiroodka

faraday-electrolysis-quantitative.title: Tijaabada xisaabinta elektrolysis ee Faraday
faraday-electrolysis-quantitative.description: Waxaa la elektrolaysiiyaa xal copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) kadibna waxaa la miisaamaa culayska kordhay ee kathoodka, si loo xaqiijiyo in cufnaanta naxaasta (Cu) la soo saartay ay la xiriirto xadka korontada la gudbiyay.
objectives: Xaqiijinta sharciga Faraday
Cabbirka tirada la soo saartay
Xisaabinta wareejinta elektaroonada

galvanic-metal-comparison.title: Go'aaminta qudhunka iyo qiyaasta unugga galvanic
galvanic-metal-comparison.description: Macdanno kala duwan ayaa lagu daraa aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la dhaafiyay si loo dhiso unug galvanic ah, halkaasoo jihada leexashada galvanomiter loo isticmaalo in la go'aamiyo macdanta firfircoon ee u ah qudhunka taban.
objectives: Go'aaminta qudhunka iyo qiyaasta
Xiriirka firfircoonida macdanta
Fahamka jihada socodka elektaroonada

hydrogen-oxygen-fuel-cell.title: Unugga shidaalka hydrogen-oksijiin
hydrogen-oxygen-fuel-cell.description: Gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) ayaa loo isticmaalaa qudhunka taban, ogsijiin (O₂) qudhunka wanaagsan, halkaasoo unugga shidaalka la dhiso gudaha xal potassium hydroxide si ay nalka yar u iftiimiso.
objectives: Barashada unugga shidaalka
Qorista falcelinta qudhunka
Fahamka hufnaanta iyo nadiifnimada

electrochemical-etching.title: Jiriitaanka birta hab elektrokimikaali ah
electrochemical-etching.description: Qayb bireed ayaa loo isticmaalaa anoodka oo lagu xidaa korontada, gudaha elektroleet sodium chloride (NaCl), si birta si xulid leh ugu dhalaasho oo jiriitaanku si saxsan u dhaco.
objectives: Fahamka dhalaashada anoodka
Barashada farsamada elektrolysis
Xukumida aagga la jiriitaanayo

anodizing-aluminum.title: Oxidation anoodka aluminium
anodizing-aluminum.description: Qayb aluminium ah ayaa loo isticmaalaa anoodka gudaha aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la dhaafiyay, oo korontada la siiyay, si dareerta weyn ee Aluminiyam ooksiid uga samaysmato dusha, taasoo kordhisa adkaysiga xumowga iyo awoodda midabaynta.
objectives: Barashada oxidation-ka anoodka
Fahamka kordhista lakabka oksiidhka
Xiriirka daaweynta dusha aluminium

silver-electrolytic-cleaning.title: Soo celinta lacagta kloriidhka iyadoo la isticmaalayo elektrolysis
silver-electrolytic-cleaning.description: Lacag (silfar) madoobaatay iyo warqadda aluminium (aluminium foil) ayaa lagu dhigaa xal kulul sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) si loo dhiso unug galvanic ah, kaas oo silver sulfide (Ag₂S) ku beddelaa Lacag (silfar) safi ah.
objectives: Barashada soo celinta unugga galvanic
Fahamka mabda'a xakamaynta sadaamka
Xiriirka isticmaalka nolosha maalinlaha ah

electrolysis-ki-solution.title: Elektrolysis-ka xalka potassium iodide (KI)
electrolysis-ki-solution.description: Marka la elektrolaysiyo xal potassium iodide (KI), anoodka ayaa keena iodine (I₂) oo xabag (xoogaa) u beddelaysa midab buluug, halka kathoodka uu soo saaro gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) oo phenolphthalein cas u galaayo, taasoo si cad u muujinaysa wax soo saarka labada qudhun.
objectives: Go'aaminta wax soo saarka elektrolysis
Hubinta iodine (I₂) ee anoodka
Hubinta aasaasiga kathoodka

silver-ammonia-complex-dissolve.title: Xalinta lacagta kloriidhka ee xal ammoniya ah iyo soo celintaeda aashito nitric ah
silver-ammonia-complex-dissolve.description: Gu'uurka cad ee lacagta kloriidhka (silver chloride) marka lagu daro xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) ayuu ku dhalaanshaa isaga oo sameynaya ion-ka muraayadaha silver-ammoniya, marka dib lagu daro aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) ayaa mar kale gu'uurku soo noqdaa.
objectives: Barashada xalinta isuduwidda
Fahamka xasilloonida ion-ka muraayadaha
Daawashada dhalaanshaha iyo soo noqoshada gu'uurka

copper-ammonia-deep-blue.title: copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) iyo xal ammoniya ah oo xad dhaafaya
copper-ammonia-deep-blue.description: Marka xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) lagu daro xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), markii hore waxaa soo baxa falaggayn buluug ah; marka xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) xad dhaafto, falaggaynta waxay ku milantaa iyo la samaysaa ion-ka naxaas-amooniya ee buluug-mudow ah.
objectives: La socod falcelinta horeba falaggaynta ka dib milanaanta
Aqoonsi ion-ka naxaas-amooniya (copper-ammonia complex ion)
Faham dheelitirka xiriirka koordineeshanka (ligand equilibrium)

agi-ammonia-insoluble.title: Barbar-dhigga milanaanta lacagta kloriidhka, silver bromide (AgBr), iyo Silfar(I) aayodiiد ee xal ammoniya ah
agi-ammonia-insoluble.description: Waxaa la barbardhigaa milanaanta lacagta kloriidhka (silver chloride), silver bromide (AgBr), iyo Silfar(I) aayodiiد marka la geliyo xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood), si loo fahmо xeerka isbeddelka qiimaha lahjadda milanaanta (Ksp) ee halide-yada silfarka.
objectives: Barbardhig milanaanta xaaladaha kala duwan
La xiriir qiimaha Ksp
Faham tartanka xiriirka koordineeshanka

nickel-dimethylglyoxime.title: Tijaabinta nickel adoo isticmaalaya dimethylglyoxime (C₄H₈N₂O₂)
nickel-dimethylglyoxime.description: Ion-yada nickel waxay la falceliyaan dimethylglyoxime (C₄H₈N₂O₂) xaaladaha qaacidda ah ee khafiif ah, waxayna soo saaraan falaggayn chelate oo cas oo iftiimaysa, taasoo ah tijaabinta calaamadeed ee nickel.
objectives: Aqoonsi midabka chelate
Ku xirfadeyso tijaabinta nickel
Faham reagent-yada gaarka ah ee tijaabinta

fe3-salicylic-acid.title: Falcelinta midabka bir (Fe)(III) iyo Aasidda saalikiilik
fe3-salicylic-acid.description: Ion-yada bir (Fe) waxay la falceliyaan Aasidda saalikiilik si ay u sameeyaan xariir-ururiye (complex) oo casaan-geel ah; tirada xiriirka koordineeshanka iyo midabka waxay isbeddelaan pH-ka, oo loo isticmaalo cabbirka midabka si loo ogaado bir (Fe).
objectives: Daawado midabka xiriirka koordineeshanka
Faham saamaynta pH
La xiriir falanqaynta midabka (colorimetric analysis)

cobalt-thiocyanate-test.title: Tijaabinta cobalt adoo isticmaalaya ammonium thiocyanate (NH₄SCN)
cobalt-thiocyanate-test.description: Ion-yada cobalt waxay la falceliyaan ammonium thiocyanate (NH₄SCN) acetone gudihiis si ay u sameeyaan ion buluug ah oo xiriir leh, oo loo isticmaalo ogaanshaha iyo aqoonsiga cobalt.
objectives: Aqoonsi ion-yada cobalt ee xiriir leh
Ku xirfadeyso tijaabinta cobalt
Barbardhig midabka falcelinta bir (Fe) ee thiocyanate

tetraamminecopper-crystal.title: Diyaarinta crystalka tetraamminecopper(II) sulfate
tetraamminecopper-crystal.description: Marka ethanol (C₂H₅OH) lagu daro xalka naxaas-amooniya, milanaantu way yaraataa, crystalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) tetraamine ah ee buluug-mudow ah waa soo baxa.
objectives: Diyaari crystalka xiriir-uruuriyaha (complex compound)
Faham daaha crystalka adoo yaraynaya milanaanta
Aqoonsi qaab-dhismeedka xiriir-uruuriyaha

fe-scn-concentration-color.title: Xiriirka u dhexeeya xoogga iyo midabka falcelinta bir (Fe)-thiocyanate
fe-scn-concentration-color.description: Marka xoogga ion-yada bir (Fe) ama thiocyanate la beddelo, waxaa la daawadaa isbeddelka qoto-dheeraanta guduudka ion-ka thiocyanatoiron complex, si loo fahmо dheelitirka koordineeshanka.
objectives: Daawado qoto-dheeraanta midabka
Faham saamaynta xoogga
La xiriir cabbirka midabka tiradda (quantitative colorimetry)

zinc-ammonia-complex.title: Samaysemida ion-ka zinc-ammonia complex
zinc-ammonia-complex.description: Marka xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) lagu daro xalka zinc sulfate, markii hore waxaa soo baxa falaggayn cad oo ah sinkyga hiidrooksaydka (zinc hydroxide); marka xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) xad dhaafto, falaggaynta waxay ku milantaa xalka, oo la samayso ion-ka zinc-ammonia complex.
objectives: Daawado milanaanta falaggaynta
Aqoonsi ion-ka zinc-ammonia complex
Barbardhig koordineeshanka naxaas iyo zinc

aluminum-hydroxide-amphoteric-complex.title: Laba-dhinacnimada iyo Xiriirka Aluminiyam hаydrooksiid
aluminum-hydroxide-amphoteric-complex.description: Aluminiyam hаydrooksiid waxay ku dhex milmaa aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) iyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH) xad-dhaafka ah labadaba, isagoo ka sameeya qaacidada aluminate, taasoo tilmaamaysa hydroxide laba-dhinac ah.
objectives: Garan laba-dhinacnimada hydroxide
Faham sida xiriirku u dhalisaa milmida
Qor labada nooc oo macaadil kimiyeed

chromium-color-states.title: Xaaladaha Midabka Badan ee Chromium
chromium-color-states.description: La eeg sida potassium dichromate uu u bedelo midabka oranji iyo jaalle marka pH-ku is-beddelo, taasoo muujinaysa dheelitirnaanta chromate-dichromate.
objectives: La eeg isbeddelka midabka oranji iyo jaalle
Faham dheelitirnaanta qaacidooyinka chromate
Gaar ahaan gado saamaynta pH

copper-chloride-complex-color.title: Isbeddelka Midabka Xiriirka Chloro-naxaas (Cu)
copper-chloride-complex-color.description: Marka hydrochloric acid dhumuc badan (concentrated hydrochloric acid) lagu daro xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), ayaa xiriir chloro-naxaas oo midabkiisu yahay jaalle-cagaaran samaysma, laakiin marka la nadiifiyo biyaha ayuu dib ugu noqdaa buluug.
objectives: La eeg midabka xiriirka
Faham beddelka ligand
Xidh xiriirka cobalt(II) chloride dheelitirnaantiisa

starch-iodine-complex.title: Midabka Xiriirka Xabag (xoogaa)-iodine (I₂)
starch-iodine-complex.description: iodine (I₂) ay la samaysaa xabag (xoogaa) waxay abuuraan xiriir buluug ah, kaas oo midabkiisu baaba'o marka la kululeeyo oo dib u soo noqdo marka la qaboojiyiyo, taasoo muujinaysa falcelinta midab-muujinta ee soo-noqnoqota.
objectives: La eeg abuurista xiriirka buluuga ah
Faham sida midab-muujintu u soo-noqoto
Ku xidh tijaabooyinka ogaanshaha iodine (I₂)

silver-ammonia-fresh-prep.title: Habka Saxda ah ee Diyaarinta Xalka Silver-Ammonia
silver-ammonia-fresh-prep.description: Xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) ayaa tali-tali loogu daraa silver nitrate (AgNO₃) ilaa dareeraha uu si buuxda u milmo, si loo helo xal silver-ammonia oo cad, kuwaas oo la xusay in la isticmaalo isla markiiba lagu diyaariyo.
objectives: Ku caawishan diyaarinta saxda ah
Faham muhiimadda xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) ee ku filan
Gaar ahaan gado waxyeelada ka timid kaydin dheer

fe3-fluoride-masking.title: Fluoride oo Daboosho bir (Fe)(III)
fe3-fluoride-masking.description: Marka soodyam flarooriid (sodium fluoride) lagu daro xalka thiocyanate-bir oo casaan ah, ayaa xiriir bir-fluoride oo adag oo ka xoog badan samaysma, taasoo midabka casaanka ka maqnaanaysa.
objectives: Faham tartanka xiriirka
Gaar ahaan gado daboosaha (masking agent)
Is-bar xiriirka xooggiisa

copper-edta-complex.title: Xiriirka naxaas (Cu)-EDTA
copper-edta-complex.description: Marka EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) lagu daro xalka buluuga ah ee copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), ayaa xiriir naxaas (Cu)-EDTA oo xoog badan samaysma, kaas oo loo isticmaalo titrasyoonka xiriirka.
objectives: Gaar ahaan gado xiriirka EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid)
Faham xiriirka 1∶1
Ku xidh titrasyoonka xiriirka

calcium-carbonate-hardness-titration.title: Titrasyoonka Xiriirka ee Adkaanta Biyaha
calcium-carbonate-hardness-titration.description: Xal EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) ah oo heerka la garanayo ayaa lagu isticmaalaa titrasyoonka muunada biyaha, iyada oo Eriochrome Black T loo adeegsado calaamadda, si loo qiyaaso wadarta calcium iyo magnesium, taasoo caddaynaysa adkaanta guud ee biyaha.
objectives: Qiyaas adkaanta guud ee biyaha
Ku caawishan gaarsiinta dhammaadka
Xisaabi qiimaha adkaanta

nickel-ammonia-complex.title: Sameynta Nickel-Ammonia Complex Ion
nickel-ammonia-complex.description: Marka xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) oo xad dhaaf ah lagu daro xalka nickel(II) chloride, midabku wuxuu ka bedelaa cagaar ilaa buluug-guduud, taasoo muujinaysa sameysamay nickel-ammonia complex ion. Tijaabadani waxay baraysa xiriirka laxaadka ee niikal.
objectives: U fiirso isbedelka midabka
Garo nickel-ammonia complex ion
Barbardhig xiriirka laxaadka ee niikal iyo naxaas (Cu)

hexacyanoferrate-color.title: Xasilloonida Bir-Cyanide Complex Ions
hexacyanoferrate-color.description: Barbardhig midabka xalka botaasiyamka ferrosayanaaydka (potassium ferrocyanide / potassium hexacyanoferrate(II)) iyo xalka potassium hexacyanoferrate(III) (potassium ferricyanide), si loo fahmo labada nooc ee cyanide complex ions ee bir (Fe) iyo xaaladooda oxidation.
objectives: Kala saaro labada complex ion
Xidh xiriirka u dhexeeya oxidation state-ka bir (Fe) iyo complex ions-ka
Garo xasilloonida complex ions

turnbull-blue.title: Sameynta Turnbull's Blue
turnbull-blue.description: Marka Fe²⁺ ions ay ku falgeliso potassium hexacyanoferrate(III) (potassium ferricyanide), waxaa samaasama raashin buluug ah oo loo yaqaan Turnbull's blue, kaas oo loo adeegsado baaritaanka Fe²⁺ ions.
objectives: Baari Fe²⁺ ions adoo adeegsanaya dallacsiinta muuqaalka
Barbardhig Turnbull's blue iyo Prussian blue
Garo complex ion precipitation

cobalt-ammonia-oxidation.title: Oxidation-ka Kobalt-Ammonia Complex Ion
cobalt-ammonia-oxidation.description: Co(II)-ammonia complex ion marka uu hawada ku jiro waxaa lagu oxidation-gareeyaa si loo sameeyo Co(III)-ammonia complex ion oo xasillo leh oo midabkiisu yahay oranjo-jaale, taasoo muujinaysa sida laxaadku u xasilleeyo xaaladda oxidation ee sare.
objectives: Daawoo isbedelka midabka oxidation-ka sabab u ah
Faham sida laxaadku u xasilleeyo xaaladda oxidation ee sare
Garo kobalt complex compounds

ferric-phenol-purple.title: Midabka Guduudan ee Bir(III) iyo Phenol
ferric-phenol-purple.description: Marka xalka phenol lagu daro iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃), waxaa samaasama xidid midab guduud ah, taasoo loo adeegsado baaritaanka kooxda phenol hydroxyl iyo bir (Fe) ions.
objectives: Daawoo sameynta midabka guduudan
Baari kooxda phenol hydroxyl
Garo iron-phenol complex

ammonium-chloride-hydrolysis.title: Hydrolysis-ka Xalka Ammonium Chloride (NH₄Cl)
ammonium-chloride-hydrolysis.description: Qiyaas pH-ka xalka ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) oo adeegsada litmus si aad u baarto sida milixda aashitada xoogga leh ee saldhiga daciifka ah ay hydrolysis ugu sababeyso in xalku noqdo aashito.
objectives: Faham sababta milixda aashitada xoogga leh ee saldhiga daciifka ah ay aashito ugu beddelo marka hydrolysis dhacdo
Baaro sida muujiyayaasha loo adeegsado si loo go'aamiyo dabeecadda aashito-saldhig ee xalka
Qor ionic equation-ka hydrolysis

washing-soda-alkalinity.title: Dabeecadda Saldhig ee Xalka Sodium Carbonate (Na₂CO₃)
washing-soda-alkalinity.description: Marka phenolphthalein lagu daro xalka sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃), midabku wuxuu noqdaa casaan, taasoo muujinaysa in sodium carbonate uu sabab u yahay saldhig hydrolysis darteed, kaas oo sidoo kale ka caawiya nadiifinta dheecaanka.
objectives: Garo sida milixda saldhiga xoogga leh ee aashitada daciifka ah ay saldhig ugu beddelo hydrolysis darteed
Daawoo isbedelka midabka phenolphthalein
Xidh xiriirka u dhexeeya dabeecadda kiimikada iyo isticmaalka maalinlaha ah ee sodium carbonate

acetate-salt-basicity.title: Baaritaanka Dabeecadda Saldhig ee Xalka Sodium Acetate
acetate-salt-basicity.description: Marka aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) iyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH) ay falgeliyaan waxaa samaasama sodium acetate, ka dibna marka phenolphthalein lagu daro waxay noqotaa casaan, taasoo xaqiijinaysa in milixda saldhiga xoogga leh ee aashitada daciifka ah ay hydrolysis darteed saldhig noqoto.
objectives: Faham sharciga hydrolysis ee milixda saldhiga xoogga leh ee aashitada daciifka ah
Qiimee sifooyinka waxyaabaha ka samaasama neutralization ka dib
Qor sodium acetate hydrolysis equation

methyl-orange-transition-range.title: Cabbirka Isbedelka Midabka Methyl Orange
methyl-orange-transition-range.description: Isbedelka saamiga u dhexeeya aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) iyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH) ayaa si tartiib tartiib ah loo sameyaa, lana raacaa u gudubka methyl orange ee cas ilaa jaalle, si loo go'aamiyo xadka isbedelka midabka.
objectives: Garan xadka isbedelka midabka methyl orange
Fahami dabeecadda aasaasiga ah ee isbedelka midabka tilmaamaha
Baranow xulashada tilmaamaha ku salaysan pH

phenolphthalein-transition-range.title: Daawashada Xadka Isbedelka Midabka Phenolphthalein
phenolphthalein-transition-range.description: Xalal kala duwan oo pH ah oo ka kooban sodium hydroxide (NaOH) iyo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) ayaa lagu ilaaliyaa isbedelka phenolphthalein ee midab la'aanta ilaa guduudka, si loo garto isbedelkeeda ee gobolka aasaasiga ah ee daciifka ah.
objectives: Fahmo xadka midab-bedelka phenolphthalein
Is barbar dhig shuruudaha ku habboon ee tilmaameyaasha kala duwan
Go'aami aashitnimada ama aasaasiga xalka

strong-acid-weak-base-titration.title: Titration Aasidda Xoogga leh ee Aasaasiga Daciifka ah
strong-acid-weak-base-titration.description: Xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) ayaa lagu titraa aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) caadiga ah; maadaama dhamaadka tilmaamaha uu muujiyo aashitanimo, methyl orange ayaa loo doortaa tilmaame, si loo bartoo xulashada tilmaamaha ee titration aasidda xoogga leh iyo aasaasiga daciifka ah.
objectives: Fahami sababta dhamaadka titration aasidda xoogga leh ee aasaasiga daciifka ah uu u leeyahay aashitanimo
Fahmo aasaaska doorashada tilmaamaha
Xisaabi xoogga xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood)

weak-acid-strong-base-titration.title: Xulashada Tilmaamaha ee Titration Aasidda Daciifka ah
weak-acid-strong-base-titration.description: Aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) ayaa lagu titraa sodium hydroxide (NaOH); maadaama dhamaadka uu muujiyo aasaasiga, phenolphthalein ayaa loo doortaa tilmaame, si loo fahmo aasaaska xulashada tilmaamaha ee titration aasidda daciifka ah iyo aasaasiga xoogga leh.
objectives: Garan sababta dhamaadka titration aasidda daciifka ah iyo aasaasiga xoogga leh uu u leeyahay aasaasiga
Habee hawlgalka tuubada titraashada
Falanqee khaladaadka dhamaadka

back-titration-carbonate.title: Cabirka Calcium Carbonate Adoo Isticmaalaya Dib-u-Titration
back-titration-carbonate.description: Calcium carbonate ayaa marka hore lala falceliyaa aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) oo xad dhaaf ah, kadibna sodium hydroxide (NaOH) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu dib-u-titraa aashidda kharashka ah; methyl orange ayaa tilmaamaya dhamaadka, si loo go'aamiyo qadarka calcium carbonate.
objectives: Fahmo mabaadi'da titraashada dib-u-celinta iyo xaaladaha ay ku haboon tahay
Samee xisaabaadka laba-tallaaboodka ah ee tiradda
Falanqee isha khaladaadka

phosphoric-acid-stepwise-titration.title: Titration Tallaabo-tallaabeedka ah ee Aasidda Foosforik
phosphoric-acid-stepwise-titration.description: Aasidda foosforik ayaa lagu titraa sodium hydroxide (NaOH), lana raacaa labada booddo oo lagu muujiyo methyl orange iyo phenolphthalein, si loo garto diyaarinta tallaabada kala duwan ee diyaaridda aasidda saddex-aasaasiga ah ee daciifka ah.
objectives: Fahami kala bixinta tallaabada kala duwan iyo diyaarinta aasidda polyprotic ee daciifka ah
Aqoonsi labada boodo ee kala duwan ee xariiqda titration
Xisaabi xajmiga diyaarinta heerarka kala duwan

carbonate-double-indicator.title: Cabbirka Sodium Carbonate (Na₂CO₃) Adoo Isticmaalaya Laba Tilmaame
carbonate-double-indicator.description: Aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in si tallaabo-tallaabo ah loogu titraa sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃); phenolphthalein iyo methyl orange ayaa isku xigxiga tilmaamaya laba dhamaadood, si loo cabbiro tiradda diyaarinta tallaabada kala duwan.
objectives: Fahmo mabaadi'da titraashada talaabada leh ee laba-tilmaamood
Kala sooc natiijada labada dhamaadood ee kala duwan
Xisaabi qadarka sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃)

common-ion-ammonia.title: Baaritaanka Saameynta Ion-ka Wadaagga ah
common-ion-ammonia.description: Marka ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) lagu daro xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) oo lagu daray phenolphthalein, midabka guduudka ayaa fududaada, taas oo muujinaysa in saameynta ion-ka wadaagga ah ay xanibayso kala bixinta xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood).
objectives: Fahami saameynta ion-ka wadaagga ah
Falanqee jihada guurida dheelitirka kala bixinta
Sharax sababta fududaanshaha midabka

ammonia-weak-base.title: Asaasiga Daciifka ah ee Xal Ammoniya
ammonia-weak-base.description: pH-ga xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) iyo Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد oo isla xoogga leh ayaa la barbar dhigaa, si loo fahmo sida xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) si qayb ahaan u kala goosato ionada, taasoo ka dhigaysa asaas daciif ah.
objectives: Kala sooca asaasiga xooggan iyo asaasiga daciifka
Fahmo sida elektrolyte daciifku si qayb ahaan u kala goosado ionada
Sharax sababta farqiga pH

so2-alkali-absorption.title: Falcelinta Sulfur Dioxide iyo Asaasiga
so2-alkali-absorption.description: Sulfur dioxide ayaa lagu gudbinaayaa Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد si loogu nuugsado, markaasna litmus ayaa loo isticmaalaa xaqiijinta in oxide aashitadu falcelin la gashay asaasiga.
objectives: Gaar u yaqaan falcelinta oxide aashitada iyo asaasiga
Fahmo mabaadi'da nuugista dambiga gaaska
Qor macaamilada kiimikada

carbonic-acid-acidity.title: Baadhinaynta Aashitanimada Carbonic Acid
carbonic-acid-acidity.description: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) ayaa lagu gudbinaayaa biyo distilled ah oo ay ku jirto litmus, midabkuna wuxuu noqdaa guduud; markaad kululeysid ayuu midabku dib u baaba'aa, taasoo muujinaysa in carbonic acid ay tahay aashito daciif ah oo aan xasillooneyn.
objectives: Fahmo sida anhydride aashitadu biyaha ugu milmayso si loo sameeyo aashito
Gaar u yaqaan aashitanimada daciifka iyo xaaladda aan xasillooneynta ee carbonic acid
Sharax sababta midabku ugu baaba'o markaad kululeysid

magnesium-oxide-acid.title: Falcelinta Magnesium Oxide iyo Aashitada
magnesium-oxide-acid.description: Magnesium oxide (MgO) oo cad ah ayaa ku milma aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) si loo sameeyo xal magnesium chloride, taasoo muujinaysa falcelinta dhex marta oxide asaasiga iyo aashitada.
objectives: Gaar u yaqaan falcelinta oxide asaasiga iyo aashitada
Daawo sida walaxda adag u milmayso
Qor macaamilada kiimikada

bicarbonate-acid-salt.title: Sifooyinka Sodium Bicarbonate Aashitada Milixda
bicarbonate-acid-salt.description: pH-ga xalka sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) ayaa la cabbiraa, kaasoo muujinaya asaasiga daciifka; markuu la falceliyo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) ayaa gas soo baxa, taasoo muujinaysa hydrolysis iyo sifooyinka laba-geesoodka ee milixda aashitada.
objectives: Fahmo aashitanimada iyo asaasanimada xalka milixda aashitada
Daawso muujinta gaasku maruu falcelin dhaco oo aashito ah
Bar-bar dhig sifooyinka sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) iyo sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃)

dilution-ionization-degree.title: Biyeynta iyo Heerka Ionization
dilution-ionization-degree.description: Biyo distilled ah ayaa si tartiib ah loogu daraa aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) heerarkeedana pH la cabbiraa; natiijadu waxay muujineysaa in xoogga yaryaraanshaha uu koreeyo heerka ionization, taasoo caddaynaysa dhaqdhaqaaqa jaaqa ionization ee aashitada daciifka.
objectives: Fahmo xiriirka u dhexeeya pH iyo heerka ionization
Fairi saamaynta biyeyntu ku yeelaneyso jaaqa ionization
Sharax xeerarka biyeynta aashitada daciifka

h2-flammability-purity.title: Hubinta Nadiifnimada iyo Gubidda Gaaska Hydrogen
h2-flammability-purity.description: Graniyuulada zinc ayaa lala falcelinaayaa aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) si loo soo saaro gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas); marka hore tuubo tijaabo yar ayaa loo isticmaalaa hubinta nadiifnimada (cod qaraar oo adag baa laga maqlaa), markaasna markuu nadiif noqdo ayaa la shidaa dabku, oo muujiya olol buluug-cad ah.
objectives: Ku xirfad bixi habka hubinta nadiifnimada gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas)
Daawso olosha degdegga ah ee buluug-caddaan ah ee gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas)
Fahmo muhiimadda hubinta nadiifnimada ka hor shidista gaas qarxa kara

h2-reduce-cuo.title: Hydrogen oo Dhimaya Copper(II) Oxide
h2-reduce-cuo.description: Gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) oo engegan ayaa laga gudubiyaa copper(II) oxide oo la kululeeyo; walaxda adag ayaa ka beddeshaa midab madow ilaa guduud, tuubbadana dhinaceeda afka ah ayaa biyo ka soo baxa, taasoo muujinaysa awood dhimista gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas).
objectives: Xaqiiji awooda dhimista ee gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas)
Daawso isbedelka midabka markuu copper(II) oxide u rogmado naxaas (Cu)
Ku xirfad bixi habka shaqada: marka hore gaaska gudbi markaasna kuleyl sii, marka hore laambadda qaad markaasna gaaska jooji

h2-from-aluminum.title: Samaynta gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) adigoo isticmaalaya aluminium iyo Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد
h2-from-aluminum.description: Xaashi aluminium ah ayaa lala falceliyaa Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد si loo soo saaro gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas). Tijaabadani waxay muujinaysaa sida biraha firfircoon ay kula falceliyaan labadaba aashitooyinka iyo asaasyada xooggan.
