objectives: Ku bartid sida biraha iyo asaasyada ay ugu sameeyaan gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas)
Barbardhig sida aluminium ula falceliyaa aashitooyinka marka loo eego sida uu ula falceliyaa asaasyada
Xoojin ururinta gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) hab-biyoodka (displacement method)

o2-from-kmno4.title: Kala-saarista ogsijiin (O₂) adigoo kuleylaya potassium permanganate (KMnO₄)
o2-from-kmno4.description: Kulaylinta potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) ayaa keenta kala-saarista ogsijiin (O₂). Tijaabadani waxay baraysa qalab kuleylinta walxaha adag iyo ururinta gaaska hab-biyoodka, iyadoo xabo qori oo dhalaal leh loo isticmaalo cabbiraadda.
objectives: Ku bartid sida ogsijiin (O₂) looga soo saaro walxaha adag marka la kuleyliyaa
Fahmi sababta tuubo tijaabo ay afkeeda ugu laabantahay dhinac yar oo hoos ah iyo howsha suuf (cotton wool) ka ciyaaraan
Barad ururinta ogsijiin (O₂) hab-biyoodka iyo sida loo cabbiro

o2-iron-combustion.title: Gubashada xadhig birta (Fe) ogsijiin (O₂) gudihiis
o2-iron-combustion.description: Ogsijiin (O₂) ayaa laga soo saaraa hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) iyadoo la isticmaalayo manganese(IV) oxide (MnO₂) oo ah kaatalayst. Xadhig birta (Fe) ayaa lagu xidaa malqacadda gubashada oo dhalo uruurinta gaaska lagu riixaa, si loo arko dhalaalka kacdoonsan iyo soo-saarka walx madow ah.
objectives: Xaqiiji awoodda ogsijiin (O₂) ee kicinta gubashada
Ogow sida xadhig birta (Fe) u gubto si kulul ogsijiin (O₂) nadiif ah gudihiis
Faham sababta dhanka hoose ee dhalo uruurinta gaaska loo buuxiyaa biyo ama ciid fin ah oo kala-baxsanaanta looga hortago

o2-magnesium-combustion.title: Gubashada xarig maqniisiyam ah ogsijiin (O₂) gudihiis oo gacanta lagu sameeyay
o2-magnesium-combustion.description: Ogsijiin (O₂) ayaa laga soo saaraa hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) iyadoo manganese(IV) oxide (MnO₂) loo isticmaalo kaatalayst ahaan. Xarig maqniisiyam ah ayaa la shidaa oo dhalo uruurinta gaaska lagu riixaa, si loo arko iftiinka cad ee iftiiminaya iyo soo-saarka walx cad ah.
objectives: Ogow sida xarig maqniisiyam ah u gubto si xoogan ogsijiin (O₂) gudihiis
Aqoonsi iftiinka cad ee iftiiminaya iyo kulaylka soo baxa markii magnesium uu gubanayo
Ogeysiis badbaadada ah oo ah in aan toos loo eegan iftiinka xooggan

o2-catalyst-comparison.title: Baadhitaanka kaatalaystka kala-saarista hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂)
o2-catalyst-comparison.description: Manganese(IV) oxide (MnO₂) iyo copper(II) oxide ayaa kala gaar ahaan lagu daraa hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂), kadibna la barbardhigaa xawliga soo-saarka ogsijiin (O₂), si loo baadho saamaynta kaatalaystka ee walxaha kala duwan.
objectives: Faham sida kaatalaystku u dedejiyaa xawliga falcelinta
Barbardhig saamaynta kaatalayst ee manganese(IV) oxide (MnO₂) marka loo eego copper(II) oxide
La qabso hab-raadraadinta kontaroolka doorsoomayaasha

co2-from-sodium-carbonate.title: Soo-saarka carbon dioxide (CO₂) adigoo isticmaalaya sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) iyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid)
co2-from-sodium-carbonate.description: Falcelinta sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) iyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) ayaa si degdeg ah u soo saarta carbon dioxide (CO₂). Falcelintu waxay ka kulul tahay walxaha adka ee qaabka xabadda ah, waana la cabbiri karaa Biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد) oo la isticmaalo.
objectives: Ku bartid sida kaarboonaatku ula falceliyaa aashitooyinka si loo soo saaro carbon dioxide (CO₂)
Barbardhig xawliga falcelinta kaarboonaatada kala duwan
Isticmaal Biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد) si aad u cabirto carbon dioxide (CO₂)

co2-react-naoh.title: Falcelinta carbon dioxide (CO₂) iyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH)
co2-react-naoh.description: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) ayaa lagu dhex mariiyaa Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد; hoos-u-dhaca cadaadiska gudaha dhalo-jilicsan ayaa keena in dhalo-jilicsan uu isu dul-dhaco ama muuqaalka burburada biyo ayaa tilmaamaya in falcelintu dhacday.
objectives: Xaqiiji falcelinta carbon dioxide (CO₂) iyo asaasyada
U isticmaal isbeddellada cadaadiska si aad uga go'aanto falcelinaha aan muuqaal cad lahayn
Faham sida xalka asaasyada uu u nuugsado gaasyada aashitada ah

co2-drying-purification.title: Nadiifinta iyo engejinta carbon dioxide (CO₂)
co2-drying-purification.description: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) laga soo saaro calcium carbonate iyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) waxaa ku jira aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) iyo uumi biyo. Marka hore waxaa loo gudbinaayaa xalka sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) oo dhumuc leh si aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) laga saaro, ka dibna waxaa loo engejiyaa aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated).
objectives: Faham xididka wasakhaha ku jira natiijada soo-saarka gaaska
Ku bartid isticmaalka dhalo nadiifinta gaaska si wasakhaha looga nadiifiyo iyo engejinta aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated)
Caddee jihada xidhmada saxda ah ee dhalo nadiifinta gaaska oo ah gal-dheer bax-gaaban

hcl-preparation.title: Samaynta Gaaska Hydrogen Chloride Sheybaarka
hcl-preparation.description: Gaaska hydrogen chloride waxaa lagu sameeya annagoo kuleylina sodium chloride (NaCl) adag iyo aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated), kadibna waxaa la arkaa cad-cad ka dhasha hawada qoyan, markaasaa biyo lagu dareysaa si loo helo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl).
objectives: Fahamka mabda'a ah ee aashitada aan ka bixin (non-volatile) oo loo isticmaalayo samaynta aashitada ka bixa (volatile)
Garan kalsoonida xoogga badan ee hydrogen chloride uu ku milma biyaha iyo astaantiisa aashidda
Barasho habka ururinta gaaske annagoo hawada ka saareyna oo kor u raacneyna (upward displacement of air)

nh3-from-ammonium-sulfate.title: Samaynta Gaaska Ammonia Annagoo Isticmaalaya Amooniyam sulfeет iyo Calcium Hydroxide
nh3-from-ammonium-sulfate.description: Amooniyam sulfeет iyo calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂) waa la isku dhafaa oo la kuleyliyaa si loo samaynto gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas); warqadda litmus ee cas (red litmus paper) oo qoyan ayaa loo isticmaalaa hubinta, waxaana la baranayaa sifo guud ee bilaashka ammonia ee kuleylinta cusbileyda amooniyam iyo xalka aashidda.
objectives: Bartid habka samaynta gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) annagoo reacshiga cusbileyda amooniyam iyo xaalufiyeyaasha (alkalis) isticmaalaya
Hubinta gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) annagoo isticmaalaya warqadda litmus ee cas (red litmus paper) oo qoyan
Fahanka sababta afka tuubo tijaabo loo hoos jeedinayo si looga hortago dib-u-socoshada biyaha qaboow ee ku soo dagi karta

nh3-tail-gas-absorption.title: Hubinta Gaaska Ammonia iyo Xannibaadda Gaaske Dhambe
nh3-tail-gas-absorption.description: Gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) waxaa lagu sameyaa annagoo kuleylina ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) iyo calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂); warqadda litmus oo qoyan ayaa loo isticmaalaa hubinta, halka tuubo gaadhsiinta gaaska dhambaasha ku xidhan tahay oo la soo dhowaynayo dusha biyo distilled ah si loo xannibaado oo looga hortago dib-u-socoshada.
objectives: Bartid hababka hubinta gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas)
Barasho habka xannibaadda gaaske si fudud uu ku milma biyaha
Fahanka sida ay u shaqeyso qalab ka hortagga dib-u-socoshada (anti-suckback device)

chlorine-oxidize-ki.title: Falcelinta Beddelka ee Gaaska Chlorine (Cl₂) iyo Potassium Iodide (KI)
chlorine-oxidize-ki.description: Marka gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) lagu gudbiyo xalka potassium iodide (KI) oo ka kooban xabag (xoogaa), xalka wuxuu noqdaa buluug, taasoo caddeyneeysa in gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) uu iodine (I₂) ka beddelay xalka, sidaasna waxaa la xaqiijiyaa in awoodda oxidation ee chlorine ay ka weyn tahay ta iodine (I₂).
objectives: Xaqiijinta awoodda xooggan ee oxidation ee gaaska chlorine (Cl₂)
Fahamka tartanka beddelka ee halogens iyo taxanaha awoodda oxidation
Bartid isticmaalka xabag (xoogaa) hubinta iodine (I₂) xidhmada

chlorine-bleaching-mechanism.title: Baahitaanka Awoodda Bayaanka ee Gaaska Chlorine
chlorine-bleaching-mechanism.description: Gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) oo qalalan iyo kan qoyan ayaa si gaar ah loogu gudubiyaa warqadda litmus; kan qalalan ma beddelo midabka, halka kan qoyan uu midabka ka saaro, taasoo muujineysa in hypochlorous acid ee ka dhalata falcelinta chlorine iyo biyo ay tahay waxa bayaanka sameeya.
objectives: Garan in gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) qudhiisu bayaan samayn waayo
Fahamka hypochlorous acid oo ah walax ka shaqeeysa bayaanka
La qabsashada naqshadeynta tijaabada xog-dhac (controlled experiment)

chlorine-tail-gas-naoh.title: Xannibaadda Gaaske Dhambe ee Gaaska Chlorine
chlorine-tail-gas-naoh.description: Ka dib samaynta ama isticmaalka gaaska chlorine (Cl₂), gaaske dhambaaxa extra ah waxaa lagu nuugaa Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد si looga hortago wasakhowga hawada; waxaana la baranayaa mabda'a guud ee xannibaadda gaaske sun ah.
objectives: Bartid nuugista gaaske dhambe ee gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) annagoo isticmaalaya xalka xaalufiyaha (alkaline solution)
Fahamka shuruucda deegaanka ee ka mamnuucaya si toos ah u sii daynta gaaske sun ah hawada
Garan waxyaabaha ka dhasha falcelinta gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) iyo xaalufiyeyaasha

so2-reduce-kmno4.title: Xaqiijinta Awoodda Reduction ee Sulfur Dioxide
so2-reduce-kmno4.description: Sulfur dioxide waxaa lagu sameyaa falcelinta sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) iyo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo dillaacan, kadibna waxaa lagu gudubiyaa xalka potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) ee midabka guduudan-banaanka ah si uu midabka uga lumiyo, taasoo caddeyneeysa awoodda reduction ee sulfur dioxide.
objectives: Bartid habka samaynta sulfur dioxide
Xaqiijinta awoodda reduction annagoo ka dhuuqneyna midabka potassium permanganate (KMnO₄)
Kala soocida midab-luminta ka timaada awoodda reduction iyo ta ka timaada awoodda bayaanka

so2-from-bisulfite.title: Samaynta Sulfur Dioxide annagoo Isticmaalaya Sodium Bisulfite
so2-from-bisulfite.description: Sulfur dioxide waxaa lagu sameyaa falcelinta sodium bisulfite (NaHSO₃) iyo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo dillaacan; warqadda litmus oo qoyan ayaa loo isticmaalaa hubinta astaamaha gaaske aashidda ah, waxaana la baranayaa dariiqa kale ee samaynta gaaske.
objectives: Bartid habka samaynta sulfur dioxide annagoo isticmaalaya bisulfite iyo aashitada
Hubinta aashidnimada sulfur dioxide
Ogaanshaha in walxaha kala duwan ay samayn karaan gaas isku mid ah

feoh2-air-oxidation.title: Sameynta Bir(II) Hiidrooksaydka iyo Isbeddelka Midabkiisa
feoh2-air-oxidation.description: Markii iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄) la falgalo sodium hydroxide (NaOH), ayaa markii hore la sameeyaa birta(III) hiidrooksaydka (iron(III) hydroxide) cad, kaas oo hawada ku degdeg ah u beddelma midab cagaar-cirro ah, ugu dambayntana u rogo midab casaan-bunni ah oo birta(III) hiidrooksaydka (iron(III) hydroxide) gaar ah.
objectives: Sameynta birta(II) hiidrooksaydka
Observation-ka isbeddelka midabka ee xilliga kala duwan
Fahamka sida bir(II) ay hawadu u oksideyso si fudud

agcl-light-darkening.title: Isbeddelka Midabka Lacagta Kloriidhka (Silver Chloride) Markii Iftiin Lagu Dhaco
agcl-light-darkening.description: Markii silver nitrate (AgNO₃) la falgalo Botaasiyam kloriiد, ayaa la helaa dacal cad oo ah lacagta kloriidhka (silver chloride); markii iftiinka lagu dhaco ayuu si tartiib tartiib ah u noqdaa midab dambas-cad, taas oo muujineysa xasaasiyada halyoodka silfar ee iftiinka.
objectives: Observation-ka sameynta dacalka cad
Garan xasaasiyada halyoodka silfar ee iftiinka
Xiriirinta aqoonta kamarada iyo agabka dareensan iftiinka

halide-fractional-precipitation.title: Dacalinta Tallaabooyinka ah ee Halide Aniyoonada
halide-fractional-precipitation.description: Markii silver nitrate (AgNO₃) si tartiib tartiib ah loogu kordhiyo qulqulka isku-darka ah ee sodium chloride (NaCl), potassium bromide, iyo potassium iodide (KI), ayaa kala-soocida dacalka u dhacaa sida ku habboon qiimaha ksp: marka hore silfar(I) aayodiiد (oranjo), ka dibna silver bromide (AgBr) (jaallo-cad), ugu dambayntana lacagta kloriidhka (silver chloride) cad.
objectives: Fahamka mabda'a dacalinta tallaabooyinka ah
Barbar-dhigga qiimayaasha ksp ee halyoodka silfar
Observation-ka isku xigxiga midabada dacalka

common-ion-effect-agcl.title: Saamaynta Ion-ka Wadaagga ah ee ku Timaada Xalka Lacagta Kloriidhka (Silver Chloride)
common-ion-effect-agcl.description: Waxaa la samaynayaa dacal ah lacagta kloriidhka (silver chloride) adoo isticmaalaya silver nitrate (AgNO₃) iyo sodium chloride (NaCl), ka dibna waxaa lagu kordhiyaa aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) si loo bidhaamiyo ion-ka kloriidhka, taas oo muujineysa sida saamaynta ion-ka wadaagga ah u yareeyo kala-milmida lacagta kloriidhka (silver chloride).
objectives: Garanshaha saamaynta ion-ka wadaagga ah
Falanqaynta dheelitirnaanta kala-milmida dacalka
Xiriirinta jihada guurka ksp

precipitate-washing-filtration.title: Shaandhaynta iyo Dhaqista Dacalka
precipitate-washing-filtration.description: Anigoo adeegsanaya dacalka cad ee sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄) ee laga helo barium chloride (BaCl₂), waxaa la tababaraa hawlaha shaandhaynta iyo dhaqista dacalka, iyo sidoo kale xaqiijinta nadiifnaanta dhaqista.
objectives: Fulinта hawlaha shaandhaynta si saxsan
Bartida hababka dhaqista dacalka
Xukumida heerka nadiifnaanta dhaqista

hydroxide-color-identification.title: Aqoonsiga Ion-yada Iyadoo Lagu Tiirsan Midabka Hiidrooksaydka
hydroxide-color-identification.description: Markii sodium hydroxide (NaOH) lagu daraa qulqul isku-dar ah oo ka kooban iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) iyo copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), ayaa dacalka casaan-bunni ah iyo buluugga ah ee la soo saaro loo isticmaalaa aqoonsiga iron-ionka iyo copper-ionka.
objectives: Aqoonsiga ion-yada iyadoo lagu tiirsan midabka dacalka
Observation-ka dacalka casaan-bunni ah iyo kan buluugga ah
Qorista macaadilada ion-ka

barium-salts-acid-solubility.title: Barbar-dhigga Kala-milmida Aashitada ee BaSO₄ iyo BaCO₃
barium-salts-acid-solubility.description: Waxaa la isticmaalaa barium chloride (BaCl₂) si loola falgalo sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄) iyo sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) si gooni gooni ah, si loo helo dacalka cad ee labadaba; ka dibna waxaa lagu daraa aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) si loo barbar-dhigo kala-milmidahooda aashitada.
objectives: Barbar-dhigga kala-milmida aashitada ee dacalka
Kala-soocista aniyoonnada sulfate iyo carbonate
Fahamka kala-duwanaanshaha xasilloonida cusbo-aan-milmaynta

cuoh2-thermal-decomposition.title: Kala-jabinta Kulaylka ah ee Naxaas(II) Hаydrooksiiد
cuoh2-thermal-decomposition.description: Waxaa la samaynayaa dacal buluug ah oo Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد ah adoo falgalsiinaya copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) iyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH); markii la kululeeyо ayuu kala-jabaa oo soo saara copper(II) oxide madow.
objectives: Sameynta Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد
Observation-ka muuqaalka kala-jabinta kulaylka
Garanshaha sameynta copper(II) oxide

feoh3-ignition-oxide.title: Birta(III) hiidrooksaydka gubasho si loo sameeyo birta(III) oksiidka
feoh3-ignition-oxide.description: iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) waxay ka falcelisaa sodium hydroxide (NaOH) si ay u soo saarto talaalka cas-bunni ah ee birta(III) hiidrooksaydka (iron(III) hydroxide), kaas oo shaandhaynta ka dib la gubo oo u beddelo birta(III) oksiidka (iron(III) oxide) midabkiisu cas-bunni yahay.
objectives: Soo saarida birta(III) hiidrooksaydka (iron(III) hydroxide)
Indho indheynta kala-jabinta gubasho
Aqoonsiga sida loo sameeyo birta(III) oksiidka (iron(III) oxide)

carbonate-vs-sulfate-barium.title: Isticmaalka barium chloride (BaCl₂) si loo kala saaro sulfate iyo carbonate
carbonate-vs-sulfate-barium.description: Marka barium chloride (BaCl₂) lagu daro xalka sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄) iyo sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) midkasta, labadaba waxay soo saaraan talaal cad; hase yeeshee marka aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) lagu daro, orodka barium carbonate oo kaliya ayaa kala dhumiya oo sii daaya carbon dioxide (CO₂), taasoo kala soocaysa labada anion.
objectives: Kala soocida anionka sulfate iyo carbonate
Indho indheynta kala duwanaanshaha talaalka marka aashito lagu daro
Aqoonsiga sida loo saafeyo ionka wax khalkhal geliya

sequential-anion-detection.title: Baaris kala-sooc ah oo chloride iyo sulfate
sequential-anion-detection.description: Xalka isku-darka ah ee ka kooban sodium chloride (NaCl) iyo sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄), waxaa ugu horrayn xoogaa barium chloride (BaCl₂) oo dheeraad ah lagu daraa si loo saafo sulfate, ka dibna shaandhaynta waxaa lagu baaraa ionka chloride adoo isticmaalaya silver nitrate (AgNO₃) iyo aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid).
objectives: Naqshadeynta qorshaha kala-soocida iyo baarista
Ka saridda khalkhalka sulfate
Bartida habka saxda ah ee baarista tartibkeeda

volhard-chloride-titration.title: Habka Volhard ee qiyaasida chloride si lagu cabiro
volhard-chloride-titration.description: Xalka sodium chloride (NaCl) ee ku jira aashito nitric ah (HNO₃), waxaa lagu daraa xoogaa silver nitrate (AgNO₃) ah oo dheeraad ah si loo dul-dhigo ionka chloride, ka dibna waxaa la isticmaalaa potassium thiocyanate (KSCN) oo leh tilmaamiye Birta(III) sulfeet si dib loogu qiyaaso silver-ka dheeraadka ah, tijaabada oo dhammaanaysa markii midabka cas ka muuqdo.
objectives: Bartida habka Volhard
Go'aaminta dhamaadka tijaabada qiyaasida
Xisaabinta qiyaasta chloride ee muunada

copper-hydroxide-anion-independence.title: Isbarbardhigga naxaas-ملحyada kala duwan ee loo sameeyo Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد
copper-hydroxide-anion-independence.description: Marka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), copper(II) chloride, iyo copper(II) nitrate (Cu(NO₃)₂) midkasta lala falceliyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH), dhammaan waxay soo saaraan Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد midabkiisu buluug yahay oo isku mid ah, taasoo xaqiijinaysa in talaalku uu go'an yahay ionka naxaas (Cu).
objectives: Isbarbardhigga falcelinta noocyada kala duwan ee mlaxda naxaas
Fahanka dabeecadda falcelinta ionic
Indho indheynta talaalka buluugga ah ee isku midka ah

seawater-magnesium-extraction.title: Ku-dayashada soo-saarka magnesium badda
seawater-magnesium-extraction.description: Ku-dayashada hababka soo-saarka magnesium ee badda, waxaa lagu daraa calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂) xalka magnesium chloride si loo sameeyo talaal cad oo magnesium hydroxide ah.
objectives: Fahmida habka soo-saarka magnesium ee badda
Soo saarida magnesium hydroxide
Aqoonsiga sababta loo doorto saldhiga raqiiska ah

caco3-acid-dissolution.title: Soo saarida calcium carbonate iyo ka-dhalaalinta aashitada
caco3-acid-dissolution.description: sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) iyo calcium chloride (CaCl₂) ayaa falceliya si ay u soo saaraan talaal cad oo calcium carbonate ah, ka dibna marka aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) lagu daro, talaalku wuu kala dhumiyaa oo sii daayaa carbon dioxide (CO₂).
objectives: Indho indheynta soo saarida iyo kala dhuminta talaalka
Aqoonsiga dabeecadda calcium carbonate
Xiriirka cave-yada dabiiciga ah iyo barafka biyo-mareenka

ferrous-ferric-hydroxide-comparison.title: Isbarbardhigga hiidrooksaydyada bir (Fe) ee labada qiimo
ferrous-ferric-hydroxide-comparison.description: iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄) iyo iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) midkasta lala falceliyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH), waxaa la isbarbardhigaa birta(II) hiidrooksaydka cad ee si deg-deg ah midabka u beddela iyo birta(III) hiidrooksaydka (iron(III) hydroxide) cas-bunni ah.
objectives: Isbarbardhigga labada qiimo ee bir (Fe)
Indho indheynta kala duwanaanshaha midabka talaalka
Aqoonsiga sida birta(II) si fudud ugu oksideyso

baso4-from-nitrate.title: Sameynta BaSO₄ adigoo isticmaalaya barium nitrate (Ba(NO₃)₂)
baso4-from-nitrate.description: Botaasiyam sulfeet waxaa lagu daraa barium nitrate (Ba(NO₃)₂) si loo sameeyo rajo cad oo BaSO₄ ah oo aan ku dhalalin aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid).
objectives: Sameynta BaSO₄
Garanshaha sida birta barium loo isticmaalo xaqiijinta ion-ka sulfate
Daawashada rajada cad ee aan ku dhalalin aashidda

baso4-from-copper-sulfate.title: Sameynta BaSO₄ oo ka timaada copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄)
baso4-from-copper-sulfate.description: Marka barium chloride (BaCl₂) lagu daro xalka buluuga ah ee copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), waxaa soo baxa rajo cad oo BaSO₄ ah halka xalku buluug u sii jiro, taas oo muujinaysa in ion-ka sulfate kaliya uu rajada u baxay.
objectives: Garanshaha sameynta rajada xulashada leh
Daawashada midabka rajada iyo xalka
Fahamka sida ion-adu si madaxbanaan uga falcelinayaan

kmno4-fecl2.title: Potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) oo oxidizing-gareeya birta(II) kloriidhka (iron(II) chloride)
kmno4-fecl2.description: Marka potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) oo aashito leh lagu dhibto xalka birta(II) kloriidhka (iron(II) chloride), midabka guduudka-jeexjeexan ayaa baaba'a oo midabka cagaarka fudud wuxuu u rogo bunni-huruud, taas oo muujinaysa awoodda oxidizing ee potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) uu u leeyahay adeegga Fe²⁺ u rogidda Fe³⁺.
objectives: Daawashada baaba'ida midabka guduudda-jeexjeexan
Garanshaha sida Fe²⁺ loo oxidizing-gareeyay
Qorista isla-dheellitirka ion-ka

kmno4-h2o2.title: Falcelinta potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) iyo hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂)
kmno4-h2o2.description: Marka hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) lagu dhibto potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) oo aashito leh, midabka guduudka-jeexjeexan ayaa baaba'a oo xumbo ayaa soo baxa, taas oo muujinaysa in hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) halkan u dhaqmayo sida reducing agent, isagoo oxidized loo gareeyay oo sii daayay ogsijiin (O₂).
objectives: Daawashada baaba'ida midabka iyo soo baxa xumbada
Garanshaha awoodda reducing ee hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂)
Fahamka sida uu isaga qudhiisu u noqday muujiye

k2cr2o7-fe2.title: Potassium dichromate oo oxidizing-gareeya iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄)
k2cr2o7-fe2.description: Marka potassium dichromate oo aashito leh lagu dhibto iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄), midabka oranji ayaa u roga cagaar, taas oo muujinaysa in potassium dichromate uu Fe²⁺ oxidizing-gareeyay isagoo isagu loo soo rogay chromium-ka saddexaad ee heerka.
objectives: Daawashada rogidda oranji ilaa cagaarka
Garanshaha isbedelka heerarka valence ee chromium
Qorista isla-dheellitirka oxidation-reduction

k2cr2o7-ethanol.title: Potassium dichromate oo oxidizing-gareeya ethanol (C₂H₅OH)
k2cr2o7-ethanol.description: Marka potassium dichromate oo aashito leh uu la kulmaa ethanol (C₂H₅OH), midabka oranji ayaa u roga cagaar, taas oo muujinaysa sida alcohol loo oxidizing-gareeyay, waxaana lala xiriiriyaa mabaadi'da tijaabada neefsiga ee hubinta khamriga.
objectives: Daawashada rogidda oranji ilaa cagaarka
Garanshaha sida ethanol (C₂H₅OH) loo oxidizing-gareeyay
Xiriirinta tijaabada hubinta wadaagaha khamriga

thiosulfate-iodine-titration.title: Titration-ka sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) iyo xal iodine ah (I₂ biyood) (habka iodometric)
thiosulfate-iodine-titration.description: Xalka caadiga ah ee sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) waxaa loo isticmaalaa titration-ka xal iodine ah (I₂ biyood); marka dhamaadka uu dhowaan yahay, xabag (xoogaa) ayaa lagu daraa si uu midab buluug u muujiyo, titration-kana waxaa lagu soo gabagabeeyaa marka midabka buluuga ah uu si sax ah u baaba'o, taas oo siinaysa garashada heerka tirada ee habka iodometric.
objectives: Garashada habka iodometric
Isticmaalka xabag (xoogaa) si loo muujiyo dhamaadka
Xisaabinta xadka iodine (I₂)

h2o2-oxidize-ki.title: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) oo oxidizing-gareeya potassium iodide (KI)
h2o2-oxidize-ki.description: Xaalad aashito ah, hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) waxay oxidizing-gareysaa potassium iodide (KI) si loo sameeyo iodine (I₂); marka xabag (xoogaa) lagu daro xalka, midab buluug ayaa soo muuqdaa, taas oo muujinaysa awoodda oxidizing ee hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂).
objectives: Daawashada soo baxa midabka buluuga ah
Garanshaha awoodda oxidizing ee hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂)
Barbardhigga awooddiisa reducing

bromine-fe2-oxidation.title: Bromine oo kala-saaraya ionka iron(II)
bromine-fe2-oxidation.description: Marka xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood) lagu daro xalka iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄), midabka oranji ayaa baaba'a; markaas potassium thiocyanate (KSCN) ayaa lagu dara si loo hubiyo in ionka iron(II) loo beddelay iron(III) ion.
objectives: La'aanshaha midabka ee oxidation-ka la arko
Isticmaalka iftiiminta midabka si loo hubiyo iron(III) ion
Xoogga oxidation-ka is barbar dhigga

so2-kmno4-decolor.title: Sulfur dioxide oo baabi'inaya midabka potassium permanganate (KMnO₄)
so2-kmno4-decolor.description: Marka sulfur dioxide lagu mari-mariyo xalka aashito ah ee potassium permanganate (KMnO₄), midabka guduud-dambaska ah ayaa baaba'a, taasoo xaqiijinaysa awoodda yaraynta (reducing power) ee sulfur dioxide iyo farqiga u dhexeeya yaraynta iyo caddaynta (bleaching).
objectives: Awoodda yaraynta ee SO₂ la garto
Farqiga u dhexeeya yaraynta iyo caddaynta la kala saaro
Isle'egtada ionka (ionic equation) la qoro

copper-concentrated-sulfuric-acid.title: Naxaas (Cu) iyo aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) oo falceliya
copper-concentrated-sulfuric-acid.description: Marka xaashi naxaas ah la kululeeyo oo ay la jirto aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated), ayaa soo baxa gaas ur xun leh, xalka na aad u buluugaado, taasoo muujinaysa awoodda oxidation-ka xooggan ee aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan — falcelintaas waa in gudaha hawada loo sameeyo.
objectives: Awoodda oxidation-ka ee aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan la garto
Soo baxa gaaska iyo buluugaanshaha xalka la arko
Farqiga u dhexeeya aashitada xooggan iyo tan la wasakheeyay la fahmo

silver-nitric-acid.title: Lacag (silfar) iyo aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) oo falceliya
silver-nitric-acid.description: Marka Lacag (silfar) ay la falceliso aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid), ayaa soo baxa xal midab la'aan ah iyo gaas, taasoo muujinaysa awoodda oxidation-ka xooggan ee aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) oo ku habboon in ay dhaliso macdanta gaabiga ah ee Lacag (silfar) — falcelintaas waa in gudaha hawada loo sameeyo.
objectives: Awoodda oxidation-ka ee aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) la garto
Soo baxa gaaska la arko
Xaddidaadda firfircoonida macdanta la fahmo

halogen-displacement-cl-i.title: Chlorine oo bedelaya iodine (I₂)
halogen-displacement-cl-i.description: Marka biyo chlorine ah (chlorine water) lagu daro xalka potassium iodide (KI), ayaa iodine (I₂) soo baxa; markaas marka xabag (xoogaa) lagu daro, midab buluug ah ayaa ka muuqda, taasoo xaqiijinaysa in awoodda oxidation-ka ee chlorine ay ka xoogsan tahay tan iodine (I₂).
objectives: Firfircoonida chlorine iyo iodine (I₂) la xaqiijiyo
La arko buluugaanshaha iodine-xabag (xoogaa)
Xeerka bedelashada la fahmo

halogen-oxidizing-power.title: Is barbardhigga awoodda oxidation-ka ee halogennada
halogen-oxidizing-power.description: Biyo chlorine ah (chlorine water) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in laga bedelo bromine (Br₂) xalka potassium bromide, xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood) na waxaa lagu beddelaa iodine (I₂) xalka potassium iodide (KI); adoo isticmaalaya xabag (xoogaa) in la muujiyo midabka, ayaa la soo koobaa xeerka hoos-u-dhaca awoodda oxidation-ka ee chlorine ilaa bromine (Br₂) ilaa iodine (I₂).
objectives: Awoodda oxidation-ka ee halogennada la is barbardhigo
Tijaabo barbardhig ah la naqshadeeyay
Xeerka isbedelka la soo koobo

fe3-iodide-oxidation.title: Iron(III) ion oo kala-saaraya iodide ion
fe3-iodide-oxidation.description: Marka potassium iodide (KI) lagu daro xalka iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃), midabka bunni-jaallaha ah ayaa sii xoqnaada iyo iodine (I₂) ayaa soo baxa; marka xabag (xoogaa) lagu daro, midab buluug ah ayaa ka muuqda, taasoo xaqiijinaysa in Fe³⁺ uu awood u leeyahay in uu iodide ion kala saaro.
objectives: Awoodda oxidation-ka ee Fe³⁺ la garto
La arko soo baxa iodine (I₂)
Xoogga oxidation-ka is barbar dhigga

sulfite-iodine-reduction.title: Sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) oo baabi'inaya midabka xal iodine ah (I₂ biyood)
sulfite-iodine-reduction.description: Marka sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) lagu daro xalka buluuga ah ee iodine-xabag (xoogaa), midabka buluuga ah ayaa baaba'a, taasoo xaqiijinaysa in awoodda yaraynta ee sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) ay iodine (I₂) u beddesho iodide ion.
objectives: Awoodda yaraynta ee xoogaa sulfite la garto
La arko baaba'ista midabka buluuga ah
Isle'egtada ionka (ionic equation) la qoro

sulfite-kmno4-oxidation.title: Oxidation-ka Potassium Permanganate (KMnO₄) ee sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃)
sulfite-kmno4-oxidation.description: Marka sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) lagu daro potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) oo aashito ah, midabka guduud-dhirbaaxada ah wuu baaba'aa, taasoo tilmaamaysa sida sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) loo rogo xaasido sulfate.
objectives: La soco baaba'ida midabka guduud-dhirbaaxada
Faham sida xaasidaha sulfite loo oxidize gareeyo
Qor isla-simaha kiimikada ee falcelinta

oxalic-acid-reducing-dichromate.title: Oxalic acid oo Yaraynaysa Potassium Dichromate
oxalic-acid-reducing-dichromate.description: Marka potassium dichromate oo aashito ah la kululeeyo oxalic acid, midabka oranji wuxuu u beddelaa cagaar-madow waxaana soo baxa gaas, taasoo muujinaysa awoodda yaraynta ee oxalic acid iyo isbedelka heerka valence ee chromium.
objectives: La soco beddelka midabka oranji ilaa cagaar
Faham awoodda yaraynta ee oxalic acid
Faham sida chromium loo yareeyo

iodine-thiosulfate-decolor.title: Falcelinta Iodine (I₂) iyo Sodium Thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃)
iodine-thiosulfate-decolor.description: Marka sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) lagu dhibto xalka buluug-madow ee iodine (I₂) iyo xabag (xoogaa), midabka buluugga ah si degdeg ah ayuu baaba'aa, taasoo muujinaysa awoodda yaraynta ee sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) marka ay yareyso iodine (I₂), waxayna aasaas u tahay habka titrimetric ee iodometric.
objectives: La soco baaba'ida midabka buluugga ah
Faham awoodda yaraynta ee sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃)
Xiriir la samee dhamaadka titration-ka iodometric

zinc-sulfuric-hydrogen.title: Soo Saarka Gaaska Hydrogen (hydrogen gas) Adoo Isticmaalaya Graniyuulada Zinc iyo Aashito Sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo La Wasakheeyay
zinc-sulfuric-hydrogen.description: Graniyuulada zinc marka ay falceliso aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la wasakheeyay, xarafka sare ayaa si joogto ah uga soo baxa xumbo oo ah gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) waxaana soo baxa kulyl, taasoo muujinaysa mabda'a soo saarka hydrogen-ka ee shaybaarka.
objectives: La soco soo baxa gasaska iyo kulaylka
Xaqiiji gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas)
Qor isla-simaha kiimikada ee falcelinta

magnesium-hydrochloric-acid.title: Falcelinta Xarig Maqniisiyam ah iyo Aashito Hydrochloric ah (HCl)
magnesium-hydrochloric-acid.description: Marka xarig maqniisiyam ah la rido aashito hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid), si deg-deg ah ayuu u xumbiiraa gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) waxaana tuubo tijaabo si cad u kulushaa, taasoo muujinaysa xawaaraha falcelinta ee birta firfircoon marka ay la kulmayso aashito.
objectives: La soco soo baxa xumbo badan oo degdeg ah
Dareemid soo baxa kulaylka falcelinta
Barbar dhig firfircoonida biraha kala duwan

lead-hydrochloric-slow.title: Falcelinta Gaabista ah ee Xaashi Rasaas ah iyo Aashito Hydrochloric ah (HCl)
lead-hydrochloric-slow.description: Marka xaashi rasaas ah la dhigo aashito hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid), xumbo yar oo gaas ah ayaa si tartiib ah uga soo baxa, xarafkana waxaa ka samaysmaya dabool ah chloride rasaas ah oo aan si fudud ku dhalalin biyo, taasoo muujinaysa inay rasaasta (lead) adag tahay firfircoonida.
objectives: La soco gaabiska falcelinta
Faham sida xarafka loo gaabsado
Go'aan ku samee booska rasaasta (lead) jadwalka firfircoonida biraha

potassium-water.title: Falcelinta Botaasiyam Bireed ah iyo Biyo
potassium-water.description: Marka Botaasiyam bireed ah la rido biyo lagu daray phenolphthalein, falcelintu way ka xoog badnaataa ta sodium: wuxuu sarraysaa, dhawaaq buu samaystaa, olol guduud-dhuuban ayaana ka soo baxaa, xalka pH-kiisuna wuu koraa marka midabka casaanka phenolphthalein soo muuqdo.
objectives: La soco falcelinta xoog badan
Faham soo saarka xaasiduhu adag yahay
Barbar dhig firfircoonida Botaasiyam bireed ah iyo sodium

calcium-water.title: Falcelinta Birta Calcium (Ca) iyo Biyo
calcium-water.description: Marka birta calcium (Ca) la dhigo biyo lagu daray phenolphthalein, si xasilloon ayuu gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) uga soo baxaa waxaana soo baxa calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂) oo xalka u rida midabka casaanka phenolphthalein, falcelintu hase yeeshee way ka qabow tahay ta sodium.
objectives: La soco soo baxa gaaska joogto ah
Faham soo saarka xaasidaha yaraanta lagu dhalalinayaa
Barbar dhig firfircoonida biraha

sodium-potassium-water-compare.title: Barbar-dhigga falcelinta sodium iyo botaasiyam ee biyaha
sodium-potassium-water-compare.description: Birta sodium (sodium metal) iyo Botaasiyam bireed ah ayaa gaar ahaan lagu xidaa biyo leh phenolphthalein; Botaasiyam bireed ah waxay si xoog leh u falcelisaa waxayna u nugul tahay in ay shidato, taasoo noo oggolaanaysa in aan ku kala soocno firfircoonida iyadoo ku saleysan muuqaalka.
objectives: Barbar-dhigga xoogga falcelinta
Kala-soocida tartiibka firfircoonida
Qaabka saxda ah ee qaadashada iyo badbaadada

zinc-copper-sulfate.title: Zinc-ku wuxuu ka beddelaa naxaasta copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄)
zinc-copper-sulfate.description: Graniyuulada zinc ayaa lagu dhex ridiaa xalka buluugga ah ee copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄); naxaas (Cu) cas ah ayaa soo baxa dusha, xalka buluugna wuu faafidhaa, taasoo xaqiijinaysa in zinc uu naxaas (Cu) ka firfircoon yahay.
objectives: Indho-indheynta beddelka iyo isbeddelka midabka
Barbar-dhigga firfircoonida zinc iyo naxaas (Cu)
Qorista macaadaladda kiimikada

magnesium-copper-sulfate.title: Magnesium wuxuu ka beddelaa naxaasta copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄)
magnesium-copper-sulfate.description: Xarig maqniisiyam ah ayaa lagu dhex geliyaa xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄); naxaas (Cu) cas ah ayaa si degdeg ah u soo baxa kulaylna wuu soo saartaa, midabka buluugguna si cad ayuu u yaraadaa, taasoo muujinaysa awoodda beddelka ee biraha firfircoon.
objectives: Indho-indheynta beddelka degdegga ah
Dareemista xaaladda kulaylka-soo-saarka
Fahamka farqiga firfircoonida

aluminum-copper-chloride.title: Aluminium wuxuu ka beddelaa naxaasta copper(II) chloride
aluminum-copper-chloride.description: Xaashi aluminium ah oo la cirifbixiyay ayaa lagu dhex geliyaa xalka copper(II) chloride; naxaas (Cu) cas ah ayaa soo baxa dusha, midabka buluugguna wuu dhintaa, taasoo noo muujinaysa awoodda sare ee soo-celinta aluminium.
objectives: Indho-indheynta muuqaalka beddelka
Fahamka doorka cirifbixinta ee qarinaysa lakabka oxide-ka
Qorista macaadaladda kiimikada

zinc-silver-nitrate.title: Zinc-ku wuxuu ka beddelaa Lacagta (silfar) silver nitrate (AgNO₃)
zinc-silver-nitrate.description: Graniyuulada zinc ayaa lagu dhex ridiaa xalka silver nitrate (AgNO₃); laamo-laamo cad oo Lacag (silfar) ah ayaa soo baxa dusha, xalka midabkiisuna wuxuu ka beddelaa midab la'aanta ilaa xal leh saldhig zinc, taasoo xaqiijinaysa in zinc uu Lacag (silfar) ka firfircoon yahay.
objectives: Indho-indheynta koritaanka laamo-laamo Lacagta (silfar)
Fahamka falcelinta beddelka
Go'aaminta booska Lacagta (silfar) ee jadwalka firfircoonida

metal-order-by-salt.title: Ku-go'aaminta firfircoonida biraha iyadoo la adeegsanayo beddelka
metal-order-by-salt.description: Xaashi bir ah (Fe) iyo xaashi naxaas ah ayaa gaar ahaan lagu dhex geliyaa xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄); bir (Fe) dusha ayaa naxaas (Cu) ka soo baxa halka naxaas (Cu) aanu wax isbeddel ah soo arkin, kaasoo noo muujinaya in bir (Fe) uu naxaas (Cu) ka firfircoon yahay.
objectives: Naqshadeynta tijaabada la-barbardhigga ah
Ku-go'aaminta firfircoonida iyadoo ku saleysan muuqaalka
Soo-koobida xeerarka beddelka

copper-dilute-nitric-acid.title: Falcelinta naxaas (Cu) iyo aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid)
copper-dilute-nitric-acid.description: Xaashi naxaas ah ayaa ku dhex milmaa aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid) waxayna soo saartaa xal buluug ah oo copper(II) nitrate (Cu(NO₃)₂) iyo gaas nitrogen monoxide oo midabla'aan ah oo marka hawada la kulmo u beddelma cas-osman, taasoo noo muujinaysa awoodda oxidation-ka ee aashito nitric ah (HNO₃).
objectives: Indho-indheynta buluunaanshaha xalka
Fahamka isbeddelka midabka gaaska
Fahamka awoodda oxidation-ka ee aashito nitric ah (HNO₃)

iron-ferric-chloride.title: Falcelinta dhexdhexaadka bir (Fe) iyo iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃)
iron-ferric-chloride.description: Xaashi bir ah (Fe) ayaa lagu dhex geliyaa xalka huruud-huruudka ah ee iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃); bir (Fe) ayaa si tartiib ah u dhalaalaayaa, xalkuna wuxuu u beddelaa cagaar-cagaarka, taasoo xaqiijinaysa in bir (Fe) uu iron(III) u soo celiyo iron(II).
objectives: Indho-indheynta isbeddelka tartiibka ah ee midabka
Fahamka falcelinta dhexdhexaadka
Fahamka isbedelaadka oxidation-state-ka ee bir (Fe)

iron-oxide-hydrochloric.title: Xididka bir ee ku milma aashitada hidroklorikada
iron-oxide-hydrochloric.description: Iron(III) oxide midabka casaan-buniga ah ayaa si tartiib tartiib ah ugu milma aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid), waxaana ka soo baxa xal huruud ah, taasoo muujinaysa falcelinta oxiidka birta ee aashidda ah ee soo saarta milixda.
objectives: La daawado sida walxu u milmayso oo xalku u huruudaado
La fahmo mabda'a nadiifinta xididka bir
La qoro isla-simaha kiimikada ee falcelinta

copper-oxide-sulfuric.title: Falcelinta copper(II) oxide iyo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄)
copper-oxide-sulfuric.description: copper(II) oxide midabka madow ah ayaa ku milma aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la wasakheeyay markii yar la kululeeyo, waxaana ka soo baxa xal copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) oo buluug ah, taasoo muujinaysa sida oksiidyada biraha u samaystaan milixda.
objectives: La daawado sida walxda madow u milmayso oo xalku u buluugaado
La fahmo dabeecadda oksiidyada
La baranno habka qoyan ee lagu sameeyo milixda naxaasta

magnesium-oxide-hydrochloric.title: Dabeecadda alkaline oxide ee magnesium oxide (MgO)
magnesium-oxide-hydrochloric.description: magnesium oxide (MgO) midabka cad ah ayaa ku milma aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid), waxaana ka soo baxa xal magnesium chloride ah oo midab la'aan, taasoo muujinaysa falcelinta oksiidyada alkaline ee aashidda.
objectives: La daawado milmida walxda adeyga ah
La aqoonsado oksiidyada alkaline
La qoro isla-simaha kiimikada

iron-oxygen-burning.title: Birta (Fe) oo ku gubanaysa ogsijiin (O₂)
iron-oxygen-burning.description: xaashi bir ah oo kulul ayaa la gelinayaa dhalo uruurinta gaaska oo buuxda ogsijiin (O₂), waxayna si xoogan u gubi jirtaa oo dhinacyo walba uga baxa dab-ciidamada, waxaana ka soo baxa birta oksiidka (iron(II,III) oxide / Fe₃O₄) oo ah walax adeyg madow ah.
objectives: La daawado baraaqda dab-ciidamada
La aqoonsado waxa gubashuhu soo saarto
La fahmo sababta dhab-dhulka dhalada loogu wado ciid

copper-air-heating.title: Naxaasta (Cu) oo madoowda markii hawada lagu kululeeyo
copper-air-heating.description: xaashi naxaas ah oo dhalaalaysa ayaa laambad alkohol lagu kululeeyo, waxaana xaashidooda sare uga soo baxa copper(II) oxide midabka madow ah markii ogsijiin (O₂) ay oksiideyso, taasoo muujinaysa oksiidaynta gaabisan ee biraha.
objectives: La daawado sida xaashidu u madoowdo
La aqoonsado sida copper(II) oxide u samaysmo
La fahmo oksiidaynta biraha

sodium-copper-sulfate-solution.title: Birta sodium (sodium metal) oo la gelinayo xal copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄)
sodium-copper-sulfate-solution.description: birta sodium (sodium metal) markii la geliyo xal copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), waxay horta si xoogan ula falcelisaa biyaha oo soo saartaa gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) oo soo saartaa sodium hydroxide (NaOH), ka dibna waxay la falcelisaa copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) oo soo saartaa rasaas buluug ah; sodium ma beddelo naxaasta.
objectives: La daawado soo saarida gaaska iyo rasaasta buluugta ah
La fahmo sida sodium ugu horrayn biyaha ula falceliso
La kala saaro xeerarka beddelashada biraha firfircoon

metal-flame-color.title: Falcelinta midabka olollaha ee biraha
metal-flame-color.description: Dunta lagu milicsado ee biyo ku jirta sodium chloride (NaCl), calcium chloride (CaCl₂), iyo Botaasiyam sulfeet ayaa si kala duwan loo gubiyo, waxaana la daawadaa midabka ollo ee gaarka ah: jaalle sodium, cas-dhagax calcium, iyo guduud-cagaar potassium; habkan waxaa loo isticmaalaa aqoonsiga ioniga biraha.
objectives: La daawado midabka ollo ee gaarka ah
La baranno hab-fulinta falcelinta midabka olollaha
La aqoonsado curiyayaasha biraha

formic-acid-silver-mirror.title: Falcelinta muruska lacagta ee Aasidda foormiik
formic-acid-silver-mirror.description: Aasidda foormiik waxay leedahay koox aldehyde ah, marka la kululeeyo hammaan biyo oo ay la jirto xalka silver-ammonium, waxay soo saartaa muruus Lacag (silfar) oo dhalaalaya darbiyada tuubada, taasoo caddaynaysa in Aasidda foormiik leedahay awood ikhtizaalka. Xalka silver-ammonium waxaa loo diyaariyaa silver nitrate (AgNO₃) iyo xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) si is-dhaf ah.
objectives: La aqoonsado awoodda ikhtizaalka ee Aasidda foormiik
La daawado sida muruuska lacagtu u samaysmo
La fahmo falcelinta gaarka ah ee kooxda aldehyde

formic-acid-methyl-ester.title: Sameynta Methyl Formate
formic-acid-methyl-ester.description: Aasidda foormiik iyo Metaanol ayaa esterification ku dhacda marka la isticmaalo aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) oo ah catalyst iyo kulaylka, waxayna sameysaa methyl formate oo ur macaan leh; tijaabadani waxay baraysa esterification ee ka dhex jirta carboxylic acid iyo alcohol.
objectives: Ku xirfadeyso falcelinta esterification
Fahmo sida aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) u shaqeyso oo uu catalyst iyo dehydration agent u yahay
Gaar u yeel fikradda falcelinta soo-noqonaysa (reversible reaction)

acetic-acid-methyl-ester.title: Sameynta Methyl Acetate
acetic-acid-methyl-ester.description: Aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) iyo Metaanol ayaa aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) oo catalyst ah ku isticmaalaan esterification si ay u sameeyaan methyl acetate; marka la barbardhigo ethyl acetate (CH₃COOC₂H₅), waxaa cad sida kala duwan ee esterification-ka ee alcohols kala duwan.
objectives: Xooji fahamka falcelinta esterification
U barbardhig ester-yada ka soo baxa alcohols kala duwan
Fahmo doorka catalyst-ka falcelinta kiimikada

acetic-acid-carbonate.title: Falcelinta Aashito Acetic ah iyo Sodium Carbonate
acetic-acid-carbonate.description: Marka aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) lagu daro xalka sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃), waxaa si xoog leh u soo baxa balooliyo badan oo muujinaya in xoogga aashitnimada aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) uu ka sarreeyo carbon dioxide (CO₂); tijaabadani waxay sharaxaysaa aashitnimada carboxylic acids.
objectives: Gaar u yeel aashitnimada carboxylic acids
U barbardhig xoogga aashitnimada aashidaha kala duwan
La socodsii soo-baxa carbon dioxide (CO₂) falcelinta

citric-acid-bicarbonate.title: Falcelinta Citric Acid iyo Sodium Bicarbonate (Effervescence)
citric-acid-bicarbonate.description: Marka citric acid la dhex milmiyo biyo ka dibna lagu daro sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃), waxaa soo baxa carbon dioxide (CO₂) oo abuura effervescence; tijaabadani waxay xidhiidhisaa mabaadi'da shaybaarka iyo isticmaalka maalinlaha ah ee quruuradaha effervescent.
objectives: Gaar u yeel aashitnimada polyprotic carboxylic acids
La socodsii muuqaalka effervescence
Xidhiidhi natiijooyinka shaybaarka oo la xiriirta alaabta maalinlaha ah

phenol-weak-acidity.title: Aashitnimada Daciifka ah ee Phenol
phenol-weak-acidity.description: Xalka phenol oo dariiqi ah wuxuu noqdaa mid cad marka lagu daro Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد si loo sameeyo sodium phenoxide; haddii xigta carbon dioxide (CO₂) lagu dhex qariyo, wuxuu mar kale noqdaa dariiqi oo phenol baxsada, taasoo muujinaysa in aashitnimada phenol ay ka hooseyso ta carbonic acid.
objectives: Gaar u yeel aashitnimada daciifka ah ee phenol
U barbardhig aashitnimada phenol iyo carbonic acid
Daawasho milmitaanka iyo baxsashada maddada

glucose-silver-mirror.title: Falcelinta Silver Mirror ee Glukoos
glucose-silver-mirror.description: Glukoos waxaa ku jira koox aldehyde ah, marka hammaan biyo lagu kululeeyo xalka silver-ammonia (kaas oo ka samaysan silver nitrate (AgNO₃) iyo xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood)), waxaa ku dhaca dabaqad lacag (silfar) oo dhalaalaysa oo muujinaysa hoos-u-dhigitaanka (reducing property) ee Glukoos.
objectives: Xaqiiji joogitaanka Glukoos adiga oo isticmaalaya falcelinta silver mirror
La socodsii samaysmaha dabaqadda lacag (silfar)
Gaar u yeel hoos-u-dhigitaanka (reducing property) ee kaarbohaydreetka

acetaldehyde-copper-hydroxide.title: Falcelinta acetaldehyde (CH₃CHO) iyo Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد Cusub
acetaldehyde-copper-hydroxide.description: Marka acetaldehyde (CH₃CHO) la kululeeyo Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد oo cusub ah (kaas oo ka samaysan copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) iyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH)), waxaa soo baxa rasaasta guduud-tufaax ah ee copper(I) oxide, taasoo xaqiijinaysa hoos-u-dhigitaanka (reducing property) ee kooxta aldehyde.
objectives: Xaqiiji joogitaanka kooxta aldehyde
La socodsii samaysmaha rasaasta guduud-tufaax ah
Ku xirfadeyso diyaarinta iyo isticmaalka Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد cusub

ester-hydrolysis-acid.title: Kala-go'a (Hydrolysis) Aashido ee ethyl acetate (CH₃COOC₂H₅)
ester-hydrolysis-acid.description: ethyl acetate (CH₃COOC₂H₅) wuxuu kala goostaa aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) iyo ethanol (C₂H₅OH) marka hammaan biyo lagu kululeeyaa oo lagu catalyze-gareeyaa aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) daciif ah; lakabka saliidda ah ayaa si tartiib tartiib ah u yaraada, taasoo caddeynaysa kala-go'a ester-ka.
objectives: Gaar u yeel kala-go'a ester-ka
Fahmo doorka catalyst-ka falcelinta kala-go'a
U barbardhig kala-go'a aashidda iyo kala-go'a qaliga

ester-hydrolysis-base.title: Kaarbalka Aasaasiga ah ee Ethyl Acetate
ester-hydrolysis-base.description: Ethyl acetate (CH₃COOC₂H₅) waxaa lagu kariyaa hammaan biyo gudahood oo Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد ku jira, taasoo keenta in lakabka esteerka si dhakhso ah oo buuxda u baaba'o, waxaana la baranayaa sida aasaasku u dedejiyaa kaarbalka esteerka.
objectives: Garan kaarbalka aasaasiga ah
Fahamka farqiga heerka kaarbalka
Xiriirka la sameeya falcelinta saponification

ethylene-kmno4.title: Ethylene-ku Dhumucda potassium permanganate (KMnO₄)
ethylene-kmno4.description: Markii ethylene (C₂H₄) lagu shubo xalka potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) oo aashito ah, midabka guduud-baaruur ah ayaa baaba'a, taasoo caddaynaysa in ethylene (C₂H₄) uu oksiidhaysto potassium permanganate (KMnO₄), waxaana la xaqiijinayaa joogtada labanlaabka ee kaarboonka.
objectives: Garan oksiidhaysiinta alkiinada
Kala soocida hydrocarbons-ka dhumuca iyo kuwa aan dhumucaynayn
La socodsiinta muuqaalka dhumucda

starch-hydrolysis.title: Kaarbalka Xabag (xoogaa) iyo Hubinta Natiijada
starch-hydrolysis.description: Xabag (xoogaa) ayaa hammaan biyo gudahood lagu kaarbalaa aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo dillaacan oo u hiiliya falcelinta, waxaana loo badalaa Glukoos; ka dib markii sodium hydroxide (NaOH) la isticmaalaa si loo dheelitiro, xalal lacag-ammoniya ah oo ka kooban Lacag (silfar) iyo xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) ayaa lagu daraa hubinta, haddii muuqaal lacag (silfar mirror) la arko, waxay caddaynaysaa in Glukoos la sameeyay. Xalka lacag-ammoniya ah waxaa laga diyaarinayaa silver nitrate (AgNO₃) iyo xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood).
objectives: Garan kaarbalka xabag (xoogaa)
Ku mahaarida hubinta ka dib dheelitirka
Xaqiijinta natiijada kaarbalka

starch-hydrolysis-iodine.title: Hubinta Kaarbalka Xabag (xoogaa) Adoo Isticmaalaya iodine (I₂)
starch-hydrolysis-iodine.description: Xabag (xoogaa) ayaa lagu kaarbalaa aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo dillaacan; dhex-dhexaadka, specimen ayaa la qaataa, sodium hydroxide (NaOH) ayaa loo daraa dheelitirka ka dibna xal iodine ah (I₂ biyood) ayaa lagu darsaa — haddaan midab buluug ah soo muuqan, waxay caddaynaysaa in xabag (xoogaa) si buuxda u kaarbalamay.
objectives: La socodsiinta socodka kaarbalka
Ku mahaarida habka hubinta ee iodine (I₂)
Fahamka muhiimadda qaadashada specimen-ka iyo dheelitirka

fat-hydrolysis-acid.title: Kaarbalka Aashitada ah ee dufanka (shahada iyo dufanka)
fat-hydrolysis-acid.description: Dufanka (shahada iyo dufanka) ayaa hammaan biyo gudahood lagu kaarbalaa aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo dillaacan oo u hiiliya, waxaana loo badalaa aashitoyinka saamiga sare iyo glycerol (C₃H₈O₃); waxaa la baranayaa kaarbalka aashitada ah ee dufanka (shahada iyo dufanka), waxaana lala barbardhigayaa falcelinta saponification.
objectives: Garan kaarbalka dufanka (shahada iyo dufanka)
Barbardhigida natiijada kaarbalka aashitada iyo aasaasiga ah
Fahamka sida glycerol (C₃H₈O₃) loo sameeyo

acetic-acid-litmus.title: Hubinta Aashitada aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH)
acetic-acid-litmus.description: Xalka aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) ayaa u beddelaya litmus-ka guduuda, taasoo caddaynaysa in aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) ay leedahay dabeecad aashito, waxaana la baranayaa sifooyinka guud ee aashitoyinka carboxyl.
objectives: Hubinta aashitada aashitoyinka carboxyl
La socodsiinta isbeddelka midabka calaamadaha
Garan sifooyinka guud ee aashitoyinka carboxyl

ethanol-water-distillation.title: Karxinta Kala-soocida Xalka ethanol (C₂H₅OH) iyo Biyaha
ethanol-water-distillation.description: Xalka ethanol (C₂H₅OH) iyo biyaha ayaa la karxiyaa; farqiga u dhexeeya dhalaalka ethanol (C₂H₅OH) iyo biyaha ayaa loo isticmaalaa si loo ururiyo qaybta ethanol (C₂H₅OH), waxaana la baranayaa habka hawlgalka karxinta ee kala-soocida iyo nadiifinta.
objectives: Ku mahaarida hawlgalka karxinta
Kala-soocida adoo isticmaalaya farqiga dhalaalka
Garan meesha thermometer-ka loo dhigo

iodine-extraction-ccl4.title: Kala-soocida xal iodine ah (I₂ biyood) Adoo Isticmaalaya Kaarboon tetrakloriiد
iodine-extraction-ccl4.description: Markii Kaarboon tetrakloriiد lagu daraa xal iodine ah (I₂ biyood) oo la garaaco ka dibna la nasto, iodine (I₂) ayaa u guurta lakabka hoose ee Kaarboon tetrakloriiد oo muujinaya midab guduud-baaruur ah, labada xaloodna way kala soocmaan; waxaa la baranayaa hawlgalka qaadashada iyo kala-soocida.
objectives: Garan mabaadi'da qaadashada
Ku mahaarida hawlgalka kala-soocida xaloolaha
Fahamka farqiga ku dhex jira macluumaadka xaloolaha

salicylic-acid-recrystallization.title: Nadiifinta Dib-u-Crystallization-ka Aasidda saalikiilik
salicylic-acid-recrystallization.description: Aasidda saalikiilik ee aan nadiifnayn waxaa lagu milaa biyo distilled ah oo kulul si loo sameeyo xal dheecaan ah oo kulul, markaasaa qaboojinta ka dib waxaa soo baxa crystallo nadiif ah. Habkan waxaa lagu baranayaa sida loo nadiifiyo walxaha dabiiciga ah iyadoo la adeegsanayo dib-u-crystallization.
objectives: Bartida hawlgalka dib-u-crystallization
Isticmaalka isbedelka milnaanshaha iyadoo ku xidhan heerkulka
Garanshaha hababka nadiifinta

salicylic-acid-fecl3.title: Baarista Midabka Aasidda saalikiilik
salicylic-acid-fecl3.description: Marka xal iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) lagu daro xalka Aasidda saalikiilik, midab guduud-casaan ah ayaa soo baxa, taasoo muujinaysa in Aasidda saalikiilik ay leedahay koox phenol hydroxyl ah. Tijaabadani waxay baraysa habka gaar ah ee lagu garto phenols.
objectives: Gartida kooxda phenol hydroxyl
La socodka soo baxitaanka midabka guduud-casaanta ah
Garanshaha qaab-dhismeedka Aasidda saalikiilik

ethanol-dehydration-ethylene.title: Soo Saarista ethylene (C₂H₄) iyo Xaqiijintisa
ethanol-dehydration-ethylene.description: Ethanol (C₂H₅OH) waxaa lala kululeeyaa aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) ilaa ku dhawaad 170 °C si loo sameeyo falcel baabi'inta (elimination reaction) oo keenta soo saarista ethylene (C₂H₄). Gaaska soo baxa waxaa la mariyaa xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood) kaasoo midabkiisu caddaanaa, taasoo xaqiijinaysa soo saarista ethylene (C₂H₄).
objectives: Garanshaha falcelka baabi'inta (elimination reaction)
Bartida xukumida heerkulka si loo saaro ethylene (C₂H₄)
Adeegsiga xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood) si loo xaqiijiyo natiijada

hess-law-verification.title: Xaqiijinta Sharciga Hess
hess-law-verification.description: Waxaa gaar ahaan la cabiraa kulaylka soo baxa marka sodium hydroxide (NaOH) adkayaanshaha ah si toos ah loogu milaa aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl), iyo marka hore loogu milaa biyo distilled ah ka dibna la dhex-daayo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl). Barbar-dhigga labada jid waxay xaqiijinaysaa in kulaylka falcelku ku xidna kaliya xaaladda bilowga iyo dhamaadka.
objectives: Fahamka Sharciga Hess
Naqshadaynta laba jid oo falcel ah
Barbar-dhigga kulaylka guud ee labada jid

quicklime-water-heat.title: Kulaylka Soo Baxa ee calcium oxide (CaO) iyo Biyaha
quicklime-water-heat.description: Marka biyo distilled ah lagu daro calcium oxide (CaO) adkayaanshaha ah, waxaa la arkaa in falcelka u dhexeeya calcium oxide (CaO) iyo biyuhu uu sii daayo kulul badan oo ku filan in biyuhu karaan, taasoo muujinaysa tusaale cad oo falcel kululaynta ah.
objectives: Garanshaha falcelka kululaynta (exothermic reaction)
Cabbirka kacitaanka degdegga ah ee heerkulka
Xiriirka u dhexeeya biyo-garaynta macdanta dhismaha iyo kululaynta

metal-acid-exothermic.title: Kulaylka Soo Baxa ee Falcelka Birta iyo Aashitada
metal-acid-exothermic.description: Koobtii kulaylka ilaalisa gudaheeda, graniyuulada zinc waxaa lala fal-celiyo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la daray, waxaana la diiwaangeliyaa soo baxitaanka gaaska iyo kacitaanka heerkulka xalka, taasoo muujinaysa astaamaha kululaynta ee falcelka u dhexeeya birta iyo aashitada.
objectives: Cabbirka kulaylka soo baxa ee falcelka
Xiriirka u dhexeeya soo baxitaanka gaaska iyo kacitaanka heerkulka
Fahamka asalka kululaynta falcelka

ethanol-combustion-heat.title: Cabbirka Kulaylka Gubashada Ethanol (C₂H₅OH)
ethanol-combustion-heat.description: Ethanol (C₂H₅OH) waxaa la shidaa si uu ugu gubo si buuxda ogsijiin (O₂) gudihiisa, waxaana la adeegsadaa qalab cabirka kulaylka (calorimeter) si loo xisaabiyo kulaylka soo baxa, ka dibna waxaa la xisaabiyaa kulaylka gubashada.
objectives: Cabbirka kulaylka gubashada
Falanqaynta xisaabinta kulaylka
Qiimaynta khasaaraha kulaylka

sulfuric-dilution-heat.title: Kulaylka Soo Baxa ee Daraynta aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄ concentrated)
sulfuric-dilution-heat.description: Aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) ayaa si tartiib tartiib ah loogu shubaa biyo distilled ah iyada oo la wareejinayo, waxaana thermometer la adeegsadaa si loo diiwaangeliyo kulaylka badan ee soo baxa habka daraynta. Tijaabadani waxay fahamsiinaysaa sababta loo daro aashitada biyaha, ee aan biyaha loogu darin aashitada.
objectives: Garanshaha kulaylka soo baxa ee daraynta
Bartida hab-nololeedka ammaan ah ee daraynta
Cabbirka cabbirka kacitaanka heerkulka

sodium-hydroxide-dissolution-heat.title: Kulaylka Dhalaala ee Sodium Hydroxide
sodium-hydroxide-dissolution-heat.description: Sodium hydroxide (NaOH) adag waxaa lagu dhex milaa biyo distilled ah, thermometer-kana waxaa loo isticmaalaa in si joogto ah loo qiyaaso koritaanka heerkulka xalka, si loo garto si tiro ahaan loo qiyaaso saameynta kulaylka dhalaala ee milicyada.
objectives: Garan dhalaala kulaylka ee milicyada
Qiyaas isbeddelka heerkulka
Fahmi enthalpy-ga milicyada

ammonium-nitrate-dissolution-endotherm.title: Qaadista Kulaylka Dhalaala ee Amooniyam nayitrееt
ammonium-nitrate-dissolution-endotherm.description: Amooniyam nayitrееt adag waxaa lagu dhex milaa biyo distilled ah, kadibna waxaa la arkaa hoos u dhac weyn oo ku yimaada heerkulka xalka, taasoo ka caawisa in la fahmo isbedelka tamarta ee milicyada qaadista kulaylka.
objectives: Garan qaadista kulaylka ee milicyada
Qiyaas heerka hoos u dhaca heerkulka
Barbar dhig milicyada dhalaala kulaylka

citric-bicarbonate-endotherm.title: Falcelinta Qaadista Kulaylka ee Citric Acid iyo Sodium Bicarbonate
citric-bicarbonate-endotherm.description: Xalka citric acid iyo sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) adag markay is qasaan waxay soo saartaa xumbo gaasgaas ah waxayna heerkulku hoos u dhacaa, taasoo muujinaysa falcelinta qaadista kulaylka ee caadiga ah ee nooca bubbly ah.
objectives: Garan falcelinta qaadista kulaylka
Xog uruuri ku saabsan soo saarka gaaska iyo hoos u dhaca heerkulka
Xidh xiriir mabda'a kiniiniyaha effervescent

neutralization-heat-comparison.title: Barbar Dhigga Kulaylka Dhalaala ee Aashitooyinka iyo Alkaaliga Xoogga leh
neutralization-heat-comparison.description: Isbeddelka heerkulka ee uu keeno dhalaanka aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) iyo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) markay la fal-celiyaan sodium hydroxide (NaOH) iyo potassium hydroxide waa la qiyaasaa si gaar ah, si loo xaqiijiyo in kulaylka dhalaala ee aashitooyinka iyo alkaliga xoogga leh uu aasaasiga ahaan la mid yahay.
objectives: Barbar dhig kulaylka dhalaala
Fahmi dabeecadda kulaylka dhalaala
Falanqee khaladaadka tijaabada

iron-oxidation-handwarmer.title: Kulaylka Dhalaala ee Ogsijiin ee Bir — Kiishada Kuleylka Gacanta
iron-oxidation-handwarmer.description: Adoo raacaya mabda'a ah in xaashi bir ah ay si deg deg ah u shidato oo kulaylka dhalaaliyo markay joogto sodium chloride (NaCl) iyo ogsijiin (O₂), waxaa la sameeya kiish fudud oo kuleyl gacanta ah, heerkulka koritaankiisana waa la qiyaasaa.
objectives: Garan shidashada gaabista iyo kulaylka dhalaala
Fahmi doorka walxaha elektarolaytiga ee ku kordhiya heerka falcelinta
Xidh xiriir alaabta ganacsiga ee kuleylka gacanta

thiosulfate-concentration-rate.title: Saamaynta Xoogga Xalka ee Heerka Falcelinta Sodium Thiosulfate
thiosulfate-concentration-rate.description: Xalalka sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) oo xooggoodu kala duwan yahay waxaa lala fal-celiyo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la nadiifiyay, heerka falcelintana waxaa lagu barbar dhigaa wakhtiga ay qaadato in calaamadda hoos ku taal ay daboolanto deyrka kibiriitiga ah ee soo baxa.
objectives: Baadh saamaynta xoogga xalka
Ku xirfadle hababka wakhti tirinta ee turbidity-ga
Sawir xiriirka heerka falcelinta

h2o2-catalyst-comparison.title: Saamaynta Katal-isatorrada Kala Duwan ee Kala-gurnaanshaha Hydrogen Peroxide
h2o2-catalyst-comparison.description: Manganese(IV) oxide (MnO₂) iyo iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) waxaa gaar ahaan lagu dara hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂), kadibna waxaa la barbar dhigaa farqiga saameynta labada katal-isator ee ku kordhiya soo saarka ogsijiin (O₂).
objectives: Barbar dhig saameynta katal-isatorrada
Garan xulashada katal-isatorrada
Duwan si tiro ahaan loo qoro heerka soo saarka ogsijiin (O₂)

permanganate-oxalate-temperature.title: Saamaynta Heerkulka ee Heerka Falcelinta Potassium Permanganate iyo Oxalic Acid
permanganate-oxalate-temperature.description: Xalka potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) oo aashito leh iyo oxalic acid waxaa la fal-celiyaa heeraro kala duwan oo lagu ilaaliyo hammaan biyo, heerka falcelintana waxaa lagu barbar dhigaa wakhtiga ay qaadato in midabka guduudan ee udgoon ee damqadaa.
objectives: Baadh saamaynta heerkulka
Isticmaal nidaamka wakhti tirinta ee loo yaqaan «fading-time»
Xukum doorka doorsoomayaasha tijaabada

permanganate-oxalate-autocatalysis.title: Autocatalysis-ka Potassium Permanganate (KMnO₄) iyo Oxalic Acid
permanganate-oxalate-autocatalysis.description: La soco falcelinta u dhexeysa potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) aashitada ah iyo oxalic acid, kaas oo bilowgiisa gaabis u socda, ka dibna si deg-deg ah u xoqxoqda marka natiijadu kordhayso, si loo baaro muujinta autocatalysis-ka iyo tamarta firfircoonida.
objectives: Garan autocatalysis-ka
Faham tamarta firfircoonida (activation energy)
Falanqee sida xawliga falcelinta uu waqtiga la beddelmo

iodine-clock-reaction.title: Cabbirka Xawliga Falcelinta «Saacadda Iodine»
iodine-clock-reaction.description: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) xaaladda aashitada ah ayuu oxidize-gareeya potassium iodide (KI) si looga soo saaro iodine (I₂), taas oo sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) u isticmaasho; marka sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) dhammaado, xabag (xoogaa) si kedis ah ayay u bulaacowdaa, taas oo xawliga falcelinta lagu cabbiro.
objectives: La soco falcelinta saacadda (clock reaction)
Cabbir xawliga falcelinta
Faham tallaabada go'aamisa xawliga (rate-determining step)

surface-area-zinc-rate.title: Saamaynta Cabbirka Xabxabka Falcelinta Zinc iyo Aashitada
surface-area-zinc-rate.description: Graniyuulada zinc oo dhan iyo graniyuulada zinc oo la shiidshiiday ayaa labaduba la falcelinaynaa aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo xoogihiisu la mid yahay, si loo barbar dhigo saamaynta aagga xiriirka ku leh xawliga soo saarista gaaska.
objectives: Baadhid saamaynta aagga xiriirka
Xukun doorsoomayaasha kale (control variables)
Duwan xawliga soo saarista gaaska

pressure-equilibrium-no2.title: Saamaynta Cadaadiska Dheelitirka Nayitrojiin daa'ooksiiد
pressure-equilibrium-no2.description: Nayitrojiin daa'ooksiiد iyo Dii-nayitrojiin tetraooksiiد oo dheelitir ah ayaa lagu xidhaa siriinjada, kaddibna la cadaadiyaa ama la ballaariyaa si loo beddelo cadaadiska, loona soco isbeddelka moogga midabka.
objectives: Garan saamaynta cadaadiska dheelitirka
La soco isbeddelka midabka
Ku dabaq mabaadi'da Le Chatelier

esterification-equilibrium.title: Dheelitirka Falcelinta Esterification-ka ee La Soo Celin Karo
esterification-equilibrium.description: Aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) iyo ethanol (C₂H₅OH) ayaa falceliya aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo catalyst ahaan u adeegta si ester uunsi macaan leh looga sameeyo; lagana baadho in esterification-ku falcelin la soo celin karo yahay, iyo siyaabaha lagu kordhin karo waxsoosaarka.
objectives: Garan falcelinta la soo celin karo
Faham dheelitirka esterification-ka
Baadhi hababka lagu kordhinayo waxsoosaarka

dichromate-chromate-equilibrium.title: Dhaqdhaqaaqa Dheelitirka Potassium Dichromate iyo Potassium Chromate
dichromate-chromate-equilibrium.description: Xalka potassium dichromate ayaa lagu daraa sodium hydroxide (NaOH) iyo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) si gooni ah, loona soco u beddelashada midabka oranjiška iyo jaallaha, si loo fahmo saamaynta xoogga walxaha dheelitirka.
objectives: La soco dhaqdhaqaaqa dheelitirka
Garan saamaynta xoogga walxaha
Ku dabaq mabaadi'da Le Chatelier

carbonic-acid-reversible.title: Falcelinta La Soo Celin Karo ee Carbon Dioxide (CO₂) oo Biyaha La Dhex Geliyay
carbonic-acid-reversible.description: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) ayaa lagu bukiyaa biyo distilled ah oo litmus ku jiro si ay u casaadaan iyadoo carbonic acid la sameeynayo, kaddibna xalka la kululeeyo si uu midabkii hore u soo laabto, loona baaro dabeecadda falcelinta la soo celin karo.
objectives: Garan falcelinta la soo celin karo
La soco isbeddelka midabka iyo soo-noqoshada
Faham sida kulaylku dheelitirka u dhaqaajinayo dhinaca ka soo horjeeda

fe2-identification.title: Aqoonsiga Ionka Iron(II)
fe2-identification.description: Xalka iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄) oo ionka Fe²⁺ ku jiro ayaa lagu daraa sodium hydroxide (NaOH), taas oo soo saarta fal cad ah oo si degdeg ah u cagaarjaan, ugu dambeyntana u roonaada casaankaaga; iyada oo tani la adeegsado si ionka iron(II) loo xaqiijiyo.
objectives: Awood u yeelo xaqiijinta Fe²⁺
La soco isbeddelka midabka faalka
Kala sooc labada isla-tiris ee bir (Fe)

calcium-ion-identification.title: Hubinta ion-ka calcium-ka
calcium-ion-identification.description: Marka la darayo sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) xalka calcium chloride, waxaa samaysmaya calcium carbonate oo cad oo biyaha ku milmi waaya, taasoo xaqiijinaysa joogitaanka ion-ka calcium-ka.
objectives: Bartida hubinta Ca²⁺
La socodsiinta waxyaabaha cadaan ah ee samaysmaya
Fahamka milmidda iyo aan-milmidda raasabka

magnesium-ion-identification.title: Hubinta ion-ka magnesium-ka
magnesium-ion-identification.description: Marka la darayo sodium hydroxide (NaOH) xalka magnesium chloride, waxaa samaysmaya raasab cad oo hydroxide magnesium ah, taasoo xaqiijinaysa joogitaanka ion-ka magnesium-ka.
objectives: Bartida hubinta Mg²⁺
La socodsiinta waxyaabaha cadaan ah ee samaysmaya
Barbar dhigida sifooyinka calcium iyo magnesium

silver-ion-identification.title: Hubinta ion-ka lacagta (silfar)
silver-ion-identification.description: Marka la darayo sodium chloride (NaCl) xalka silver nitrate (AgNO₃), waxaa samaysmaya lacagta kloriidhka (silver chloride) oo cad oo ku milmi waaya aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid), taasoo xaqiijinaysa joogitaanka ion-ka Lacag (silfar).
objectives: Bartida hubinta Ag⁺
La socodsiinta waxyaabaha cadaan ah ee samaysmaya
Fahamka aan-milmidda raasabka ee aashitada

bromide-identification.title: Hubinta ion-ka bromide-ka
bromide-identification.description: Adoo isticmaalaya silver nitrate (AgNO₃) iyo aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid) ayaa la hubin karaa ion-ka bromide-ka; waxaa samaysmaya silver bromide (AgBr) oo jaalle-cad ah oo aashitada ku milmi waaya, taasoo xaqiijinaysa joogitaankiisa.
objectives: Bartida hubinta Br⁻
La socodsiinta raasabka jaalle-cad ah
Barbar dhigida midabka halide-yada lacagta

iodide-identification.title: Hubinta ion-ka iodide-ka
iodide-identification.description: Adoo isticmaalaya silver nitrate (AgNO₃) iyo aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid) ayaa la hubin karaa ion-ka iodide-ka; waxaa samaysmaya Silfar(I) aayodiiد oo jaalle ah oo aashitada ku milmi waaya, taasoo xaqiijinaysa joogitaankiisa.
objectives: Bartida hubinta I⁻
La socodsiinta raasabka jaalle ah
Fahamka xeerarka taxadarka halide-yada

halide-differentiation.title: Kala soocida ion-yada kloride, bromide iyo iodide
halide-differentiation.description: Adoo silver nitrate (AgNO₃) ku daraya goobjoog ahaan xalka sodium chloride (NaCl), xalka sodium bromide (NaBr), iyo xalka potassium iodide (KI), ayaa la kala saari karaa saddexda ion ee halide-ka iyadoo la eegayo midabka raasabka halide-ka lacagta: cad, jaalle-cad, iyo jaalle.
objectives: Kala soocida saddexda ion ee halide
Barbar dhigida midabka raasabka
Bartida habka tijaabada la barbar dhigo

sulfite-identification.title: Hubinta xididdada aashitada sulfite-ka
sulfite-identification.description: Marka la darayo barium chloride (BaCl₂) xalka sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃), waxaa samaysmaya raasab cad; markay ku soo dhacdo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) raasabku wuu milmaa waxaana soo baxaya gaas xun u urta, taasoo xaqiijinaysa joogitaanka xididdada sulfite-ka.
objectives: Bartida hubinta xididdada sulfite
Kala soocida xididdada sulfate iyo xididdada sulfite
La socodsiinta milmidda raasabka iyo soo bixitaanka gaaska

iodine-starch-test.title: Hubinta iodine (I₂) adoo isticmaalaya xabag (xoogaa)
iodine-starch-test.description: Marka la darayo xal xabag (xoogaa) ah xal iodine ah (I₂ biyood), xalku isla markiiba wuxuu noqdaa buluug, taasoo muujinaysa falcelinta midabka ee u dhaxaysa iodine (I₂) iyo xabag (xoogaa), kaas oo si xasaasi ah loogu isticmaalo hubinta iodine (I₂).
objectives: Bartida hubinta iodine (I₂)
La socodsiinta dabeecadda buluug-noqoshada
Fahamka xasaasiyadda falcelinta midabka

gas-co2-identification.title: Baarista Gaaska Carbon Dioxide (CO₂)
gas-co2-identification.description: Aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) ayaa lala falcelisaa sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) si loo soo saaro gaas, gaaskaas oo la marsiyaa biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد) oo saafi ah, taasoo isu beddesho mid xaboobaya, kaas oo caddeynaya jirka carbon dioxide (CO₂).
objectives: Ku soo laab baarista CO₂
La socosho sida biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد) u xaboobayso
Faham sababta loo soo saaro gaaska

gas-ammonia-identification.title: Baarista Gaaska Ammonia (Ammonia Gas)
gas-ammonia-identification.description: Ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) ayaa lagu darsaa sodium hydroxide (NaOH) oo yar la kululeeyo si loo soo saaro gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas), kaasoo warqadda litmus ee cas (red litmus paper) oo qoyan isu beddesho buluug, taasoo caddeynaysa jirka gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas).
objectives: Ku soo laab baarista gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas)
La socosho isbeddelka warqadda litmus ee cas (red litmus paper) oo cagaaran noqonaysa
Faham falcelinta mlaxda ammonium iyo xeryaha aasaaska ah

gas-hydrogen-identification.title: Baarista Gaaska Hydrogen (Hydrogen Gas)
gas-hydrogen-identification.description: Graniyuulada zinc ayaa lala falcelisaa aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la wasakheeyay si loo soo saaro gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas), marka la shido ayuu abaar dhawaaqa khafiifka ah soo saaraa, kaas oo caddeynaya jirka gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) iyo nadiifnimadiisa.
objectives: Ku soo laab baarista gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas)
Aqoonso dhawaaqa abaarka
Faham hawsha xaqiijinta nadiifnimada gaaska

gas-chlorine-identification.title: Baarista Gaaska Chlorine (Cl₂)
gas-chlorine-identification.description: Gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) ee ku jira biyo chlorine ah (chlorine water) ayaa potassium iodide (KI) oksidaystaa si loo soo saaro iodine (I₂), ka dib xabag (xoogaa) ayaa midab buluug ah muujiya, taasoo caddeynaysa xoogga oksidaynta gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) iyo jirkiisa.
objectives: Ku soo laab baarista gaaska chlorine (Cl₂)
Faham sida oksidaystu u beddeshaa iodine (I₂)
La socosho sida xabag (xoogaa) u buluugowdo

flame-test-sodium-potassium.title: Baarista Midabka Dab-shidka Mlaxda Sodium iyo Potassium
flame-test-sodium-potassium.description: Xarig balaatiin ah ayaa lagu dhufanayaa sodium chloride (NaCl) iyo xalka potassium kloriiد oo gooni gooni ah ka dib dab ayaa lagu shidaa; sodium wuxuu muujiyaa midab huruud ah, potassium wuxuu muujiyaa midab guracan. Xariga balaatiin ah waxaa lagu safayaa aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) ka hor iyo ka dib baaritaan kastaa.
objectives: Kala sooc midabka dab-shidka sodium iyo potassium
Ku soo laab habka nadiifinta xariga balaatiin ah
Faham mabda'a falcelinta midabka dab-shidka

titration-acid-base.title: Qiyaasida Xoogga Aashitada iyo Aasaaska Adeegsiga Titraashanka
titration-acid-base.description: Phenolphthalein ayaa loo isticmaalaa indikaateer ahaan; xalka heerka caadiga ah ee sodium hydroxide (NaOH) ee la yaqaan xooggiisu waxaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu titraasho aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) aan la garanayn xooggeeda. Dhamaadka titraashanka waxaa lagu go'aamiyaa isbeddelka degdegga ah ee midabka, ka dib xoogga waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa.
objectives: Ku soo laab hawsha titraashanka dhexdhexaadinta aashitada iyo aasaaska
Go'aamiso dhamaadka titraashanka
Xisaabi xoogga xalka

titration-redox-kmno4.title: Titraashanka Oksidaynta-Kicinta Adeegsiga Potassium Permanganate (KMnO₄)
titration-redox-kmno4.description: Xaaladda aashitada aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) kujirta, xalka heerka caadiga ah ee potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu titraasho xalka oxalic acid; marka midabka cas-guduudka ah ee xalka si joogto ah u baaba'o oo dib u noqon waayo, taas ayaa dhamaadka muujinaysa, ka dib xogga oxalic acid ayaa lagu xisaabiyaa.
objectives: Ku soo laab titraashanka oksidaynta-kicinta
U adeegso potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) indikaateer ahaan
Xisaabi tirada walaxda kicinta ah

edta-hardness-titration.title: Titraashanka Koordiineeshanka EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) ee Qiyaasida Adag-nimada Biyaha
edta-hardness-titration.description: Eriochrome Black T ayaa loo isticmaalaa indikaateer ahaan; xalka heerka caadiga ah ee EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu titraasho muunada biyaha ee calcium chloride (CaCl₂) iyo magnesium chloride ku jira. Marka xalku ka beddelo cas-wine ah oo nadiif ah buluug saafi ah, taas ayaa dhamaadka muujinaysa, ka dib adag-nimada guud ee biyaha ayaa lagu xisaabiyaa.
objectives: Ku soo laab titraashanka koordiineeshanka
Aqoonso isbeddelka midabka indikaateerka
Xisaabi adag-nimada guud ee kalsiyamka iyo magnesium chloride

colorimetric-iron.title: Cabbirka Bir (Fe) Adigoo Isticmaalaya Midabka
colorimetric-iron.description: Iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) iyo potassium thiocyanate (KSCN) way isku dhex galaan oo midab cas oo dhiig u eg soo saara; ka dib markii heerarka caadiga ah la diyaariyo, spectrophotometer (qalabka cabbirka iftiinka) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in la cabbiro tiro bir ah oo xalka ku jirta.
objectives: Fahamka habka falanqaynta midabka (colorimetric analysis)
Sawirka khadka caadiga ah (standard curve) ee cabbirka
Cabbirka tirada bir (Fe) ee ku jirta xalka

filtration-separation.title: Kala Soocida Walxaha Aan Ku Milmin Biyo Adigoo Shaandhaynaaya
filtration-separation.description: Isku darka calcium carbonate iyo sodium chloride (NaCl) ayaa biyo distilled ah ku milma, ka dib shaandhada ayaa la mariyaa; calcium carbonate oo aan biyo ku milmin ayaa warqadda shaandhaynta ku hadhaa, halka sodium chloride (NaCl) uu xalka hoostiisa ka dhex maro, sidaas oo ay kala soocmaan.
objectives: Bartida habka saxda ah ee shaandhaynta (filtration)
Isticmaalka farqiga milmidda si looga mid-goosto labada walxood
Raacidda xeerarka «hal ku dhejin, laba hooseeya, saddex taabashada» ee shaandhaynta

mixture-anion-identification.title: Ganacsiga Anion-yada ku Jira Isku-darka
mixture-anion-identification.description: Xalka ka kooban sodium chloride (NaCl), sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄), iyo sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) ayaa si talaabo-talaabo ah loo falanqayaa adigoo isticmaalaya aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid), barium chloride (BaCl₂), silver nitrate (AgNO₃), iyo aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) si looga garto anion-yada ku jira.
objectives: Naqshadaynta qorshaha falanqaynta nidaamiga ah
Xalinta isbabaysiga is-carqaladaynta tijaabada
Go'aaminta guud ee walxaha ku jira xalka

ion-coexistence-test.title: Tijaabada Ogaanshaha Waa-la-jiri-karta Ion-yada
ion-coexistence-test.description: Isku-dhafka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) iyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH), barium chloride (BaCl₂) iyo sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄), sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) iyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) ayaa la tijaabiyaa si loo ogaado iyagoo la daawanayo taangaynta ama soo baxitaanka gaaska, loona garto ion-yada xalka ku wada jiri kari waaya.
objectives: Fahamka shuruudaha ion-yada wada jirista
Daawashada taangaynta iyo soo baxitaanka gaaska tijaabada
Soo ururinaha xeerarka ion-yada aan wada jiri karin

koh-hcl-neutralization.title: Baadilka potassium hydroxide iyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid)
koh-hcl-neutralization.description: Aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) ayaa si tartiib ah ugu xidiqda xalka potassium hydroxide oo lagu daray phenolphthalein; daqiiqadda midabka cas baaba'o ayaa la qorayaa iyo kac-kulaylka heerkulka, si loo fahmo dabeecadda kulaylka-soo-saarka ee falcelinta baadilka.
objectives: Daawashada isbedelka deg-degga ah ee muujiyaha marka aashitada xooggani baadisho alkali xoogga ah
Cabbirka kacaanka heerkulka inta lagu jiro baadilka
Fahamka xaqiiqada ah ee H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O oo ah saldhiga baadilka

baoh2-sulfuric-double-product.title: Baadilka barium hydroxide iyo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo laba-wax soo saara
baoh2-sulfuric-double-product.description: Aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la dareeriyo ayaa ku xidiqda xalka barium hydroxide; taangiga cad ee barium sulfate ayaa sii kordhaya, halka awoodda gudbinta koronto ee xalku ay u hoos dhacdo heer ugu hooseeya — falcelintan baadilka ah ayaa gaar u ah tan «biyo iyo taangi wada saarta».
objectives: Daawashada taangiga soo baxa inta lagu jiro baadilka
Fahamka sababta ugu hooseeya ee gudbinta koronto marka tirada ion-yada ay u dhacdo heerka ugu hooseeya
Qorista xeerka ion-yada (ionic equation) ee baadilka ay ku lug leedahay taangi

nitric-naoh-neutralization.title: Titrashada Baadilka aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) iyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH)
nitric-naoh-neutralization.description: Xalka caadiga ah ee sodium hydroxide (NaOH) ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu titro aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) oo xooggeeda aan la garanin, adigoo isticmaalaya phenolphthalein si loo garto dhibcaha dhammaadka, ka dibna xoogga moolka ee aashitada la xisaabiyo.
objectives: Bartida hawsha titrashada aashid-alkali iyo akhrisidda qalabka
Gartida midabka dhammaadka ee phenolphthalein
Xisaabinta xoogga aashitada aan la garanin adigoo adeegsanaya xidhiidhka cabbiraadda

acetic-ammonia-weak-weak.title: Baadilka Aashitada Daciifka ah iyo Alkali-ga Daciifka ah
acetic-ammonia-weak-weak.description: Aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) iyo xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) ayaa isku dhafma; labada electrolyte oo daciif ah ayaa is-dhiirrigeliya kordhinta ionization-kooda oo si buuxda isu baadiyaan, waxaana soo baxa ammonium acetate oo xalliisu u dhow yahay dhexdhexaadnimada, taasoo pH-miis lagu xaqiijinayo.
objectives: Fahamka sida aashitada daciifka ah iyo alkali-ga daciifka ah isugu dhiirrigeliyaan ionization-kooda
Xaqiijinta in xalka ammonium acetate uu dhow yahay dhexdhexaadnimada
Barbar dhigga saameynta kulaylka baadilka marka loo eego aashitada iyo alkali-ga xoogga ah

potassium-carbonate-acid-gas.title: Falcelka gaaska ee botaasiyamka kaarbooneetka iyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay
potassium-carbonate-acid-gas.description: Markii aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) lagu soo daro botaasiyamka kaarbooneetka (potassium carbonate) oo adag, waxaa si xoogan u soo baxa xumbaale midab la'aanta ah oo kulyl soo saara; gaaska la soo saaro markii loo gudbiyo biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد) ayuu muujiyaa in uu yahay carbon dioxide (CO₂).
objectives: La eego sida kaarboonaytku si xoogan ugu soo saaro gaaska markuu la kulmo aashito
Lagu qabsado habka lagu xaqiijiyo carbon dioxide (CO₂)
Lagu qoro isla-simaha iyon-ahaanshaha ee kaarboonaytka iyo aashitada xoogga leh

ammonium-bicarbonate-acid.title: Falcelka laba-dhinacaadka ah ee Amooniyam baykaabonayt iyo aashitada
ammonium-bicarbonate-acid.description: Amooniyam baykaabonayt markuu la kulmo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl), isla markiiba wuxuu soo saaraa carbon dioxide (CO₂); isla walaxdaasna markii la kululeeyo waxay kala burburaan oo soo saartaa gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas), taas oo u ah muujin toos ah oo ah in labadaba «xididdada amooniyamka iyo baykaabonaytka» ay yihiin kuwo aan xasiloonayn.
objectives: La eego sida Amooniyam baykaabonayt ugu soo saaro gaaska markuu la kulmo aashito
Lagu fahmo in labadabaملح amooniyamka iyo baykaabonaytka aysan ahayn kuwo xasilooni
Lagu sharaxo sababta Amooniyam baykaabonayt oo bacriminta nitrojin ah loo isticmaalo loo baahan yahay in laga fogaado walxaha aashitada iyo alkaliga leh

aluminum-hydroxide-acid-dissolve.title: Aluminiyam hаydrooksiid ku milmida aashitada
aluminum-hydroxide-acid-dissolve.description: Aluminiyam hаydrooksiid cad oo adag markii lagu daro aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid), wuxuu si tartiib ah ugu milmaa oo nidaamku noqdaa mid cad oo kulylbax leh; tan waxaa lala barbardhigaa milmidiisa alkaliga xoogga leh si loo muujiyo dabeecadda laba-dhinacaadka.
objectives: La eego habka alkaliga aan milmin ee ku milma aashitada xoogga leh
Lagu fahmo dhinaca alkaliga ah ee Aluminiyam hаydrooksiid
Ugu diyaargarowga fahamka buuxa ee hydroxide laba-dhinacaadka ah

calcium-oxide-acid-heat.title: Kulylbaxida xoogga leh ee calcium oxide (CaO) iyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay
calcium-oxide-acid-heat.description: Markii calcium oxide (CaO) la galiyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid), si dhakhso ah ayuu ugu milmaa oo heerkulku si degdeg ah u kacaa, taas oo muujinaysa in falcelka oxide-ka alkaliga ah iyo aashitada uu kulyl ka sii baxo mid ka badan kulayl-neefsiga caadiga ah.
objectives: La eego falcelka kulylbaxida ah ee oxide-ka alkaliga ah iyo aashitada
Loo barbardhigo saameynta kulaylka ee calcium oxide (CaO) markii biyo lagu daro iyo markii aashito lagu daro
Lagu fahmo dabeecadda calcium oxide (CaO) oo ah oxide alkaliga ah

alumina-acid-slow-dissolve.title: Habka gaabis ah ee Aluminiyam ooksiid ku milma aashitada
alumina-acid-slow-dissolve.description: Aluminiyam ooksiid oo budo ah markii la galiyo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid), milmidiisu si cad ayey u gaabisaa; waxay u baahan tahay kululayn iyo wareejin si uu nidaamku u noqdo mid cad, taas oo muujinaysa in qaab-dhismeedkiisu yahay mid adag oo xasilloon oo kimikada ku xoog badan.
