objectives: La eego gaabiska milmida Aluminiyam ooksiid
Lagu fahmo saamaynta qaab-dhismeedka kristalka ee xawliga falcelka
Lagu garto meesha Aluminiyam ooksiid ka jirto oo ah oxide laba-dhinacaadka ah

sulfuric-limestone-gas.title: Xaaladda is-xannibaadda ee aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la wasakheeyay iyo dhagaxa nuuradda
sulfuric-limestone-gas.description: Markii aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la wasakheeyay lagu soo dhibto dhagaxa nuuradda, hore waxaa si xoogan u soo baxa xumbaale, ka dibna waxay si tartiib ah u joogsataa sababtoo ah dusha dhagaxa waxaa ku samaysma lakab kalsiyam sulfate oo aan si buuxda u milmin; tani waa aasaaska caan ah ee lagu doorto aashitada la isticmaalo samaynta gaaska mukhbarka.
objectives: La eego sida soo-saarka gaaska uu ka dhaqso u noqdo mid tartiib ah oo xitaa joosto
Lagu fahmo sida walxaha milmida yar oo lakab ah u xanibayaan falcelka
Lagu sharaxo sababta mukhbarka loo isticmaalin aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) markii carbon dioxide (CO₂) la samaynayo

citric-carbonate-fizz.title: Falcelka xumbaalaha ee citric acid iyo sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃)
citric-carbonate-fizz.description: Markii citric acid iyo sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) la isku daro oo biyo lagu daro, isla markiiba waxaa si badan u soo baxa xumbaale; tani waa qaacidada aasaasiga ah ee baastoonka xumbaalaha leh, waxaana lagu isticmaali karaa in lagu muujiyo in aashitada daciifka ah oo nooca cuntada ah ay xitaa kari karto in ay ka beddesho kaarboonayta.
objectives: La eego sida aashitada daciifka ah ee dabiiciga ah uga saarto gaaska sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃)
Lagu fahmo xudunta uu ku dhaqmo mabda'a «aashitada xoogga leh ayaa saarto aashitada daciifka ah» oo ku soo kordheysa
Loo xidho isticmaalka baastoonka xumbaalaha leh ee nolosha maalmeedka

phosphoric-limewater-turbid.title: Aasidda foosforik iyo biyo gaashaan ah oo soo saara kalsiyam foosfeyt oo aan si buuxda u milmin
phosphoric-limewater-turbid.description: Markii Aasidda foosforik lagu soo dhibto biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد) oo cad, dareeraha wuxuu ka noqdaa mid cad oo daahsoon, kalsiyam foosfeyt-kana wuu milmaa si yar; tani waa aasaaska kimikaad ee diyaarinta bacrimaha foosforka.
objectives: La eego sida daahnaanta ay ugu soo biirto hannaanka neefsiga
Lagu garto milmida yar ee kalsiyam foosfeyt
Loo xidho mabda'a waxsoosaarka bacriminta kalsiyam foosfeyt-ka oo badan

sulfuric-ammonia-fertilizer.title: Soo-saarka Amooniyam Sulfeeт adigoo isticmaalaya aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) iyo gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas)
sulfuric-ammonia-fertilizer.description: Xalka ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) ayaa si tartiib tartiib ah loogu daraa aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la wasakheeyay, taasoo kulaylka sii daaysa oo soo-saarta Amooniyam sulfeeт; ka dib markii la qalajiyaa ayaa dhalaalayaasha cad la helo, waxayna tahay dariiqa ugu caansan ee warshadaha bacriminta nitrogen-ka lagu hagaajiyo.
objectives: Fahamka muhiimadda warshadeed ee aashidu ku leedahay nuugista gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas)
La socodsiga kulaylka soo-baxa ee neetralizaadka iyo dhalaalaynta crystalline-ka
Xisaabinta wax-soo-saarka theoretical-ka ee Amooniyam sulfeeт la soo-saaro

litmus-ammonia-blue.title: Litmus-ka guduudiga ah oo ku beddela buluug xalka ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood)
litmus-ammonia-blue.description: Litmus-ka guduudiga ah ayaa markiiba u beddela buluug marka la rido xalka ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) oo la wasakheeyay; marka la sifeeyaa ayaa caabuqa buluugga fiifsanaanayaa, taasoo tilmaamaysa in xoogga alkalinity-ga aasaaska daciifka ahi si qiyaas ah loo cabbiri karo midabka muujinaha.
objectives: Bartida midabka litmus xaaladaha alkaline-ka
La socodsiga saamaynta sifeyntu ku leedahay qoto-dheerida muujinta midabka
Fahamka in muujinayaashu ay kaliya si tayo-ahaan ah u go'aamiyaan dabeecadda aashitada iyo aasaaska

phenolphthalein-koh-red.title: Muujinta midabka phenolphthalein xalka potassium hydroxide
phenolphthalein-koh-red.description: Phenolphthalein ayaa u beddela casaan marka la kulmo xalka potassium hydroxide, markaasna dib ugu noqota midab la'aanta markii aashitada hydrochloric ah (HCl) ku filan la daro; beddelaanku waa soo-noqnoqosho leh, taasoo muujinaysa rogrogista midabka ee muujinayaasha.
objectives: La socodsiga muujinta midabka casaanka ah ee phenolphthalein xaaladda alkaline-ka
Xaqiijinta soo-noqoshada beddelaanka midabka muujinayaasha
Fahamka in kala-duwanaanshaha midab-beddelaanka phenolphthalein ay ku dhacdo dhinaca alkaline-ka

methyl-orange-sulfuric-red.title: Methyl orange oo ku beddela casaan aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄)
methyl-orange-sulfuric-red.description: Methyl orange ayaa aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo la wasakheeyay kaga beddeshaa oranji u beddela casaan, taasoo la barbar dhigta beddelashada jaallada ee uu ku samaystaa sodium hydroxide (NaOH) xaaladda alkaline-ka, kaasoo caddeynaya in kala-duwanaanshaha midab-beddelaankiisu uu ku dhaco gobolka acidic-ka.
objectives: Bartida saddexda marxalood ee midabka methyl orange
Fahamka xiriirka u dhexeeya kala-duwanaanshaha midab-beddelaanka iyo doorashada muujinayaasha
Doorbidista muujinayaasha ku haboon titration-ka aashitada xooggan ee aasaaska daciifka

ammonium-chloride-dissolve-cooling.title: Qaboojinta xal-bixinta ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl)
ammonium-chloride-dissolve-cooling.description: Marka crystal-yada ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) biyaha ku xalaan, thermometer-ka ayaa si cad u muujiya hoos-u-dhac kulayleed oo la xiriira qoyaan-bixinta darbiga koobka, taasoo ah caddayn toos ah oo muujinaysa in xal-bixintu ay leedahay saamayn kulayleed.
objectives: Cabbirka hoos-u-dhaca kuleylka xal-bixinta inta lagu jiro hannaanka
Kala-soocida kulaylka xal-bixinta iyo kulaylka falcelinta
Sharaxaada sababta ay xalkaملحyada ammonium ay ku yeelan karto dabeecad acidic ah

ammonium-sulfate-base-ammonia.title: Amooniyam sulfeeт iyo aasaasku oo gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) soo saara marka la kululeeyaa
ammonium-sulfate-base-ammonia.description: Amooniyam sulfeeт marka la isku daro Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد oo marka yar la kululeeyaa, ayaa sii daaya gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) ee ur daran, taasoo warqadda litmus ee cas (red litmus paper) oo qoyan u beddeshaa buluug, waxayna u adeegta hubinta ملحyada ammonium.
objectives: Bartida habka hubinta ملحyada ammonium
La socodsiga sida gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) uu warqadda litmus ee cas (red litmus paper) oo qoyan u beddelo buluug
Sharaxaada sababta aan bacriminta nitrogen-ka ah ee ammonium loo isku wadin bacriminta alkaline ah

nitric-carbonate-strong-weak.title: Aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) iyo sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃): soo-saarka aashitada daciifka aashitada xooggan
nitric-carbonate-strong-weak.description: Marka aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) la rido xalka sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃), ayaa si xoogan gaas u soo baxa, taasoo caddeynaysa in xoogga aashida aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) uu ka sarreeyo karbooniga, waxayna tahay tusaale kale oo xeerka «aashitada xooggan ayaa soo-saarta aashitada daciifka» ku saabsan.
objectives: Xaqiijinta xeerka soo-saarka aashitada daciifka aashitada xooggan
Is-barbardhigga xoogga aashida ee aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) iyo karbooniga
Qorista isla-miisaanku u dhigma ee ionic equation-ka

sodium-sulfite-acid-so2.title: Sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) iyo aashitada oo sulfur dioxide soo-saara
sodium-sulfite-acid-so2.description: Sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) marka la kulmo aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) ayaa sii daaya sulfur dioxide oo ur daran, kaasoo kala-midabeynta fuchsine baabbi'iya; waxayna tahay habka fudud ee xannaanada shaybaarka lagu soo-saaro yar yar oo sulfur dioxide ah.
objectives: Bartida falcelinta gas-soo-saarka ee ملحyada sulfite marka la kulmo aashitada
Aqoonsiga awoodda caddaynta ee sulfur dioxide
Bartida isticmaalka xalka alkaline ee lagu nuugo dheereeye-gaaska (tail gas) ee sulfur dioxide

aluminum-naoh-hydrogen.title: Laba-dhinacnimada Aluminium: Falcelinta Kaadiga Xoogga ah oo Soo Saarta Hydrogen
aluminum-naoh-hydrogen.description: Marka xaashi aluminium ah la dhigo Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد, ayaa gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) si joogto ah u soo baxa oo kulaylna soo baxa, taas oo muujinaysa in aluminium labada dhinac leeyahay — waxay ku milmaysaa labadaba asiidhka iyo kaadiga xoogga ah, kaas oo ah caddayn toos ah oo ah birta labada-dhinac.
objectives: Indho-indheynta falcelinta aluminium iyo kaadiga xoogga ah ee soo saarta gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas)
Fahamka muujinta labada-dhinac ee aluminium
Is-barbardhigga kala-duwanaanshaha xawaaraha falcelinta aluminium marka uu la fal-galo asiidhka iyo kaadiga

magnesium-oxygen-white-light.title: Xarig Maqniisiyam ah oo Gubanaya Ogsijiin (O₂)
magnesium-oxygen-white-light.description: Marka xarig maqniisiyam ah la shido oo la galiyo dhalo uruurinta gaaska oo ka buuxda ogsijiin (O₂), ayaa iftiinka cad oo dhalaalaya soo baxa oo budo cad oo ah magnesium oxide (MgO) la samaysto; indhahaaga waxaa lagugu waaniyaa inaad adeegsato dhalo koobalt oo buluug ah si aad uga badbaadato.
objectives: Indho-indheynta gubidda xoogga ah ee magnesium ogsijiin (O₂) nadiif ah
Garan samayska oxide-yada biraha
Bartida talaabooyinka ilaalinta indhahaaga inta lagu jiro tijaabada iftiinka xoogga ah

sulfur-oxygen-blue-flame.title: Sulfar Budo ah oo Gubanaya Ogsijiin (O₂)
sulfur-oxygen-blue-flame.description: Marka Sulfar budo ah hawada caadiga ah ku gubato, dab buluug-cad ah ayaa soo baxaa, laakiin marka la galiyo ogsijiin (O₂) nadiif ah, dab iftiin leh oo buluug-geel ah ayaa soo muuqda oo sulfur dioxide oo ur xun leh la samaysto.
objectives: Is-barbardhigga dab-ka Sulfar budo ah markay hawada iyo ogsijiin (O₂) nadiif ah ku gubato
Garan irriteeshinta sulfur dioxide
Bartida habka lagu nuugyo gaaska sun-leh adoo isticmaalaya xalka kaadiga

iron-wire-oxygen-sparks.title: Xadhig Birta (Fe) oo Darar-darar ku Gubanaya Ogsijiin (O₂)
iron-wire-oxygen-sparks.description: Marka xadhig birta (Fe) oo wareegsan lana shido kibriid lagu xidho dhamaadkiisa la galiyo dhalo uruurinta gaaska oo ogsijiin (O₂) ah, ayaa gubashadu si xoogan u dhacaa oo dararku kor u baxaa, isagoo sameynaya birta oksiidka (iron(II,III) oxide / Fe₃O₄) madow ah; hoosta dhalada waa in ciid lagu daadsho si dhalada hoose loogu ilaalin karo.
objectives: Indho-indheynta gubidda xoogga ah ee bir (Fe) ogsijiin (O₂) nadiif ah
Fahamka saamaynta xoogga ogsijiin-ka ku leh xawaaraha gubashada
Bartida hawlgalka lagu daadsho ciidda si dhalada hoose loogu ilaalin karo fusaynta

charcoal-oxygen-white-glow.title: Xaabo (Charcoal) oo Gubanaya Ogsijiin (O₂)
charcoal-oxygen-white-glow.description: Marka xaabo (charcoal) cas-cas loo galiyo ogsijiin (O₂), ayaa iftiinka cad soo baxa; ka dib marka la shido, marka Biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد) nadiif ah lagu rido dhalooyada la qarxiyo ayay neefto madowdaa, taas oo xaqiijinaysa in badeecadda la soo saaro ay tahay carbon dioxide (CO₂).
objectives: Indho-indheynta gubidda cad ee xaabo (charcoal) ogsijiin (O₂) nadiif ah
Xaqiijinta badeecadda carboon dioxide (CO₂) ee la soo saaray
Is-barbardhigga muuqaalka guban-ka hawada iyo ogsijiin (O₂) nadiif ah

hydrogen-oxygen-quiet-flame.title: Gaaska Hydrogen (Hydrogen Gas) oo Si Degdeg ah Ogsijiin (O₂) ku Gubanaya
hydrogen-oxygen-quiet-flame.description: Gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) ka dib markii safinaad lagu xaqiijiyey, ayuu si xasilloon ugu gubaa ogsijiin (O₂) isagoo soo saranaya dab buluug-cad ah; marka koob kiimikaad qoyan oo qabow lagu dhajiyo, ayaa biyo la arki karaa oo ku uruuranaya derbigga gudaha.
objectives: Indho-indheynta dab-ka buluug-cad ee gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas)
Xaqiijinta in badeecadda tahay biyo adoo eegaya dhibicyada biyaha
Xoogga saarista muhiimadda xaqiijinta nadaafadda gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) ka hor intaan la shidin

hydrogen-reduce-fe2o3.title: Gaaska Hydrogen (Hydrogen Gas) oo Yareyneya iron(III) oxide
hydrogen-reduce-fe2o3.description: Marka gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) engegsan la marsho iron(III) oxide cas-huruud ah oo la kululeysiiyey, ayaa walaxda adag si tartiib ah u madoobaataa oo dhibicyo biyo ah oo koob kiimikaad ah ku muuqdaan dhamaadka tuubbada; habka saxda ah waa in marka hore gaaska la mariyo ka dib qabashada nalka kululaynta.
objectives: Xaqiijinta awoodda yaraynta ee gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas)
Indho-indheynta isbeddel-midabka ee iron(III) oxide markay yaraato
Bartida nidaamka hawlgalka si looga hortago qarxida

co-reduce-cuo-tail-gas.title: Carbon Monoxide (CO) oo Yareyneya copper(II) oxide iyo Maareynta Gaaska Dambiga ah
co-reduce-cuo-tail-gas.description: Marka carbon monoxide (CO) la marsho copper(II) oxide madow oo la kululeysiiyey, ayaa walaxda adag geel-casaan ah noqotaa; gaaska dambiga ah waa in si waajib ah loo shidaa ama la ururiyaa — weligiis lama daayee si toos ah — taas oo ah tusaale hore ee maareynta gaaska dambiga ah ee sun-leh.
objectives: Xaqiijinta awoodda yaraynta ee carbon monoxide (CO)
Xaqiijinta badeecadda carbon dioxide (CO₂)
Fahamka sababta looga maareynayo gaaska dambiga ah ee sun-leh

chlorine-naoh-bleach-liquid.title: Gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) iyo Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد si loo sameeyo dareeraha cadeeynta
chlorine-naoh-bleach-liquid.description: Gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) midabka jaalle-cagaaran ah marka la geliyo Xalka soodyam hаydrooksiiد, midabku si dhakhso ah ayuu u baaba'aa oo la samaysaa sodium hypochlorite (NaClO) oo ah dareeraha cadeeynta; tani waxay sidoo kale ka mid tahay habka caadiga ah ee lagu nadiifiyo dhamaadka gaaska chlorine (Cl₂).
objectives: La socoshada baaba'ida midabka jaalle-cagaaran marka gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) uu kaarboonka ku nuugto
Fahanka doorka cadeeynta ee saldhiga hypochlorite
Bartida habka lagu nuugo dhamaadka gaaska chlorine (Cl₂)

chlorine-lime-bleaching-powder.title: Gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) iyo caanaha nuuriyada (lime milk / calcium hydroxide suspension) si loo sameeyo budo cadeeyn
chlorine-lime-bleaching-powder.description: Gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) marka la geliyo caanaha nuuriyada (lime milk / calcium hydroxide suspension), nidaamka dareeraha ah ee daahsan ayaa nuugta gaaska, midabka jaalle-cagaaranna wuu baaba'aa, taas oo keenaysa budo cadeeyn oo ay ku jirto calcium hypochlorite ahaan qaybtii waxtar lahayd.
objectives: Fahamka mabaadi'da sameeynta budo cadeeynta warshadaha
Aqoonsiga calcium hypochlorite inuu yahay qaybtii waxtar lahayd
Sharaxaadda sababta loo baahan yahay in budo cadeeynta si adag loogu xidho weelka

ammonia-water-fountain.title: Tijaabada biyaha boodda ee gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas)
ammonia-water-fountain.description: Marka dhalo af wareegsan oo buuxda gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) lagu xidho biyo, gaaska ayaa si sahlan ugu dhalaala biyaha, cadaadiska gudaha dhalada ayaa si deg-deg ah hoos ugu dhaca, biyuhuna waxaa ku soo rida cadaadiska jawiga si ay u sameeyaan biyaha boodda; marka phenolphthalein lagu daro, xalku guduud ayuu noqdaa.
objectives: Fahamka mabaadi'da cadaadiska ee tijaabada biyaha boodda
Xaqiijinta in xal amooniyaaka ah (NH₃ biyood) uu yahay aasaasi
Aqoonsiga dabeecadda gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) ee si aad ah ugu dhalaasha biyaha

ammonia-hcl-white-smoke.title: Gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) iyo gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) hydrogen chloride waxay sameeyaan ceeryaan cad
ammonia-hcl-white-smoke.description: Laba ul dhalo ah oo kala mid la duuftay xalliga amooniyaaka oo xooggan (concentrated ammonia solution) iyo hydrochloric acid dhumuc badan (concentrated hydrochloric acid) marka la isugu dhowaado, hawada dhexdeeda ayaa si deg-deg ah u soo baxa ceeryaan cad oo badan oo ah ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl); tani waa muujinta caanka ah ee loo isticmaalo laba-dhinacba si ay is-cadeeyaan.
objectives: La socoshada falcelinta u dhaxeysa labada gaas ee soo saareysa ceeryaanka cad ee adag
Bartida habka loo isticmaalo gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) iyo hydrogen chloride inay is-cadeeyaan
Kala soocida mafhumyada ceeryaanka cad iyo ceeryaanka cagaaran

copper-air-heating-black.title: Naxaas (Cu) marka la kululeeyo hawada ayuu madow noqdaa
copper-air-heating-black.description: Xaashi naxaas ah midabka guduudan marka la gaabiyo laambad alkohol, dusha korkeeda ayay si tartiib ah u madowdaa oo la samaysaa copper(II) oxide; marka dib gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) lagu marsado, waxay dib ugu noqotaa midabka guduud, taasoo samaysa wareegga oxidation-reduction.
objectives: La socoshada isbedelka midabka marka naxaas (Cu) uu ogsijiin (O₂) ku soo oxidaan
Aqoonsiga oxiidka labada walxood ee naxaasta
Diyaarinta tijaabada wareegga oxidation-reduction

ethanol-oxygen-combustion.title: Gubashada buuxda ee ethanol (C₂H₅OH) ogsijiin (O₂) gudihiis
ethanol-oxygen-combustion.description: Ethanol (C₂H₅OH) marka ogsijiin (O₂) ku filan la gubo, waxaa soo baxa olol midab buluug-cad ah, soo saaraha waa carbon dioxide (CO₂) iyo biyo, dab-cabbiradiisuna waa sare oo aan ceeryaan madow lahayn, taasoo ka dhigaysa tusaale fiican oo shidaal nadiif ah.
objectives: La socoshada oollka gubashada buuxda ee ethanol (C₂H₅OH)
Hubinta soo saaraha gubashada
Is-barbardhigga muujinta gubashada buuxda iyo ta aan buuxda ahayn

sodium-oxygen-peroxide.title: Birta sodium (sodium metal) marka ogsijiin (O₂) la gubo waxay samaysaa sodium peroxide
sodium-oxygen-peroxide.description: Birta sodium (sodium metal) marka hawada caadiga ah si tartiib ah loo oxideeyo, kaliya ayaa la heli karaa soodiyamka oksiidka (sodium oxide) cad; laakiin marka la kululeeyo oo la shito, waxaa soo baxa olol jaalle ah oo la samaysaa sodium peroxide midabka jaalle-caddaanka ah, taasoo caddaynaysa in xaaladaha falcelinta ay go'aankeeda ku leedahay soo saaraha.
objectives: Fahamka saamaynta xaaladaha falcelinta ee soo saaraha
La socoshada oollka jaalle ee gubashada birta sodium (sodium metal)
Bartida habka saxda ah ee lagu qaato oo lagu keydsado biraha firfircoon

sodium-sulfide-acid-h2s.title: Sodium sulfide (sodium sulfide, Na₂S) iyo aashito samaysta gaaska hydrogen sulfide
sodium-sulfide-acid-h2s.description: Solid-ka sodium sulfide (sodium sulfide, Na₂S) marka la siiyo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) dillacsan, waxaa soo baxa gaas hydrogen sulfide ah oo udgoon sida ukunta qudhuntay; gaaska marka la geliyo xal copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), waxaa la samaysaa rasaas madow ah, hawshana waa in laga qabtaa gol hawo-mareenka leh.
objectives: Bartida habka tijaabada ee lagu sameeyo gaaska hydrogen sulfide
Isticmaalka milixda biraha culus si loo xaqiijiyo gaaska hydrogen sulfide
Hirgelinta tallaabooyinka hawo-marinta iyo nuugista ee gaasyada sun ah

bisulfite-acid-so2.title: Sodium bisulfite iyo aashito si loo sameeyo sulfur dioxide
bisulfite-acid-so2.description: Markii sodium bisulfite (NaHSO₃) la kulmo aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo daciif ah, ayaa si degdeg ah sulfur dioxide soo baxa oo kulaylku kororaa; gaaskaasi wuxuu midabka xalka fuchsin ka saari karaa, laakiin marka la kululeeyo midabku mar kale ayuu soo noqdaa.
objectives: Bartid habka fudud ee lagu sameeyo sulfur dioxide
Xaqiijinta in xasaarida midabka ee sulfur dioxide ay tahay mid la rogrog karo
Bartid sida lagu nuugsado dambaska gaaska ee xalka alkali ah

iron-sulfide-acid-h2s.title: Birta(II) sulfiiد iyo aashito si loo sameeyo hydrogen sulfide
iron-sulfide-acid-h2s.description: Birta(II) sulfiiد oo dhagax-u-eg ah ayaa la falgalaa aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) oo daciif ah gudaha soo-saarka Kipp; tani waxay si fudud u oggolaataa in la xukumo soo-saarka iyo joojinta hydrogen sulfide, taasoo ku muujineysa nidaamka la-xukumi karo ee sayniska gaaska.
objectives: Bartid shuruudaha lagu isticmaalo soo-saarka Kipp
Fahamka sababta oo ah in walxaha adkaha ee dhagax-u-eg ah ay fududeeyaan bilowga iyo joojinta waqti kasta
Dabagalida tallaabooyinka ammaanka ee ku saabsan hydrogen sulfide

ammonia-nitric-acid-smoke.title: Gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) iyo aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) oo soo saara Amooniyam nayitrееt oo ah qiiq cad
ammonia-nitric-acid-smoke.description: Gaaska ka uumi kara xalliga amooniyaaka oo xooggan (concentrated ammonia solution) iyo Aasidda nayitariik ah oo dhumuc leh marka ay isku kulmaan ayay soo saaraan qiiq cad oo ah Amooniyam nayitrееt; falcalinta waxay soo daaysaa kulaylka, waxayna u tahay muuqaal yar oo tilmaamaya habka warshadaha lagu sameeyo bacriminta ammonium nitrate.
objectives: Daawashada falcalinta qiiqa oo u dhaxaysa aashitada la kari karo iyo gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas)
Xiriirinta habka warshadaha lagu sameeyo bacrimaha ammonium nitrate
Fahamka ah in qiiqa cad uu yahay muraayadaha yaryar ee kursiga hawo ku jira

co2-baoh2-precipitate.title: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) oo la geliyay xal barium hydroxide ah
co2-baoh2-precipitate.description: Marka carbon dioxide (CO₂) la geliyo xal barium hydroxide ah, ayaa dallacaad cad oo barium carbonate ah si degdeg ah u soo baxa; habkani waa mid ka xasaasi badan biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد); haddii gaas dheeraad ah la sii geliyo, dallacaaduhu mar kale ayay ku milmaan xalka.
objectives: Barbar-dhigga xasaasiyada xalka barium hydroxide iyo biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد) markii lagu tijaabinayo carbon dioxide (CO₂)
Daawashada soo-baxa dallacaadka ka dib baabi'istiisa
Qoritaanka isle'egta falcalinta markii carbon dioxide (CO₂) la dheereeyo

co2-koh-pressure-drop.title: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) oo potassium hydroxide nuugsatay oo keenay in dhalo caag jilicsan uu dhuunto
co2-koh-pressure-drop.description: Dhalo caag jilicsan oo buuxda carbon dioxide (CO₂) ah marka xal potassium hydroxide ah lagu shubto oo daboolka la xidho la garaacana, ayaa gaaska la nuugsadaa, cadaadiska gudaha dhalada aad u hoos u dhacaa, oo dhaladu si cad u dhuuntaa.
objectives: Isticmaalka isbedelka cadaadiska si loo xaqiijiyo nuugsiga gaaska
Barbar-dhigga kala duwanaanshaha milmidda carbon dioxide (CO₂) gudaha biyaha iyo gudaha xalka alkali ah
Naqshadeynta tijaabada la barbardhigo si looga saaro khilaafka ee ku saabsan milmidda biyaha

bicarbonate-acetic-fizz.title: Sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) iyo aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) oo soo saara gaas
bicarbonate-acetic-fizz.description: Markii sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) ee cuntada la isticmaalo la kulmo khal cuntada, ayaa si degdeg ah bubuqyo badan soo baxa; tani waa falcalin soo-saarka gaaska oo si fudud guriga looga heli karo, waxaana lagu isticmaali karaa in lagu qiyaaso nadiifnimada sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃).
objectives: Daawashada soo-saarka gaaska marka aashitada daciifka ah la falgaliyo bicarbonate
Xiriirinta isticmaalka guri ee boodh-khamiirka
Qiyaasida xajmiga gaaska si loo ogaado tirakoobka sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃)

ammonium-chloride-lime-ammonia.title: Ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) iyo baaruuda gaashaan oo la kululeeyay si loo sameeyo gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas)
ammonium-chloride-lime-ammonia.description: Marka ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) iyo baaruuda gaashaan la isku qaso la kululeeyona, ayaa gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) soo baxa; falcalintu waxay u baahan tahay kululayn joogto ah sababtoo ah waxay nuugtaa kulaylka; tani waa habka caadiga ah ee sheybaarka lagu sameeyo gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas).
objectives: Bartid habka sheybaarka lagu sameeyo gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas)
Fahamka sababta oo ah in lagu ururiyo gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) hab hawo-ka-erida hoos-u-jeedda
Bartid tijaabinta iyo qalajinta gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas)

lead-iodide-golden-rain.title: «Roobka dahab-u-eg» ee lead(II) iodide
lead-iodide-golden-rain.description: Markii xal lead(II) nitrate ah iyo xal potassium iodide (KI) ah la isku daro, ayaa si degdeg ah dallacaad jaalle-iftiin ah oo lead(II) iodide ah soo baxa; marka la kululeeyona dallacaadku milmaa, ka dibna haddii si gaaban loo qaboojiyona ayuu mar kale u dallacaadaa isaga soo saara warqado saddex-geesood oo dahab-u-eg oo dilaacsan.
objectives: Daawashada soo-baxa dallacaadka jaalle-iftiin ah ee lead(II) iodide
Fahamka sida isbedelka milmida heerkulka uu keeno dib-u-dallacaadka
Barbar-dhigga muuqaalka dallacaadka aan qaab lahayn iyo dallacaadka qaabaysan

silver-carbonate-precipitate.title: Sameynta iyo Kala-jabinta Lacagta Kaarbooneetka
silver-carbonate-precipitate.description: Silver nitrate (AgNO₃) iyo sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) waxay sameeyaan xad-dhaafka cad ee lacagta kaarbooneetka (silver carbonate), kaas oo kulaylka ama iftiinka ku kala jabaya oo madoobaada, taasoo muujinaysa in cusbitada lacagtu guud ahaan aan xasilloonayn.
objectives: Daawashada sameynta lacagta kaarbooneetka (silver carbonate)
Aqoonsiga xasilloon-la'aanta cusbitada lacagta
Qorista isla-sameynta ionka ee sameynta lacagta kaarbooneetka (silver carbonate)

barium-carbonate-vs-sulfate.title: Barbaraadinta Kala-dhaqnaanta Aashitada ee Barium Carbonate iyo Barium Sulfate
barium-carbonate-vs-sulfate.description: Sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) iyo sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄) waxaa si gooni-gooni ah loogu daraa barium nitrate (Ba(NO₃)₂) si loo sameeyo laba xad-dhaaf oo cad, kadibna waxaa lagu daraa aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid): barium carbonate wuu dhalaalaa isagoo gaas soo saara, halka barium sulfate uusan dhalalin, taasoo kala soocida u oggolanaysa.
objectives: Sameynta laba xad-dhaaf oo cad oo barium ah
Adeegsiga kala-dhaqnaanta aashitada si loo kala sooco kaarbooneetka iyo sulfate
Fahamka ah in baarista xidhmada sulfate ay qasab tahay in marka hore la saaro xidhmada kaarbooneetka

barium-sulfite-precipitate.title: Sameynta Xad-dhaafka Barium Sulfite iyo Oksidayntiisa
barium-sulfite-precipitate.description: Barium chloride (BaCl₂) iyo sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) waxay sameeyaan xad-dhaaf cad oo barium sulfite ah, markii hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) lagu daro oo la oksideeyo wuxuu u beddelaa barium sulfate oo aashitada ku aan dhalaalin, taasoo ah caddayn xad-dhaaf ah oo muujinaysa isbedelka darajada valency-ga sulfar.
objectives: Sameynta xad-dhaafka barium sulfite
Daawashada isbedelka kala-dhaqnaanta aashitada ka dib oksidaynta xad-dhaafka
Fahamka shuruudaha u oggolaanaya u-beddelida xad-dhaafka

zinc-hydroxide-amphoteric.title: Kala-dhaqnaanta Laba-geesoodka ee Sinkyga Hiidrooksaydka (Zinc Hydroxide)
zinc-hydroxide-amphoteric.description: Zinc sulfate oo lagu daro sodium hydroxide (NaOH) oo yar wuxuu sameeya xad-dhaaf cad oo sinkyga hiidrooksaydka (zinc hydroxide) ah, markii aasalka dheeraadka ah lagu siiyo wuxuu dib u dhalaalaadaa, taasoo muujinaysa dabeecadda laba-geesoodka ah oo la mid ah ta aluminium.
objectives: Daawashada xad-dhaafka horeba u sameeya kadibna u dhalaalaa
Aqoonsiga laba-geesoodka sinkyga hiidrooksaydka (zinc hydroxide)
Barbaraadinta astaanta hiidrooksaydka zinc iyo aluminium

cobalt-hydroxide-pink.title: Xad-dhaafka Guduudka-Cagaarka ah ee Cobalt Hydroxide
cobalt-hydroxide-pink.description: Xalliga cobalt(II) chloride markii sodium hydroxide (NaOH) lagu daro wuxuu sameeya xad-dhaaf guduud-cagaar ah oo cobalt hydroxide ah, marka muddo lagu reebo hawada waxaa oksideeya hawadu isagoo u beddelaya midab madow-bunni, taasoo muujinaysa astaanta cobalt ee isbeddelka valency.
objectives: Daawashada sameynta xad-dhaafka guduud-cagaarka ah ee cobalt hydroxide
Aqoonsiga midabada calaamadeed ee hiidrooksaydka macadanku-gudbiye (transition metal)
Fahamka sababta midabku u qoto-dheeraado oksidaynta hawada awgeed

nickel-hydroxide-green.title: Xad-dhaafka Cagaarka Tufaaxda ah ee Niikelka Hiidrooksaydka (Nickel(II) Hydroxide)
nickel-hydroxide-green.description: Xalliga nickel(II) chloride markii aasalka lagu daro wuxuu sameeya xad-dhaaf cagaar-tufaax ah oo niikelka hiidrooksaydka (nickel(II) hydroxide) ah, taasoo ah astaanta muhiimka ah ee aqoonsiga tayada ee ionka niikel, waxaana sidoo kale looga faa'iidaystaa agabka kutubta togan ee baatariiga nickel-hydrogen.
objectives: Daawashada sameynta xad-dhaafka cagaarka-tufaaxda ah
Bartida astaanta tayada ee ionka niikel
Xiriirinta agabka kutubta ee baatariiga nickel-hydrogen

copper-sulfide-black.title: Xad-dhaafka Madow ee Copper Sulfide
copper-sulfide-black.description: Xalliga copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) markii sodium sulfide (sodium sulfide, Na₂S) lagu daro wuxuu si deg-deg ah u sameeya copper sulfide madow oo aad u aan dhalaalin, xataa markii aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) lagu daro ma dhalaalo, taasoo muujinaysa in alaabadeeda solubility-product ay aad u yar tahay.
objectives: Daawashada sameynta xad-dhaafka madow ee copper sulfide
Fahamka ah in xad-dhaafyada solubility-product-koodu aad u yar yahay aysan ku dhalalin aashitada xoogga leh
Bartida habka sameynta xad-dhaafka sulfide ee ionka macadanka culus

silver-sulfide-tarnish.title: Silver Sulfide iyo Madoobaadka Dheefshiidka Lacagta
silver-sulfide-tarnish.description: Silver nitrate (AgNO₃) markii uu la kulmo sodium sulfide (sodium sulfide, Na₂S) wuxuu sameeya silver sulfide (Ag₂S) madow, taasoo ah sababta kiimikada ee lacagta xidmaddu marka muddo lagu reebo walxaha ku jira sulfar u madoobaato; warqadda aluminium (aluminium foil) iyo xalliga cusbitada (salt water / brine) waxaa loo isticmaali karaa soo-celinta.
objectives: Daawashada sameynta silver sulfide (Ag₂S) madow
Sharaxaadda sababta madoobaadka dheefshiidka lacagta
Naqshadaynta habka electrokiimikada ee warqadda aluminium (aluminium foil) ee nadiifinta khaynka

lead-sulfide-detection.title: Ogaanshaha Ioniga Rasaasta Adoo Isticmaalaya Barqada Sulfide-ka
lead-sulfide-detection.description: Biyaha qashinka ah ee ka kooban rasaasta markaa lagu daro sodium sulfide (sodium sulfide, Na₂S) ayaa si xidid ah loo soo saaro barqo madow oo sulfide ah. Habkani waa mid aad u xasaasi ah, waxaana loo isticmaalaa si caadi ah daaweynta biyaha qashinka ee macadanta culus.
objectives: Ku bartid tijaabinta ioniga rasaasta (lead) adoo isticmaalaya sulfide-ka
Fahmid sida habka barqada sulfide-ku u daweeyso biyaha qashinka ee macadanta culus
Aqoonsiga waxyeellada wasakhda rasaasta

calcium-fluoride-precipitate.title: Barqada Calcium Fluoride iyo Daaweynta Biyaha Fluoride-ka
calcium-fluoride-precipitate.description: Markaa soodyam flarooriid xal ah lagu daro calcium chloride (CaCl₂), ayaa barqo cad oo calcium fluoride ah soo baxa. Habkani waa hab caadi ah oo warshadaha loogu isticmaalo daweynta biyaha qashinka ee fluoride-ka, waxaana waliba uu yahay qayb weyn oo ka mid ah macdanta fluorite.
objectives: La socodsii soo saarista calcium fluoride
Fahmid fikradda xagga kimikada ee habka "lime method" ee lagu saaro fluoride-ka
Xidhiidhi walxaha la soo saaray iyo qaabka macdanta fluorite

calcium-phosphate-bone.title: Barqada Calcium Phosphate iyo Xubinta Lafaha
calcium-phosphate-bone.description: Markaa sodium phosphate lagu daro calcium chloride (CaCl₂), ayaa barqo cad oo calcium phosphate ah soo baxa. Walxahan waa walxaha inorganic ee ugu badan ee ka kooban lafaha iyo ilkaha, waxaana sidoo kale loo isticmaala diyaarinta bacriminta superphosphate.
objectives: La socodsii soo saarista calcium phosphate
Aqoonsiga doorka uu ku leeyahay jidhka noolaha
Xaqiiji in calcium phosphate la kari karo aashitada xoogga badan

silver-phosphate-yellow.title: Barqada Jaallaha ah ee Silver Phosphate
silver-phosphate-yellow.description: Markaa sodium phosphate la kulmaan silver nitrate (AgNO₃), ayaa barqo huruud ah oo silver phosphate ah soo baxa, oo ka dhammaanaysa Lacag (silfar) iyo phosphate. Barqadaasi waxay ku milmi kartaa aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid), taasi oo ah farqi muhiim ah oo loo garan karo phosphate ion-ka marka la barbardhigo halogen ion-yada.
objectives: La socodsii soo saarista barqada jaallaha ah ee silver phosphate
U isticmaal aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid) si aad uga soocdo silver phosphate iyo silver halide
Ku bartid tijaabinta munaasabadda ee phosphate ion-ka

magnesium-carbonate-precipitate.title: Barqada Magnesium Carbonate iyo Ururinta Maagnisiyamka
magnesium-carbonate-precipitate.description: Markaa xal ah oo Maagnisiyam sulfeet ku jiro lagu daro sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃), ayaa barqo cad oo magnesium carbonate ah soo baxa. Gubashadeedii dambe waxay soo saartaa magnesium oxide (MgO), taasi oo ah mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinka muhiimka ah ee lagu soo saaro maagnisiyamka brine-ka.
objectives: La socodsii soo saarista magnesium carbonate
Fahmid sida habka barqadu ugu urursato maagnisiyamka
Ku bartid hawlgalka isku xidnaanta sayniska ee filtering-ga iyo gubashada

zinc-sulfide-white.title: Barqada Cad ee Zinc Sulfide
zinc-sulfide-white.description: Markaa zinc sulfate lagu daro sodium sulfide (sodium sulfide, Na₂S), ayaa barqo cad oo zinc sulfide ah soo baxa. Midabkeeda cad ayaa si cad uga duwan midabka mugdiga ah ee sulfide-yada macadanta culus ee kale, taasi oo u ogolaanaysa in ay loo isticmaalo kala-soocidda kooxaha cation-yada.
objectives: La socodsii soo saarista barqada cad ee zinc sulfide
Barbar dhig midabada kala duwan ee barqooyinka sulfide
Fahmid fikradda falanqaynta ee kala-soocidda kooxaha sulfide

calcium-sulfite-flue-gas.title: Barqada Calcium Sulfite iyo Nadiifinta Qiiqa Dacalaha
calcium-sulfite-flue-gas.description: Markaa calcium chloride (CaCl₂) lagu daro sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃), ayaa barqo cad oo calcium sulfite ah soo baxa. Tijaabadani waxay modeelaysaa habka saldhigga u ah nadiifinta qiiqa adoo isticmaalaya habka "lime method." Walxaha la soo saaraa markay oxidized yihiin waxay noqdaan gypsum.
objectives: La socodsii soo saarista calcium sulfite
Fahmid mabaadi'da kimikada ee habka lime-ka ee nadiifinta SO₂-ka
Aqoonsiga faa'iidada dib-u-isticmaalka gypsum-ka nadiifinta ka yimaada

lead-sulfate-white.title: Barqada Cad ee Sulfate Rasaasta
lead-sulfate-white.description: Markaa lead(II) nitrate lagu daro sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄), ayaa barqo cad oo rasaasta (lead) sulfate ah soo baxa. Walxahan ayaa ku dhejinaya labada kutubka bataariga lead-acid-ka xilliga shaqada, taasi oo ah sababta tooska ah ee gaabiska bataariga.
objectives: La socodsii soo saarista sulfate rasaasta
Xidhiidhi walxaha soo saarma iyo waxyaabaha ka soo baxa shaqada bataariga lead-acid
Fahmid sida sulfate-ka ugu keeno hoos u dhaca awoodda bataariga

barium-phosphate-precipitate.title: Baruurta Barium Phosphate iyo Saarista Fosfooraska
barium-phosphate-precipitate.description: Sodium phosphate markay la falgasho barium chloride (BaCl₂) waxay samaystaa baruur cad oo barium phosphate ah, taasoo loo isticmaali karo daraasadda tirada ee saarista fosfooraska biyaha, si looga hortago hodmida nafaqada (eutrophication).
objectives: Indho-indheynta samaynta baruurta barium phosphate
Fahamka mabaadi'da kiimikada ee saarista fosfooraska
Xiriirinta daaweynta hodmida nafaqada ee xaafadaha biyaha

iron-carbonate-precipitate.title: Samaynta Baruurta Iron(II) Carbonate iyo Oksidhiinteeda
iron-carbonate-precipitate.description: Iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄) markay la falgasho sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) waxay samaystaa baruur cad oo iron(II) carbonate ah, kaas oo hawada ku wareegsan si deg-deg ah u noqda midab huruud-cawl, taasoo tilmaamaysa in iron(II) ay fududahay in la oksidheeyo.
objectives: Indho-indheynta samaynta baruurta iron(II) carbonate iyo beddelkeeda midabka
Fahamka fududaanshaha oksidhiinta ion-ka iron(II) (Fe²⁺)
Bartida hab-maamuska diyaarinta xaaladaha iron(II) adigoo ka hortaganaya hawada

basic-copper-carbonate-patina.title: Naxaas Carbonate Aasaasiga ah iyo Midabka Cagaaran ee Naxaasta
basic-copper-carbonate-patina.description: Copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) markay la falgasho xal sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) waxay samaystaan naxaas carbonate aasaasiga ah oo midab cagaar ah leh, taasoo ah qayb weyn ka mid ah midabka cagaaran ee dusha naxaasta, waana waxay kulaylku kala jebiso si ay u noqoto copper(II) oxide oo madow.
objectives: Indho-indheynta samaynta naxaas carbonate aasaasiga ah ee midabka cagaaran
Sharaxaadda sababta u ah samaynta midabka cagaaran ee dusha naxaasta
Indho-indheynta kala jabinta kulaylka oo keenta copper(II) oxide oo madow

silver-sulfate-slightly-soluble.title: Dhacdada Xoogga-yar-Millaynta Silver Sulfate
silver-sulfate-slightly-soluble.description: Lacag (silfar) nitrate oo xooggan ayaa baruur cad oo silver sulfate ah ku samaysa oo kaliya marka la isticmaalo sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄) oo xooggan, halkii xalyada dabacsan ma samaystaan baruur, taasoo si cad u muujinaysa in «xoogga-yar-millaynta» ay u dhaxayso millaynta iyo aan-millaynta.
objectives: Fahamka ku-tiirsanaanshaha xoogga xalka ee walxaha xoogga-yar-milla
Is-barbardhigga dhacdooyinka xaaladaha labada xal ee dabacsan iyo xooggan
Bartida isticmaalka qiimaha solubility product si loo go'aamiyo haddii baruur samaysmi karaan

lead-chloride-hot-water.title: Millaynta Chloride-ka Raasaasta Biyaha Kulul
lead-chloride-hot-water.description: Lead(II) nitrate markay la falgasho sodium chloride (NaCl) waxay samaystaa baruur cad oo rasaasta (lead) chloride ah, kaas oo kulaylku milliyo oo dhaqso ah, markaana qaboowgu dib u keeno muruqyo yaryar oo qaab irbad ah, taasoo ka dhigaysa tusaale gaar ah oo millaynta ay aad uga badesho kuleylka.
objectives: Indho-indheynta millaynta baruurta kulaylka saameeysa iyo dib u soo muuqashadeeda qaboowga
Fahamka ku-tiirsanaanshaha millaynta heerkulka
Is-barbardhigga farqiga millaynta rasaasta (lead) chloride iyo lacagta kloriidhka (silver chloride)

mno2-concentrated-hcl-chlorine.title: Diyaarinta Gaaska Chlorine (Cl₂) Adoo Isticmaalaya Manganese(IV) Oxide iyo Hydrochloric Acid Dhumuc Badan
mno2-concentrated-hcl-chlorine.description: Marka la kululeeyo isku-darka manganese(IV) oxide (MnO₂) iyo hydrochloric acid dhumuc badan (concentrated hydrochloric acid), waxaa la arkaa gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) oo huruud-cagaar ah oo ka baxaya, taasoo fahamsiinaysa doorka go'aansiga ee xoogga xalka ku leeyahay falgashadda oksidhiinta-ho'siinta.
objectives: Bartida mabaadi'da iyo qalabka labo-guri ee diyaarinta gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) ee shaybaarka
Fahamka sababta aashitada hidroklorikada oo la wasakheeyay (dilute hydrochloric acid) aysan uga oksidhikayn karin manganese(IV) oxide (MnO₂)
Barashadda isticmaalka xalka aasaasiga ah si loo nuugsado gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) ee dambiga ah

kmno4-concentrated-hcl-chlorine.title: Diyaarinta Gaaska Chlorine (Cl₂) Adoo Isticmaalaya Potassium Permanganate (KMnO₄) iyo Hydrochloric Acid Dhumuc Badan Heerkulka Qolka
kmno4-concentrated-hcl-chlorine.description: Awooda oksidhiinta potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) waa aad uga xoog badan tahay tan manganese(IV) oxide (MnO₂), markaa marka hydrochloric acid dhumuc badan (concentrated hydrochloric acid) la saaraa heerkulka qolka ayaa si isla-markiiba ah gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) u soo baxa iyada oon kulaylku loo baahnayn, taasoo sahlaysa is-barbardhigga labada habood.
objectives: Is-barbardhigga xoogga oksidhiinta potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) iyo manganese(IV) oxide (MnO₂)
Bartida qaabka diyaarinta gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) ee aan kulaylka u baahnayn
Hababka saxda ah ee maamulista gaaska sun-ah ee dambiga ah

kclo3-mno2-oxygen.title: Diyaarinta Ogsijiin (O₂) Adoo Kala-jabinaya Botaasiyam klorееt
kclo3-mno2-oxygen.description: Marka Botaasiyam klorееt la kululeeyaa oo lala daro qaddar yar oo manganese(IV) oxide (MnO₂) ah, ogsijiin (O₂) ayaa si deg-deg ah u soo baxa, xabo qori oo dhalaal lehna dib bay u shidata, taasoo muujinaysa in kiciyaanaha uu beddelayo kaliya xaaladaha jaraynta iyada oon wax ka gelin badeecadda.
objectives: Bartida mabaadi'da diyaarinta ogsijiin (O₂) adoo isticmaalaya Botaasiyam klorееt
Fahamka qeexitaanka iyo astaamaha kiciyaanaha (catalyst)
Barashadda ururinta ogsijiin (O₂) habka biyo-meesha-looga-saaro iyo xaqiijinta buuxnimadiisa

iron-burning-chlorine.title: Birta oo ku guban gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) waxayna soo saartaa iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃)
iron-burning-chlorine.description: Marka xadhig birta (Fe) oo gubanaya la geliyo dharka gaaska chlorine (Cl₂), waxay si xoogan u gubataa oo ay soo saartaa qiiq bunni ah. Walxaha la soo saaro waa iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) ee ma aha birta(II) kloriidhka (iron(II) chloride), taasoo muujinaysa in gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) birta u oksideeyo heerka ugu sarreeya.
objectives: La socdo qiiqda bunni-madow ee ka soo baxa markii birta ku gubanayso gaaska chlorine (Cl₂)
Faham sida xoogga oksideerayaasha u go'aamiyaa heerka valence ee natiijada
Bar-bar dhig falcelinta birta (Fe) ee la gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) iyo ta la aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) oo kaliya soo saarta birta(II) kloriidhka (iron(II) chloride)

copper-burning-chlorine.title: Naxaasta (Cu) oo ku guban gaaska chlorine (Cl₂)
copper-burning-chlorine.description: Xadhigga naxaasta (copper wire) markuu ku gubanayo gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) wuxuu soo saaraa qiiq bunni-jaalle ah. Markii biyaha lagu daray, waxaa la helaa xal cagaar-buluug ah oo ah copper(II) chloride, kaas oo ah caddayn muuqata oo ku saabsan xoogga oksidaynta gaaska chlorine (Cl₂).
objectives: La socdo muuqaalka gubashada naxaasta (Cu) gudaha gaaska chlorine (Cl₂)
Faham in gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) si toos ah u oksidayn karo biraha aan firfircoonayn
Aqoonso midabka xalka copper(II) chloride

hydrogen-burning-chlorine.title: Gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) oo ku guban gaaska chlorine (Cl₂)
hydrogen-burning-chlorine.description: Gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) markuu ku gubanayo gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) wuxuu soo saaraa olol cad oo adag, oo afka dharka laga arko ceeryaamo cad. Falcelintani waa falcelinta aasaasiga ah ee warshadaha ku sameeya aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl).
objectives: La socdo ololka cad-dhalaalaya iyo ceeryaanta cad ee afka dharka
Faham khatarta qaraxga ee falcelinta hoos yimaada iftiinka qorraxda
Xidh xidhiidh inta u dhaxaysa tijaabada iyo habka warshadaha lagu sameeyo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl)

sodium-burning-chlorine.title: Sodium oo ku guban gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) oo soo saara cusbo (sodium chloride)
sodium-burning-chlorine.description: Sodium oo dhalaalaya markuu ku gubanayo gaaska chlorine (Cl₂) wuxuu si aad ah ugu gubataa ololka jaalle ah, isagoo soo saaraya qiiq cad oo tiro badan. Qiiqdan caddaa waa uuska yar-yar ee kristaalada sodium chloride (NaCl).
objectives: La socdo ololka jaalle iyo qiiqda cad ee ka soo baxa markii sodium ku gubanayo gaaska chlorine (Cl₂)
Faham sida xidhmaha ionic ee tooska ah looga sameeyo curiyayaasha fudud
Baro hab-maamuska ammaan ee biraha firfircoon

zinc-concentrated-sulfuric-so2.title: Graniyuulada zinc oo la gaashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) soo saara sulfur dioxide
zinc-concentrated-sulfuric-so2.description: Markii graniyuulada zinc la geliyo aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) oo la kululeeyay, waxa la soo saaraa sulfur dioxide oo ur xun leh, ee ma aha gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas). Tani waxay muujinaysaa in aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) ay oksidaynta ka heshiinayso sulfur (S) oo helaya elektaroon.
objectives: Bar-bar dhig farqiga u dhexeeya gaaska ay graniyuulada zinc ka soo saarto aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) iyo ta la dhumicday
Faham in xoogga oksidaynta aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) uu ka yimaado S(+6)
Baro sida loo nuugsado sulfur dioxide adoo isticmaalaya xal alkaline ah

zinc-dilute-sulfuric-hydrogen.title: Tijaabada meesha labaad: graniyuulada zinc oo la aashito sulfuric ah oo la dhumiciyay soo saarta gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas)
zinc-dilute-sulfuric-hydrogen.description: Graniyuulada zinc markay la falceliso aashito sulfuric ah oo la dhumiciyay, waxay kaliya soo saartaa gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) oo aan midab lahayn oo aan ur lahayn. Tijaabadani waxay si cad ula barbardhigaysaa kooxda aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated), taasoo iftiimaysa sida xoogga dhumicdu u beddesho dabeecadda asaasiga ah ee falcelinta.
objectives: La socdo muuqaalka soo saarka gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) marka aashito sulfuric ah oo la dhumiciyay la gaashito graniyuulada zinc
Ku tijuuri gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) hab gubashada
Faham farqiga asaasiga ah u dhexeeya xoogga oksidaynta aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) iyo ta la dhumiciyay

zinc-concentrated-nitric-no2.title: Graniyuulada zinc oo la Aasidda nayitariik ah oo dhumuc leh soo saarta Nayitrojiin daa'ooksiiد ah oo bunni-cas ah
zinc-concentrated-nitric-no2.description: Graniyuulada zinc markay si xoogan ula falceliso Aasidda nayitariik ah oo dhumuc leh, waxa ka soo baxa Nayitrojiin daa'ooksiiد (NO₂) oo bunni-cas ah. Midabka nafsigiisu waa calaamad lagu garto natiijada falcelinta.
objectives: La socdo soo saarka Nayitrojiin daa'ooksiiد (NO₂) ee bunni-cas ah
Faham in natiijada yaryaynta Aasidda nayitariik ah oo dhumuc leh ay tahay NO₂
Baro sida loo maareeyo cagaarka nitrogen-ka ee dambiga ah oo loo nuugsado

zinc-dilute-nitric-no.title: Graniyuulada zinc oo la aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid) soo saarta NO oo aan midab lahayn
zinc-dilute-nitric-no.description: Markii aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid) la gaashito graniyuulada zinc, waxa la soo saaraa NO oo aan midab lahayn. Hase yeeshee, markuu NO ka baxo tuubo gaadhsiinta gaaska oo uu la kulmo hawada, wuu u beddelaa bunni-cas isla markiiba. Tani waa habka caadiga ah ee lagu garto NO.
objectives: La socdo sida NO uu ugu beddelayo bunni-cas marka uu ka baxo dharka oo uu la kulmo hawada
Faham in natiijada yaryaynta aashitada naytareetka oo la wasakheeyay (dilute nitric acid) ay tahay NO
Baro sida biyaha looga ururiyo NO oo aan ku milmin biyo, iyadoo la isticmaalayo hab-qafaafida biyaha

iron-concentrated-nitric-no2.title: Bir iyo aashito nitric ah oo dhumuc leh: falcelin xooggan
iron-concentrated-nitric-no2.description: Heerkulka caadiga ah, bir (Fe) waxay ku dhumucnaato aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) oo dhumuc leh, laakiin markii la kululeeyo waxay si xooggan u falcelisaa una soo saartaa Nayitrojiin daa'ooksiiد midabkiisu yahay casaan-bunni, taas oo muujinaysa sida xallada dhumucnaaduhu ilaaliso ka dibna burburto.
objectives: Aqoonsi dhumucnaadka bir (Fe) ee ku dhex jira aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) oo dhumuc leh
La socod soo-saarka Nayitrojiin daa'ooksiiد marki la kululeeyo
Fahami isticmaalka dhumucnaadka warshadaha kaydinta iyo gaadiidka

fe3-oxidize-sulfide-sulfur.title: Ayoonaadka iron(III) wuxuu soo-saaraa salphuur
fe3-oxidize-sulfide-sulfur.description: Markii iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) lagu dhufo xalka sodium sulfide (sodium sulfide, Na₂S), kuma samaysmo wax ir-ir ah oo iron sulfide ah, halkii waxaa soo baxa salphuur jaalle-caddaan ah, xalku na cagaar-fudud noqdaa, taas oo caddaynaysa in Fe³⁺ uu awood sare u leeyahay oksidayn marka loo eego S.
objectives: La socod soo-baxa salphuurka jaalle-caddaanka ah
Fahami sababta oksidayn-kabarka uu u mudnaado ka hor ka beddelka laba-jibbaaran
Qabso shuruudaha tijaabada ee lagu cabbiro xoogga oksidaynta

hypochlorite-iodide-oxidation.title: Bleach-ku wuxuu oksideeya ayoonaadka iodide
hypochlorite-iodide-oxidation.description: Markii bleach-ka guriga lagu dhufo xalka potassium iodide (KI) iyo xabag (xoogaa), isla markiiba wuxuu u bedelaa buluug, taas oo muujinaysa in hypochlorite leedahay awood xooggan oo oksidayn ah, kaas oo ah aasaaska kiimikada nadiifinta iyo dilida jeermiska.
objectives: La socod beddelka buluugga xabag (xoogaa) oo ah calaamad soo-saarka iodine (I₂)
Fahami awood-oksidaynta hypochlorite
Xidh mabda'ahan falcelinta maaddooyinka nadiifinta ee maalinlaha ah

iodine-thiosulfate-endpoint.title: Dhamaadka titraadka sodium thiosulfate ee nidaamka iodometric
iodine-thiosulfate-endpoint.description: Markii lagu tiriyo sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) xalka iodine (I₂) ee xabag (xoogaa) ku jirto, dhamaadka ayaa gaadhay marka midabka buluuggu baaba'o oo badh-daqiiqo gudihiis uusan soo noqon, taas oo ah hawl-gal caadi ah oo falanqaynta tiradeed.
objectives: Qabso sida loo go'aamiyo dhamaadka nidaamka iodometric
Fahami doorka sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) ee kabarka tiradeed
Habso akhrinta iyo isticmaalka burette

methane-oxygen-combustion.title: Gubitaanka methane (CH₄) ee ogsijiin (O₂)
methane-oxygen-combustion.description: Markii methane (CH₄) lagu shito ogsijiin (O₂), waxay saartaa olol buluug-fudud ah; koob kiimikaad oo qoyan oo qabow lagu hayo waxaa ku soo baxa dhibco biyo ah, xalka Biyo gaashaan ah (xalka kaalshiyam hаydrooksiiد) na wuu ceeryaamaa, taas oo caddaynaysa in soo-saarka ka kooban yahay kaarboon iyo haydroojiinka.
objectives: La socod olólka buluug-fudud ee gubitaanka methane (CH₄)
U isticmaal laba-tallaabo ah si aad u xaqiijiso soo-saarka CO₂ iyo H₂O
Fahami qaacidada guud ee gubitaanka buuxa ee hydrocarbons

carbon-monoxide-burning.title: Olólka buluugga carbon monoxide (CO)
carbon-monoxide-burning.description: Markii carbon monoxide (CO) nadiif ah lagu shito, waxay saartaa olol buluug ah, taas oo ah falcelinta ugu muhiimsan ee kuleylka gaaska shidaalka, waxaana sidoo kale xusid mudan sunta xooggan ee ka dhigan in si adag looga taxadaro daadkiisa.
objectives: La socod olólka buluugga carbon monoxide (CO)
Xaqiiji in soo-saarka yahay carbon dioxide (CO₂)
Aqoonsi sababta sun-qaadka carbon monoxide (CO) iyo siyaabaha ka-hortagga

red-phosphorus-oxygen-smoke.title: Gubitaanka phosphorus cas (P) ee ogsijiin (O₂) oo soo-saara udgoon cad
red-phosphorus-oxygen-smoke.description: Phosphorus cas (P) markuu ku guba ogsijiin (O₂), wuxuu soo-saaraa iftiinka jaalle ah iyo udgoon cad oo badan; soo-saarka phosphorus pentoxide ah aad ayuu u baahi-qabaa biyo, waana loo isticmaali karaa in lagu cayimiyo tirada ogsijiin (O₂) ee hawo-mareenka.
objectives: La socod iftiinka jaalle iyo udgoon caddaanka gubitaanka phosphorus cas (P)
Aqoonsi dareenka qoyaan-qaadka phosphorus pentoxide
Fahami naqshada tijaabada ee lagu qiyaasayo tirooyinka ogsijiin (O₂) ee hawada

zinc-oxygen-blue-green.title: Gubitaanka budo zinc ee ogsijiin (O₂)
zinc-oxygen-blue-green.description: Markii budo zinc lagu shito ogsijiin (O₂), waxay soo-saartaa iftiinka buluug-cagaaran, waxaana soo-baxa budo cad oo sinkyga oksiidka (zinc oxide) ah; sinkyga oksiidka (zinc oxide) caddaanku waa astaanta caadiga ah ee dhawrista qorraxda iyo rinjiyaynta.
objectives: La socod iftiinka buluug-cagaaran ee gubitaanka zinc
Aqoonsi muuqaalka iyo isticmaalka sinkyga oksiidka (zinc oxide)
Barbar dhig kala-duwanaanshiyaha midabka olólka macdanta kala duwan

dichromate-sulfite-green.title: Botaasiyam dichromate oo oxidizing sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃)
dichromate-sulfite-green.description: Botaasiyam dichromate oo aashito ah markuu la kulmo sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) si degdeg ah ayuu u bedelaa midabka oranjiyadda-jaallada ilaa midabka cagaarka chromium(III), taasoo muujinaysa sida chromium lixaad-valence ah loo soo celiyo uguna muhiimsan yahay hababka nadiifinta biyaha wasakhda leh.
objectives: La sooco beddelka midabka oranjiyadda-jaallada ilaa cagaarka
Fahmo sida chromium(III) loo soo celiyo oo laga saaro sun
Qabso sida xaaladaha aashitada u xoojiso awooda oxidization

h2o2-oxidize-fe2.title: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) oo oxidizing iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄)
h2o2-oxidize-fe2.description: Marku hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) ku dhejiyo xalka biyo-cagaarka ah ee iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄), midabku wuxuu u bedelaa bunni-jaalle, haddaana Botaasiyam thayosayanayt lagu daro si deg-deg ah waxay u noqotaa cas-dhiig, taasoo xaqiijinaysa in iron(III) la samaysmay.
objectives: La sooco beddelka midabka oxidization-ka iron(II)
U adeegsoo Botaasiyam thayosayanayt si aad u xaqiijiso in iron(III) la samaysmay
Fahmo dabeecadda cagaaran ee hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) marka oxidizing agent ahaan la isticmaalo

sulfite-reduce-fe3.title: Sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) oo soo celisa iron(III)
sulfite-reduce-fe3.description: Marku sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) ku dhejiyo xalka bunni-jaallada ah ee iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃), midabku wuxuu ka dhacaa ilaa biyo-cagaar oo sulfate ayaa la samaystaa; tijaabadani waxay si buuxda ula barbardhigtaa oxidization-ka hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂), oo labadooduba ay samaystaan xaaladda beddelka valence-ka bir (Fe).
objectives: La sooco beddelka valence-ka markuu bunni-jaalluhu ka dhaco ilaa biyo-cagaarka
Aqoonso sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) ahaan reducing agent
Barbardhig sida labada valence ee bir (Fe) ay u is-beddelaan

sodium-peroxide-water-oxygen.title: Sodium peroxide oo kula falceliya biyo si ogsijiin (O₂) loo samaysto
sodium-peroxide-water-oxygen.description: Marku sodium peroxide jaalle-fudud ah biyo lagu rido, si xoogan ayuu kuleyl u sii daayaa oo ogsijiin (O₂) wuxuu soo saara, xabo qori oo dhalaal leh ayaana mar labaad dab qaadata; haddaana phenolphthalein lagu daro, midabku wuxuu cas noqdaa ka dibna dib u caddaanaa, taasoo sharraxaysa mabda'a agabka keenta ogsijiin.
objectives: La sooco dhacdooyinka u dhexeeya sodium peroxide iyo biyo markay ogsijiin sii daayaan
Kala sooc farqiga u dhexeeya falceliyaha sodium, soodiyamka oksiidka (sodium oxide), iyo sodium peroxide marka ogsijiin la samaynayo
Fahmo sababta phenolphthalein uu marka hore cas noqdo ka dibna dib u caddaado

sodium-peroxide-co2-air-regeneration.title: Sodium peroxide oo nuugaya carbon dioxide (CO₂) oo sii daaya ogsijiin (O₂)
sodium-peroxide-co2-air-regeneration.description: Marku carbon dioxide (CO₂) sodium peroxide lagu buufiyo, walaxda jaalle-fudud ah waxay u caddaataa cad oo ogsijiin (O₂) ayaa la sii daayaa; xajmiga gaaska la nuugay iyo kan la sii daayay waa 2∶1, taasoo ah hab ku habboon dib-u-soo-celinta hawo ee qolalka xidxidsan.
objectives: La sooco sida walaxdu u caddaato oo ogsijiin (O₂) la sii daayo
Fahmo sida xajmiga 2∶1 uu ula jaanqaado baahida neefsashada
Aqoonso naqshadaynta ogsijiin-keenidda ee gawaarida hooseysa badda iyo diyaaradaha hawada sare

sodium-oxide-water-base.title: Soodiyamka oksiidka (sodium oxide) oo biyo la xidhiidha oo salaan samaynaya
sodium-oxide-water-base.description: Soodiyamka oksiidka (sodium oxide) marku biyo la midoobo si toos ah ayuu sodium hydroxide (NaOH) u samaystaa, kuleyl ayaa soo baxa laakiin ogsijiin (O₂) ma sii daayaan; tijaabadani waxay si cad ula barbardhigtaa sodium peroxide, iyagoo xoojinaya farqiga u dhexeeya valence-yada oksijiinta.
objectives: La sooco midowga oksaydka aasaasiga ah iyo biyo
Barbardhig sida sodium peroxide ogsijiin (O₂) u sii daayo iyo sida soodiyamka oksiidka (sodium oxide) uusan gaas sii dayn
Fahmo sida valence-ka oksijiinta u go'aamiso nooca falcelinta

alumina-strong-base-dissolve.title: Aluminiyam ooksiid oo ku dhalaala salaan xoog leh si loo muujiyo dabeecadda laba-geesoodka ah
alumina-strong-base-dissolve.description: Aluminiyam ooksiid cad-cad wuxuu ku dhalaala labadaba aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) daciifka ah iyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH); tuubooyinka tijaabada labadaba waxay noqdaan shafaf, taasoo ah caddaynta ugu dhamaystiran ee oksaydka laba-geesoodka ah.
objectives: La sooco sida Aluminiyam ooksiid isugu dhalaalo labada aashito iyo salaan
Qabso halbeegga go'aaminta oksaydka laba-geesoodka ah
Fahmo sida aluminate la samaysto

zinc-oxide-amphoteric-both.title: Sinkyga oksiidka (zinc oxide) oo laba-geesoodka ah oo labada dhinac ku dhalaala
zinc-oxide-amphoteric-both.description: Sinkyga oksiidka (zinc oxide) marku si gooni ah ugu daro aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) iyo sodium hydroxide (NaOH) labadaba ayuu ku dhalaala, taasoo muujinaysa inuu la mid yahay Aluminiyam ooksiid marka loo eego dabeecadda laba-geesoodka ah, waxaana kaloo uu ahaa unugga firfircoon ee khudradda qoraxda ka difaaca.
objectives: Xaqiiji dabeecadda laba-geesoodka ah ee sinkyga oksiidka (zinc oxide)
Barbardhig xiriirka zinc iyo aluminium ee jadwalka xulqiyaadka
Aqoonso isticmaalka maalintii ah ee sinkyga oksiidka (zinc oxide)

thermite-iron-oxide-weld.title: Falcelka Aluminothermic-ka ee uu Aluminiyamku u Soo Saaro Birta Oksiidka
thermite-iron-oxide-weld.description: Xadhigga maganisiiyamka shiidaha (magnesium ribbon igniter) ayaa shidaya isku-darka Aluminiyam budo ah iyo iron(III) oxide, taasoo soo saarta iftiim cad oo dhalaalaya, birta la dhalaaliyayna way soo daadasaa oo gashadaa xabadado bireed markey qaboowdo. Habkani waxaa loo isticmaalaa heerka warshadaha si loogu xidho meeriska tareenka bannaanka.
objectives: La socoshada heerkulka sare iyo birta la dhalaaliyey ee ka dhasha falcelka aluminothermic-ka
Fahamka aasaaska xoogga soo-celinta ee xooggan ee Aluminiyamka
Aqoonsiga isticmaalka warshadeed ee aluminothermic welding-ka

thermite-copper-oxide.title: Falcelka Aluminothermic-ka ee Aluminiyam budo ah u Soo Saaro Copper(II) Oxide
thermite-copper-oxide.description: Markaad shiddo isku-darka Aluminiyam budo ah iyo copper(II) oxide oo madow ah, falcelku si xoogan ayuu kuleyl u soo saartaa wuxuuna soo saaraa naxaas (Cu) oo midab guduud-cas ah, taasoo si cad u muujinaysa in Aluminiyamku ka firfircoon yahay naxaasta si weyn.
objectives: La socoshada sida copper(II) oxide madowga ah loo soo-celiyo naxaas (Cu) guduud-cas ah
Is-barbardhigga xoogga soo-celinta ee Aluminiyamka iyo naxaasta
Barasho howlgalka shiidaha iyo amniga falcelka aluminothermic-ka

magnetite-acid-dissolve.title: Birta oksiidka (iron(II,III) oxide / Fe₃O₄) oo ku Dhalaala Aashito Hydrochloric ah (HCl)
magnetite-acid-dissolve.description: Birta oksiidka (iron(II,III) oxide / Fe₃O₄) oo madow oo bir-jiidashada leh ayaa ku dhalaala aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) si loo helo xal isku-dhafan oo ka kooban birta laba-valente iyo saddex-valente, kuwaasoo kala la garto adiga oo adeegsanaya Botaasiyam thayosayanayt iyo potassium hexacyanoferrate(III) (potassium ferricyanide).
objectives: La socoshada dhalaalaynta birta oksiidka (iron(II,III) oxide / Fe₃O₄) ee bir-jiidashada leh
Fahamka sida Fe₃O₄ uu u leeyahay laba nooc oo valente ah oo bir ah
Barasho tijaabada kala soocida birta laba-valente iyo saddex-valente

iron-hydroxide-acid-dissolve.title: Birta(III) hiidrooksaydka (iron(III) hydroxide) oo ku Dhalaala Aashitada si Dib loogu Helo Biyo-milicda Birta
iron-hydroxide-acid-dissolve.description: Markaad ku dartid aashito sulfuric ah (H₂SO₄) xaddiga birta(III) hiidrooksaydka (iron(III) hydroxide) ee casaan-bunni ah, wuu dhalaалаа oo noqdaa xal bunni-huruud ah, taasoo muujinaysa in xaddida iyo milicda ay is-u-beddeli karaan, waxaana kani ka mid yahay wareegga birta.
objectives: La socoshada sida xaddidda casaan-bunni ahi u dhalaanto oo u noqoto bunni-huruud
Fahamka is-u-beddelka xaddidda iyo milicda
Barasho xeerarka falcelka ee asaasiga aan la milmin iyo aashitada

copper-hydroxide-acid-blue.title: Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد oo ku Dhalaala Aashito Hydrochloric ah (HCl)
copper-hydroxide-acid-blue.description: Xaddidda Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد ee buluug ah ayaa si degdeg ah ugu dhalaalaaya aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) oo noqota xal copper(II) chloride oo buluug-cagaar ah, isbeddelka qotodheerida buluugga ayaana tilmaamaya heerka horumarka falcelka.
objectives: La socoshada dhalaalaynta xaddidda buluugga ah
Is-barbardhigga midabka ka soo baxa markaad dhalaaliso Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد marka la barbar dhigo birta(III) hiidrooksaydka (iron(III) hydroxide)
Barasho howlgalka dhalaalinta aashitada ee asaasyada aan la milmin

lead-silver-nitrate-tree.title: «Geedka Lacagta» ee ka Dhasha Beddelka Rasaasta ee Lacagta
lead-silver-nitrate-tree.description: Xaashi rasaas ah oo la dhigo xalka silver nitrate (AgNO₃) ayaa si tartiib tartiib ah uga baxaa kaabayaal jirooyin ah oo Lacag (silfar) ah oo muuqaalkoodu yahay geed, taasoo ah muuqaalka ugu quruxda badan ee falcelka beddelka.
objectives: La socoshada koritaanka kaabayaasha geedka ee Lacagta (silfar)
Xaqiijinta in rasaasta (lead) ka firfircoon tahay Lacagta (silfar)
Fahamka sida kaabayaashu u kori jireen goobahaas xumaaday oo ah meesha ugu horraysa

zinc-copper-chloride-displacement.title: Zinc-ku u Beddelaysa Naxaasta ee copper(II) chloride
zinc-copper-chloride-displacement.description: Markaad dhigto graniyuulada zinc xalka copper(II) chloride ee buluug-cagaar ah, dusha sare ayaa la gashaa lakab naxaas (Cu) oo guduud-cas ah midabka xalna wuu gaabiyaa, taasoo ah caddaynta ugu tooska ah ee taxanaha firfircoonta.
objectives: La socoshada soo-bixitaanka naxaasta (Cu) ee guduud-cas ah
Xaqiijinta in zinc-ku ka firfircoon yahay naxaasta
Duubista hannaan-gaabista midabka xalka

iron-silver-nitrate-displacement.title: Birtu (Fe) u Beddeshaa Lacagta ee silver nitrate (AgNO₃)
iron-silver-nitrate-displacement.description: Xadhig birta (Fe) oo nadiif ah oo la geliyey xalka silver nitrate (AgNO₃) ayaa dusha sare ka soo baxa lakab Lacag (silfar) ah oo cad, xalkuna si tartiib tartiib ah ayuu u noqdaa cagaar-cad, taasoo muujinaysa in birtu (Fe) la oxideeyo oo noqoto aayonaadka laba-valente ee birta.
objectives: La socoshada soo-bixitaanka Lacagta (silfar) iyo xalka oo noqonaya cagaar-cad
Fahamka sida birtu (Fe) ay beddelka ku soo saarto aayonaadka laba-valente ee birta ee aan ahayn birta(III)
Barasho diyaarinta hordhaca ee nadiifinta dusha sare ee birta

potassium-water-violet-flame.title: Falcelka Potassium iyo Biyo: Olol Guduud ah
potassium-water-violet-flame.description: Marka grain-ka potassium la rido biyaha lagu daray phenolphthalein, falcel adag ayaa dhacda oo olol guduud ah ayaa ka kaca, kaas oo ka xooggan reaction-ka sodium. Tani waxay si cad u muujinaysaa sida firfircoonida macdanta isku qoyska ugu kordho muddo kasta oo darajooyinku koraan.
objectives: La socod falcelka xooggan ee potassium iyo biyaha iyo olosha guduuda
Barbar dhig firfircoonida sodium iyo potassium
Ku mahad naq xeerarka amniga ee la xiriira macdanta alkaline

silver-chloride-ammonia-dissolve.title: Lacagta kloriidhka (silver chloride) ee ku milma xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood)
silver-chloride-ammonia-dissolve.description: Markii xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) xad dhaaf ah lagu daro cabbirada cad ee lacagta kloriidhka (silver chloride), waxay si buuxda ugu milmaysaa xal daahir ah. Dheellitirka koordineeshanka ayaa silver ion-ka ka dhulmaya xaaladda adag.
objectives: La socod sida cabiradu cad u milmayso xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood)
Fahm sida dheellitirka koordineeshanka u saarayso dheellitirka milmidda
Baro shuruudaha lagu abuuro silver-ammoniya complex ion-ka

silver-bromide-ammonia-resist.title: Silver bromide (AgBr) oo aan ku milmin xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood)
silver-bromide-ammonia-resist.description: Silver bromide (AgBr) ee midabkiisu huruud-cad yahay, xataa marka xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) xad dhaaf ah lagu daro, weli ma milmo. Tani waxay si adag uga duwan tahay lacagta kloriidhka (silver chloride), waxayna muujinaysaa in Ksp-ka yar yahay, milmidda ku adag tahay xataa koordineeshanka.
objectives: Barbar dhig farqiga u dhexeeya lacagta kloriidhka (silver chloride) iyo silver bromide (AgBr) marka xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) la isticmaalo
Fahm tartanka u dhexeeya Ksp iyo joogteynta dheellitirka koordineeshanka
Baro xeerka hoos u dhaca milmidda ee halide-yada silver

silver-iodide-ammonia-resist.title: Milmid la'aanta aadka u xoogga badan ee Silfar(I) aayodiiد
silver-iodide-ammonia-resist.description: Silfar(I) aayodiiد ee midabkiisu huruud yahay, xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) xad dhaaf ah laguma milmiyo, waxayna leedahay Ksp-ka ugu yar halide-yada silver dhammaan. Silfar(I) aayodiiد waxaa loo isticmaalaa da'da roobka macmal ah.
objectives: Xaqiiji in Silfar(I) aayodiiد aan ku milmin xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood)
Kala sooc heerarka milmidda ee saddexda halide oo silver ah
Ogow isticmaalka Silfar(I) aayodiiد ee da'da roobka macmal ah

silver-bromide-thiosulfate-fixing.title: Milmidda silver bromide (AgBr) ee xalka hagaajinta (fixer)
silver-bromide-thiosulfate-fixing.description: Silver bromide (AgBr) oo xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) ku adkaysatay, waxay ku milmaysaa xal midab la'aanta ah marka sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) la isticmaalo. Tani ayaa ah aasaaska kiimikada ee hagaajinta sawirrada madow-cad.
objectives: La socod milmidda silver bromide (AgBr) ee ku dhacda xalka hagaajinta
Barbar dhig awoodda koordineeshanka ee ammoniya iyo thiosulfate ion
Fahm mabda'a hagaajinta sawirrada

silver-iodide-thiosulfate-limit.title: Silfar(I) aayodiiد oo adkaysanaysa xalka hagaajinta
silver-iodide-thiosulfate-limit.description: Silfar(I) aayodiiد wali waxay ku hartaa xagga hoose ee tuubada xataa marka sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) la isticmaalo, taas oo muujinaysa in xataa ligand-yada caadiga ah ee xoogga badan ay leeyihiin xad, waxaana loo baahan yahay cyanide si loo milmiyo.
objectives: Xaqiiji adkaysiga Silfar(I) aayodiiد ee ka dhanka ah xalka hagaajinta
Aqoonsi xeeldheerida la xiriirta xoogga ligand-yada
Fahm muhiimadda qiyamka Ksp aadka u yar

silver-carbonate-ammonia-dissolve.title: Lacagta kaarbooneetka (silver carbonate) oo ku milma xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood)
silver-carbonate-ammonia-dissolve.description: Lacagta kaarbooneetka (silver carbonate) ee midabkiisu huruud-cad yahay waxay ku milmaysaa xal daahir midab la'aanta ah marka xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) la isticmaalo, taas oo ah hab milmid oo badanaa la iska indhatiraa marka silver-ammoniya xalka la diyaarinayo.
objectives: La socod milmidda koordineeshanka ee lacagta kaarbooneetka (silver carbonate)
Barbar dhig sahalaanta milmiddiisa iyo ta halide-yada silver
Baro hababka kala duwan ee diyaarinta xalka silver-ammoniya

copper-hydroxide-ammonia-deep-blue.title: Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد oo ku milma xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) xad dhaafka ah
copper-hydroxide-ammonia-deep-blue.description: Cabirka buluugga ah ee Naxaas(II) hаydrooksiiد waxay ku milmaysaa xal daahir oo buluug-madow ah marka xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) xad dhaaf ah lagu daro. Isbedelka midabka ee buluug-fudud ilaa buluug-madow waa calaamadda ugu cad ee koordineeshanka.
objectives: La socod sida cabiradu u milmayso oo xalku u noqdo buluug-madow
Fahm sida tetra-ammine copper(II) complex ion loo abuuro
Baro natiijooyinka kala duwan ee xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) yar iyo xad dhaafka ah

zinc-hydroxide-ammonia-dissolve.title: Sinkyga hiidrooksaydka (zinc hydroxide) oo ku dhalaalaaya xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood)
zinc-hydroxide-ammonia-dissolve.description: Sinkyga hiidrooksaydka (zinc hydroxide) midabkiisu caddaan yahay waxaana lagu milmi karaa labadaba aashito xooggan iyo xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood); kan hore wuxuu ku dhacaa dabeecadda laba-geesoodka (amphoteric), kan dambe wuxuu ku dhacaa xiriirka koordineeshanka, labaduba waxay geeyaan isla natiijada.
objectives: La eego sida raasibka caddaanka ah ugu dhalaalaayo xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood)
Lagu kala sooco milmidda amphoteric iyo milmidda koordineeshanka
Loo fahmo sida [Zn(NH₃)₄]²⁺ — ion-ka koordineeshanka afar-ammoniya leh — u samaysmo

nickel-hydroxide-ammonia-violet.title: Niikelka hiidrooksaydka (nickel(II) hydroxide) oo ku dhalaalaaya xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) una noqonaya buluug-guduud
nickel-hydroxide-ammonia-violet.description: Niikelka hiidrooksaydka (nickel(II) hydroxide) ee midabkiisu cagaar yahay wuxuu ku dhalaalaayaa xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) oo xad-dhaafsan, wuxuuna sameeyaa xal buluug-guduud ah; midabka [Ni(NH₃)₆]²⁺ waa mid aad uga duwan raasibkii asalka ahaa.
objectives: La eego sida raasibka cagaarka ah ugu beddelo xal buluug-guduud ah
Loo garanno ion-ka niikel-ammoniya leh ee leh lix meel koordineeshanka ah
Loo fahmo sida xaaladda ligand field u saameeyso midabka

copper-edta-chelate-titration.title: Titration-ka chelation-ka ee ion-ka naxaasta (Cu) adoo isticmaalaya EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid)
copper-edta-chelate-titration.description: Markii EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) lagu daray xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) ee midabkiisu samaa-dhuuban yahay, midabku si yar ayuu u qoto-dheeraan doonaa; meelahal lix oo koordineeshanka ah ayaa ku xira ion-ka naxaasta (Cu) waxayna sii daayaan ion-yada hydrogen-ka, sidaas awgeed waa in titraation-ku ka dhacaa buffer solution.
objectives: Loo bartaa hawlgallada aasaasiga ah ee titration-ka koordineeshanka
Loo fahmo stoichiometry-ga chelation-ka 1∶1 ee EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid)
Loo garanno muhiimadda nidaamka buffer ee titration-ka koordineeshanka

iron3-edta-decolorize.title: EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) oo midabka biyo-milmiska iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) ka baabbi'inaysa
iron3-edta-decolorize.description: Xalka iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) ee midabkiisu huruud-bunni yahay markii EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) lagu daro wuxuu u beddeli doonaa huruud-fudud; kadib markii ion-ka bir (Fe) lagu xiro chelation-ka, midabkii uu hore u lahaa ee uu ka helayay biyo-milmiska (aqueous form) ayuu waayaa.
objectives: La eego isbeddelka midabka huruud-bunniga ah ee u rogmada huruud-fudud
Loo fahmo sida chelation-ku u beddesho deegaanka koordineeshanka ee ion-ka bir (Fe)
Loo garanno awoodda chelation-ka xooggan ee EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) marka la xiriiriyo ion-yada valency-da sare leh

aluminum-edta-back-titration.title: Back-titration-ka EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) ee ion-ka Aluminiyam kloriiد
aluminum-edta-back-titration.description: Chelation-ka u dhexeeya Aluminiyam kloriiد iyo EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) waa mid gaabis ah oo aan midab lahayn; sidaas darteed EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) xad-dhaaf ah ayaa loo diyaariyaa, ka dibna zinc-ka biyo-milmiskiisu ayaa loo isticmaalaa back-titration, taasoo ah hab-maamuus caadi ah oo falanqaynta koordineeshanka.
objectives: Loo fahmo xaaladaha ku habboon isticmaalka back-titration
Loo bartaa istiraatiijiyadda la isticmaalo nidaamyada chelation-ka gaabiska ah
Loo garanno sababta chelate-yada aan midabka lahayn u baahan yihiin indicator

lead-edta-masking.title: EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) oo masking ka samaysa ion-ka rasaasta (lead)
lead-edta-masking.description: Markii EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) lagu daro xalka lead(II) nitrate, rasaasta (lead) ayaa si adag ugu xidnaanaysa chelation-ka, markii xigana haddii sodium sulfide (sodium sulfide, Na₂S) lagu daro raasib madow ma samayn doono — taasoo ah nidaamka caadiga ah ee masking-ga ion-yada kaga filan.
objectives: Loo fahmo habka shaqada ee masking agent
Lagu barbardhigo farqiga u dhexeeya xaaladda EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) leh iyo ta aan lahayn marka jira raasib
Loo garanno isticmaalka masking-ga koordineeshanka ee falanqaynta kiimikada

magnesium-edta-hardness.title: Koordineeshanka ion-ka Maagnisiyam sulfeet iyo EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid)
magnesium-edta-hardness.description: Maagnisiyam sulfeet iyo EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) waxay sameeyaan chelate aan midab lahayn; isbeddelka midabka waxaa loo baahan yahay Eriochrome Black T si loogu garto dhamaadka — tani waa aasaaska kale ee cabbirka adkaanshaha biyaha.
objectives: Loo bartaa titration-ka koordineeshanka ee magnesium
Loo fahmo sababta chelate-yada aan midab lahayn u baahan yihiin indicator
Magnesium iyo calcium isugu jiraan si loogu fahmo fikradda total hardness

zinc-edta-titration.title: Standardisation-ka EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) adoo isticmaalaya zinc sulfate
zinc-edta-titration.description: Zinc sulfate iyo EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) waxay si tirad-ahaaneed u samayaan chelate, sidaas darteed zinc sulfate waxaa badanaa loo isticmaalaa xoogga caadiga ah ee standardisation-ka EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid); dhamaadka titration-ka waxaa lagu gartaa isbeddelka muuqda ee midabka indicator-ka.
objectives: Loo bartaa ficilka standardisation-ka EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid)
Loo fahmo shuruudaha xulashada xoogga caadiga ah (primary standard)
Isbeddelka midabka dhamaadka lagu qoro oo lagu xafido

nickel-edta-blue-green.title: Chelation-ka EDTA ee Ionka Nickel
nickel-edta-blue-green.description: Xalka nickel(II) chloride ee cagaaran markuu helaa EDTA ayuu u beddela midab buluug-cagaar ah, maxaa yeelay EDTA waxay meesha ka saartaa molekyuullada biyaha ku xidnaa goobta isku-xidka, taasoo beddesho xoogga goobta ligand-ka.
objectives: La soco isbedelka midabka ee cagaaran ilaa buluug-cagaar
Fahmo sida beddelka ligand-ka u saamayso midabka
Baaro shuruudaha titration-ka isku-xidka ee nickel

cobalt-edta-purple-red.title: Chelation-ka EDTA ee Ionka Cobalt
cobalt-edta-purple-red.description: Xalka cobalt(II) chloride ee guduud-caddaanku markuu helaa EDTA ayuu u beddela guduud-baajin, kaas oo iska soo horjeeda jihada midabka buluusha ee ay abuurto khloorayda, waxaana labadaas isu barbar dhigi kara si toos ah.
objectives: La soco isbedelka guduud-caddaan ilaa guduud-baajin
Barbar dhig saamaynta EDTA iyo ion-ka chloride ee cobalt
Fahmo sida xoogga ligand-ka u go'aamiyo jihada midabka

copper-chloride-ammonia-blue.title: Isku-xidka Xal Ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) iyo Copper(II) Chloride oo Buluug Qoto Dheer
copper-chloride-ammonia-blue.description: Xalka copper(II) chloride ee buluug-cagaarku markuu helaa xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) oo xad dhaaf ah ayuu u beddela buluug qoto dheer, taasoo muujinaysa sida ion-ka naxaas (Cu) kali ah uu ugu muuqdo laba midab oo kala duwan marka uu la xidmo khloorayda iyo ammoniyada.
objectives: La soco isbedelka buluug-cagaar ilaa buluug qoto dheer
Barbar dhig midabka isku-xidka khloorayda iyo ta ammoniyada
Baaro astaamaha lagu garto beddelka ligand-ka

copper-nitrate-ammonia-blue.title: Isku-xidka Xal Ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) iyo copper(II) nitrate (Cu(NO₃)₂)
copper-nitrate-ammonia-blue.description: Xalka copper(II) nitrate (Cu(NO₃)₂) markuu helaa xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) oo xad dhaaf ah ayuu sidoo kale u beddela buluug qoto dheer, taasoo caddaynaysa in isku-xidka uu ku xidna ion-ka bartamaha iyo ligand-ka oo kaliya, halka ion-ka anion-ku uusan door muhiim ah ka qaadan.
objectives: Xaqiiji in anion-ku uusan saamayn midabka isku-xidka
Adag samayska tetraamminecopper oo aad u fiirso shuruudaheeda
Fahmo fikradda ion-ka bartamaha ee kimiyada isku-xidka

iron3-sulfate-thiocyanate-red.title: Muujinta Midabka Dhiigga ee Birta(III) Sulfeet iyo Potassium Thiocyanate (KSCN)
iron3-sulfate-thiocyanate-red.description: Xalka Birta(III) sulfeet markuu helaa potassium thiocyanate (KSCN) ayuu si degdeg ah u muujiyaa midab cas oo dhiig u eg, taasoo ah falcelinta ugu xasaasida badan ee loo isticmaalo hubinta ion-ka bir (Fe), xitaa tiro yar ayaa ku filnayd muujinta.
objectives: Baaro habka hubinta ion-ka bir (Fe) adoo isticmaalaya potassium thiocyanate (KSCN)
Qiimee xasaasiyadda falcelinta muujinta midabka
Xaqiiji in anion-ku uusan wax saamayn ah ku yeelan muujinta midabka

benzene-bromination-substitution.title: Falcelinta Beddelka Bromine (Br₂) ee Benzene (C₆H₆)
benzene-bromination-substitution.description: Benzene (C₆H₆) iyo bromine (Br₂) dareeraha ah ayaa lala kulmiyaa budo birta (Fe) oo ah katalayste, waxaana soo baxa hydrogen bromide oo litmus qoyan ka dhiga mid cas, halka natiijadu tahay bromobenzene oo saliid u eg oo biyaha ku dhex dhaca.
objectives: Kala sooc falcelinta beddelka iyo ta ku-darista
fagaare habka hubinta hydrogen bromide
La soco kala soocida lakabka ee natiijada saliidda u eg

toluene-bromination-substitution.title: Falcelinta Beddelka Bromine (Br₂) ee Tooluwiin
toluene-bromination-substitution.description: Tooluwiin ayaa budo birta (Fe) oo katalayste ah uga dhacda beddelka giraanta aromatic-ka, waxaana soo baxa bromotoluene iyo hydrogen bromide, falcelintuna waa fudud tahay marka loo eego benzene (C₆H₆), taasoo caddaynaysa in kooxda methyl-ku ay firfircooneyso giraanta benzene-ka.
objectives: Barbar dhig firfircoonaanshaha beddelka benzene (C₆H₆) iyo Tooluwiin
Fahmo sida kooxda beddelka u firfircoonaynayso giraanta benzene-ka
Hubin soo baxa hydrogen bromide

toluene-side-chain-oxidation.title: Oksideeska Garabka Tooluwiin si uu u noqdo Benzoic Acid (C₆H₅COOH)
toluene-side-chain-oxidation.description: Tooluwiin iyo potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) oo aashito ah ayaa wada kululeysta, midabka guduud-jaallaha ahna way baaba'daa, kooxda methyl-kuna waxay u beddeshaa kooxda carboxyl, markaad qaboojisana waxaa soo baxa crystal-yada cad ee benzoic acid (C₆H₅COOH).
objectives: Garto sida giraanta benzene-ku u firfircoonaynayso garabka
Xaqiiji in giraanta benzene-ka lafteeda aan la oksideeyn
Baaro habka shaandhaynta iyo dib-u-crystallization-ka ee natiijada

acetylene-bromine-addition.title: Kulminta acetylene (C₂H₂) iyo xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood)
acetylene-bromine-addition.description: Marka acetylene (C₂H₂) la geliyo xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood), midabka oranji-jaallaha ah si deg-deg ah ayuu u baaba'aa oo aan gaas la sii dayn, sababo oo ah in xididdada saddexaad labojibbaar si joogto ah loo furo, taasoo kulminta acetylene (C₂H₂) ka dhigaysa laba jeer tan ethylene (C₂H₄).
objectives: La socodsii baaba'ida xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood) iyadoon gaas la sii dayn
Is-barbar dhig awoodda kulminta xididdada saddexaad iyo tan laba-laabka
Fahmi sida loo kala saaro kulminta iyo beddelashada

acetylene-kmno4-oxidation.title: acetylene (C₂H₂) oo potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) aashitada ah ka duminaya midabka
acetylene-kmno4-oxidation.description: Marka acetylene (C₂H₂) la geliyo xal potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) oo aashito ah, midabka guduud-banafsajiga ah ayaa baaba'a oo carbon dioxide (CO₂) la sii daayaa, taasoo muujinaysa in xididdada saddexaad si buuxda loo oksidaystay oo loo jabiyay.
objectives: La socodsii baaba'ida midabka iyo soo bixitaanka gaaska isla mar ahaantaana
Garto sida oksideeska u jabiyaa xidhiidhyada aan dhammaystirnayn
Ku xirfadeyso tijaabinta tayada hydrocarbon-yada aan dhammaystirnayn

styrene-bromine-addition.title: Kulminta xididdada laba-laabka ee dhinaca styrene (C₆H₅CH=CH₂)
styrene-bromine-addition.description: Marka styrene (C₆H₅CH=CH₂) la soo dhibaaqo xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood), midabku wuu baaba'aa; falcelinta waxay ka dhacday xididdada laba-laabka ee dhinaca, ee kuma dhicin giraanta benzene (C₆H₆), sidaas darteedna uma baahna katalaysar.
objectives: Xaqiiji in kulminta ka dhacday dhinaca ee kuma dhicin giraanta benzene (C₆H₆)
Is-barbar dhig farqiga u dhexeeya benzene (C₆H₆) iyo styrene (C₆H₅CH=CH₂) marka ay la kulmaan xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood)
Fahmi firfircoowga xididdada laba-laabka ee nidaamka conjugated

ethylene-glycol-sodium-hydrogen.title: iithayleenka glaykoolka (ethylene glycol) iyo sodium si loo cabbiyo tirada hydroxyl-yada
ethylene-glycol-sodium-hydrogen.description: Marka iithayleenka glaykoolka (ethylene glycol) la falceliyo sodium, gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) la soo saaro waa laba jeer kan alcohol khamaasiga ah ee xajmi siman, taasoo suurtogal ka dhigaysa in tirada hydroxyl-yada molekiulka laga garto tirada gaaska la soo saaray.
objectives: U isticmaal tirada gaaska la soo saaray si aad u go'aamiso tirada hydroxyl-yada
Is-barbar dhig farqiga soo-saarka gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) u dhexeeya alcohol khamaasiga ah iyo laba-hydroxyl ka ah
Ku xirfadeyso habka ururinta gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) si tijaabo ah

glycerol-sodium-three-hydroxyl.title: glycerol (C₃H₈O₃) iyo sodium: soo-saarka gaaska saddex-hydroxyl
glycerol-sodium-three-hydroxyl.description: glycerol (C₃H₈O₃) waxaa ku jira saddex hydroxyl, marka la falceliyo sodium gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) ee la soo saaro waa saddex jeer kan alcohol khamaasiga ah; xabagaha ayaa si joogto ah uga soo baxa dusha filimaha sodium laakiin si xooggan uma kacaan.
objectives: Xaqiiji tirada gaaska la saadaaliyay ee alcohol saddex-hydroxyl ka ah
Is-barbar dhig firfircoowga hydroxyl iyo tan biyaha
Fahmi astaamaha qaab-dhismeedka alcohol badan hydroxyl ka ah

propanol-sodium-hydrogen.title: Probaanol iyo beddelashada sodium ee keenta gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas)
propanol-sodium-hydrogen.description: Probaanol wuxuu si tartiib ah ula falceliyaa sodium isagoo soo saari gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas); silsilada carboonka oo dheer waxay yaraysaa firfircoowga hydroxyl, taasoo xabagaha ka dhigaysa mid ka tartiib baxaya nidaamyada alcohol silsilad gaaban.
objectives: La socodsii sida xawaaraha soo-saarka gaaska u gaabinayo marka silsilada carboonka ay dheeraaday
Fahmi saamaynta kooxda hydrocarbon ee ku tiirsanaanta firfircoowga hydroxyl
Ku xirfadeyso shuruudaha lagu sameeyo sodium alkoxide

aniline-bromine-white-precipitate.title: aniline (C₆H₅NH₂) iyo xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood): beddelashada saddex-meelood
aniline-bromine-white-precipitate.description: Marka aniline (C₆H₅NH₂) la soo dhibaaqo xal bromine ah (Br₂ biyood), midabku si dhakhso ah ayuu u baaba'aa oo dallaco cad oo tribromoaniline ah ayaa ka dhacda, adoon katalaysar loo baahnayn; tani waxay muujinaysaa in kooxda amine ay giraanta benzene (C₆H₆) ka awood badan tahay hydroxyl firfircoowga dhanka.
objectives: La socodsii soo-saarka dallacada cad ee beddelashada saddex-meelood ee heerkulka qolka
Is-barbar dhig awoodda firfircoowga u dhexeysa kooxda amine iyo hydroxyl
