Tixraac beddelashada khamaasiga ee benzene (C₆H₆) oo u baahan katalaysar budo birta (Fe)

benzaldehyde-silver-mirror.title: falcelinta muraayadda lacagta ee benzaldehyde (C₆H₅CHO)
benzaldehyde-silver-mirror.description: Marka benzaldehyde (C₆H₅CHO) la kululeeyo xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) oo silver nitrate (AgNO₃) ku jiro adoo isticmaalaya hammaan biyo, darbiyada tuubada ayaa ka muuqanayaan lakab Lacag (silfar) oo dhalaalaya, taasoo xaqiijinaysa in kooxda aldehyde ee aromatic-ka ay sidoo kale leedahay dareen-rogashada. Xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood) waxaa laga sameeyaa silver nitrate (AgNO₃) iyo xal ammoniya ah (NH₃ biyood).
objectives: Ku xirfadeyso tallaabooyinka hawleedka ee falcelinta muraayadda lacagta
Xaqiiji dareen-rogashada aldehyde aromatic ah
Fahmi saamaynta nadiifnimada darbiga tuubada oo ku tiirsanaanta samaynta murayaadka

benzoic-acid-ethyl-ester.title: Dhisidda Ethyl Benzoate
benzoic-acid-ethyl-ester.description: benzoic acid (C₆H₅COOH) iyo ethanol (C₂H₅OH) ayaa falceliya aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) oo u shaqeysa katalayste si loo sameeyo ethyl benzoate oo udgoon udgoon miraha, walaxdana kuma milmayso biyo ee ayay sarreysa dareere.
objectives: Ku bartid xaaladaha esterification-ka aashidaha aromatic ah
Fahamid doorka qalabka dib-u-celinta (reflux)
Barid sida loo adeegsado funnel kala qaybinta dareeraha si loo sooco lakabka ester

propanoic-acid-ethyl-ester.title: Dhisidda Ethyl Propanoate
propanoic-acid-ethyl-ester.description: propionic acid (CH₃CH₂COOH) iyo ethanol (C₂H₅OH) ayaa falceliya si loo sameeyo ethyl propanoate; udgoonkeedu ka xooggan yahay esterka silsiladaha gaagaaban, taasoo muujineysa saamaynta dhererka silsilada carbon-ka ee udgoonka.
objectives: Barbar dhig udgoonka esterrada ka yimaada carboxylic acids kala duwan
Ku bartid xaaladaha guud ee esterification-ka
Fahamid siyaabaha lagu kordhiyo soo saarista falcelinta la soo noqon karto

acetic-acid-propyl-ester.title: Dhisidda Propyl Acetate
acetic-acid-propyl-ester.description: aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) iyo Probaanol ayaa falceliya si loo sameeyo propyl acetate oo leh udgoon godob ah; isla carboxylic acid-ka oo la geliyo alcohols kala duwan ayaa bixisa silsilad caطaraat ah.
objectives: Fahamid saamaynta silsilada carbon-ka ee alcohol-ka ee udgoonka ester
Xoojin xirfadaha esterification-ka
Aqoonsiga isticmaalka esteryada warshadaha caطarada

acetic-acid-butyl-ester.title: Dhisidda Butyl Acetate
acetic-acid-butyl-ester.description: aashito acetic ah (CH₃COOH) iyo n-butanoolka (n-butanol) ayaa falceliya si loo sameeyo butyl acetate oo ah xaliye rinjiyeed oo caadi ah; boiling point-kiisu sarreeyaa waana in dib-u-celinta waqti dheer la sameeyaa.
objectives: Ku bartid sida loo sameeyo ester boiling point sarreeya adoo isticmaalaya reflux
Fahamid xiriirka u dhexeeya boiling point iyo dhererka silsilada carbon-ka
Aqoonsiga wadooyinka diyaarinta xalileyaasha warshadaha

sucrose-acid-hydrolysis.title: Hydrolysis-ka Aashidka Sukroos
sucrose-acid-hydrolysis.description: Sukroos ayaa aashito sulfuric ah oo khafiif ah (H₂SO₄) oo u shaqeysa katalayste kula kululaynta hammaan biyo ku milma monosakariidhyo; dareeraha ayaa kasbada awood reduce ah oo lagu xaqiijin karo tijaabada Lacag (silfar).
objectives: Aqoonsiga hydrolysis-ka disaccharides
Fahamid doorka katalayste-ka aashidka ah ee hydrolysis-ka
Ku bartid diyaarinta kiimikada ka hor tijaabada badeecadaha hydrolysis

cellulose-acid-hydrolysis.title: Hydrolysis-ka Aashidka Saylulooska
cellulose-acid-hydrolysis.description: Suufka shaydha laga saaro ayaa aashito sulfuric ah oo xooggan (H₂SO₄ concentrated) kula kululaynta muddo dheer si tartiib tartiib ah ugu milma Glukoos; tan ka adag hydrolysis-ka polysaccharides-ka caadiga ah, waxayna tahay dariiqa aasaasiga ah ee sukarrada laga sameeyo maadooyinka noolaha.
objectives: Barbar dhig adagtida hydrolysis-ka saylulooska (cellulose) iyo xabag (xoogaa)
Fahamid sida qaab-dhismeedka crystalline-ka u carqaladeynayo hydrolysis-ka
Aqoonsiga muhiimadda warshadeed ee sukarrada laga sameeyo maadooyinka noolaha

copper-sulfate-dissolution-exotherm.title: Kuleylka Milmida copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) aan Biyo Lahayn
copper-sulfate-dissolution-exotherm.description: Markii copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) cad oo biyo la'aani ku milmo biyo, kulaylka hydration-ka ayaa si cad u muuqda, thermometer ayaa muujiya kororka heerkulka, iyadoo dareeraha ku noqonaya midab buluug ah; tani waa aasaaska lagu garto biyo yar yar.
objectives: Qiyaasida isbedelka heerkulka xilliyada milmida
Fahamid tartanka u dhexeeya kulaylka hydration-ka iyo tamarta shabakadda crystal-ka
Aqoonsiga mabaadi'da lagu garto biyo adoo isticmaalaya copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) aan biyo lahayn

sodium-acetate-dissolution-endotherm.title: Xoojinta Kuleylka Milmida sodium acetate (CH₃COONa)
sodium-acetate-dissolution-endotherm.description: Markii sodium acetate (CH₃COONa) ku milmo biyo, jebin shabakadda crystal-ka oo qaadata kulaylka ayaa sare u qaadata, thermometer ayaa muujiya hoos u dhac heerkulka; tani si toos ah ugu soo horjeedaa kulaylka crystallization-ka dareeraha supersaturated-ka.
objectives: Duubista heerkulka hoos u dhaca xilliyada milmida endothermic
Barbar dhig kulaylka crystallization-ka si loo fahmo suurtagalnimada dib-u-celinta hannaanka
Ku bartid heshiisyada calaamadda kulaylka milmida

ammonium-sulfate-dissolution-endotherm.title: Amooniyam sulfeeт ka dhalata qaboojinta marka la dhalaaliyo
ammonium-sulfate-dissolution-endotherm.description: Marka Amooniyam sulfeeт biyo lagu darayo, heerkulku si cad ayuu hoos ugu dhacaa. Xeryahan la mid ah Amooniyam nayitrееt waxay ka tirsan yihiin walxaha qaboojiya marka la dhalaaliyo, taasoo ah sababaha ka mid ah hoos u dhaca ku meel gaarka ah ee heerkulka dhulka marka bacriminta beeraha la isticmaalo.
objectives: Cabbirka qaboojinta ka dhalata dhalaalinta cusbada amooniyamka
Barbar dhigida hoos u dhaca heerkulka ee cusbooyin kala duwan oo amooniyam ah
Xiriirinta muuqaalka dhabta ah ee bacriminta beeraha

potassium-chloride-dissolution-endotherm.title: Botaasiyam kloriiد ka dhalata qaboojinta marka la dhalaaliyo
potassium-chloride-dissolution-endotherm.description: Marka Botaasiyam kloriiد biyo lagu darayo, heerkulku si yar ayuu hoos ugu dhacaa, taasoo aad uga hooseysa hoos u dhaca Amooniyam nayitrееt. Tani waxay u adeegtaa barbar dhigida cabbiraadda dhalaalinta (enthalpy of dissolution) ee cusbooyin kala duwan.
objectives: Cabbirka isbedelka heerkulka ee qaboojinta yar
Barbar dhigida heerarka enthalpy of dissolution ee cusbooyin kala duwan
Bartida habka saxda ah ee miisaanka muunada cabbiraadda

aluminum-chloride-dissolution-exotherm.title: Aluminiyam kloriiد ka dhalata kuleylka xoogga badan marka la dhalaaliyo
aluminum-chloride-dissolution-exotherm.description: Marka Aluminiyam kloriiد aan biyo lahayn biyo lagu darayo, kulaylka xoogga badan ayaa si isku mar ah uga dhalata labadaba hidration-ka iyo hydrolysis-ka, heerkulkuna si cad ayuu kor ugu kacaa waxaana weheliya ur xun. Walxada waa in tartiib tartiib lagu daraa.
objectives: Daawashada kuleylka xoogga badan ka dhalata dhalaalinta cusbada qiimaha sare leh
Fahamka sida hydrolysis ugu saamayso saameynta kuleylka
Bartida habka ammaan ah ee ku darista cusbooyin si fudud u kala baxa

sodium-nitrate-dissolution-endotherm.title: Soodiyamka naytareetka (sodium nitrate) ka dhalata qaboojinta marka la dhalaaliyo
sodium-nitrate-dissolution-endotherm.description: Marka soodiyamka naytareetka (sodium nitrate) biyo lagu darayo, heerkulku hoos ayuu u dhacaa. Tan oo la mid ah potassium nitrate (KNO₃) oo ah cusbada nitrate-ka, labaduba waxay muujinayaan in energy-da shabakadda crystalline-ka ee cusbada nitrate-ku guud ahaan ka sarayso energy-da hidration-ka.
objectives: Cabbirka qaboojinta ka dhalata dhalaalinta cusbada nitrate-ka
Koobaynta saameynta anion-ka enthalpy of dissolution
Hagaajinta habka akhrinta thermometer saxda ah

sodium-sulfate-dissolution-endotherm.title: Sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄) ka dhalata qaboojinta marka la dhalaaliyo
sodium-sulfate-dissolution-endotherm.description: Marka sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄) aan biyo lahayn biyo lagu darayo, heerkulku si yar ayuu hoos ugu dhacaa, hase yeeshee qaababkiisa tobanka biyo kristal ah waxay muujinayaan qaboojin ka xoogsan. Labada qaabba waa la barbar dhigi karaa si loo fahmo sida biyo-kristalku u saameeyo enthalpy of dissolution.
objectives: Cabbirka qaboojinta ka dhalata dhalaalinta sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄)
Fahamka sida biyo-kristalku u saameeyo saameynta kuleylka
Bartida naqshadeynta tijaabada isbarbardhigga ah ee tirada walxaha la mid ah

potassium-bromide-dissolution-endotherm.title: Potassium bromide ka dhalata qaboojinta marka la dhalaaliyo
potassium-bromide-dissolution-endotherm.description: Marka potassium bromide biyo lagu darayo, heerkulku si yar ayuu hoos ugu dhacaa. Potassium bromide, Botaasiyam kloriiد, iyo potassium iodide (KI) waxay wadajir u samaynayaan taxanaha enthalpy of dissolution ee halide-yada haliday isla kooxda.
objectives: Cabbirka qaboojinta ka dhalata dhalaalinta potassium bromide
Qeexidda tartanka qaboojinta ee halide-yada haliday isla kooxda
Dareenka sida radheynta ion-ku u saarto energy-da shabakadda crystalline-ka

potassium-iodide-dissolution-endotherm.title: Potassium iodide (KI) ka dhalata qaboojinta marka la dhalaaliyo
potassium-iodide-dissolution-endotherm.description: Marka potassium iodide (KI) biyo lagu darayo, heerkulku hoos ayuu u dhacaa. In kastoo anion-ku leeyahay radheynta ugu weyn oo energy-da shabakadda crystalline-kiisu ugu hooseyso, haddana weli qaboojintu way jirtaa, taasoo tilmaamaysa in energy-da hidration-ku sidoo kale hoos u dhaco si isku mid ah.
objectives: Cabbirka qaboojinta ka dhalata dhalaalinta potassium iodide (KI)
Falanqaynta isbedelka isku mid ah ee energy-da shabakadda crystalline-ka iyo ta hidration-ka
Dhammaystirka uruurinta xogta taxanaha halide-yada potassium

magnesium-chloride-dissolution-exotherm.title: Magnesium chloride ka dhalata kuleylka marka la dhalaaliyo
magnesium-chloride-dissolution-exotherm.description: Marka magnesium chloride aan biyo lahayn biyo lagu darayo, kuleylku si cad ayuu u muuqdaa. Density-da shargiga ion-ka magnesium waa sare, energy-da hidration-kiisuna way weyn tahay, taasoo ah sabab loo baahan yahay in la xukumo heerkulka marka brine-ka warshadaha lagu isticmaalo samaynta milixda.
objectives: Cabbirka kuleylka ka dhalata dhalaalinta cusbada laba-qiimiga ah
Fahamka xiriirka u dhexeeya density-da shargiga iyo energy-da hidration-ka
Xiriirinta baahida xukumida heerkulka warshadaha brine-ka

calcium-chloride-dissolution-exotherm.title: Karboonka Kalsiyamka iyo Kiisku Kulaylka
calcium-chloride-dissolution-exotherm.description: Calcium chloride (CaCl₂) engegan markuu biyaha ku dhex milmo, heerkulku si dhakhso ah ayuu u kororaa; waxaa loo isticmaalaa maadada kulul-saarista ee baakidhyada kulul ee caafimaadka, oo isla markaana lala barbardhigi karo Amooniyam nayitrееt ee baakidhyada qaboobaya.
objectives: Cabbirka xaddiga kororka heerkulka ee dhex-milmitaanka calcium chloride (CaCl₂)
Fahmidda mabaadi'da kiimikada ee baakidhyada kulul ee caafimaadka
Xirfadda hawlgalka kalorimitar ee xafidda kulaylka

magnesium-sulfate-dissolution-exotherm.title: Dhex-milmitaanka Kulul ee Maagnisiyam sulfeet
magnesium-sulfate-dissolution-exotherm.description: Maagnisiyam sulfeet engegan markuu biyaha ku dhex milmo kulaylka ayuu sii daayaa, haddaase aad isticmaasho nooca toddoba-biyo-xidhka (Epsom salt) qaboobidda ayuu keenaa; tani waa tusaale cad oo muujinaya sida biyaha xidhxidhka ah ay u beddelaan calaamadda saameynta kuleylka.
objectives: Cabbirka kulaylka sii-daynta ee Maagnisiyam sulfeet engegan
Barbardhigga qabowga dhex-milmitaanka nooca biyo-xidhka
Fahmidda sida biyaha xidhxidhka ah ay u beddeli karaan calaamadda saameynta kuleylka

sodium-carbonate-dissolution-exotherm.title: Dhex-milmitaanka Kulul ee sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃)
sodium-carbonate-dissolution-exotherm.description: Soodaa nadiifta ah markay biyaha ku dhex milmaan kulaylka ayay sii daayaan, waxaana xalka uga dhasha asaasnimo sababtoo ah kaarbonaydka; qayb ka mid ah waxyaabaha la dabaqashado waa kulaylka iyo asaasnimaanta hal mar.
objectives: Cabbirka kulaylka sii-daynta ee dhex-milmitaanka soodaa nadiifta ah
Xog-uruurinta asaasnimaanta xalka isku mar
Kala-soocidda gaarka ah ee culayska kuleylka dhex-milmitaanka iyo kuleylka kaarbonaydka

ammonium-chloride-dissolution-endotherm.title: Dhex-milmitaanka Qabowga ee ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl)
ammonium-chloride-dissolution-endotherm.description: Ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) markuu biyaha ku dhex milmo heerkulku wuu hoos u dhacaa; cunugyada amooniyamka waxay si weyn u qaboojiyaan oo kharash yar bay leeyihiin, waxayna inta badan loo isticmaalaa beddelka fudud ee qaboojiyaha degdegga ah.
objectives: Cabbirka qaboobidda dhex-milmitaanka ee ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl)
Barbardhigga hufnaanta hoos-u-dhaca heerkulka ee dhex amooniyamyada kala duwan
Naqshadeynta qaacidada fudud ee qaboojiyaha degdegga ah

barium-hydroxide-dissolution-endotherm.title: Dhex-milmitaanka Qabowga ee barium hydroxide
barium-hydroxide-dissolution-endotherm.description: Barium hydroxide markuu biyaha ku dhex milmo heerkulku wuu hoos u dhacaa; waa mid ka mid ah asaasyada adag ee yar-yar ee dhex-milmitaanku qabooba, taasi oo si cad uga duwan dabeecadda asaasyada kale ee adag ee kulaylka sii daaya sida sodium hydroxide (NaOH).
objectives: Cabbirka tusaalaha aan caadiga ahayn ee dhex-milmitaanka qabowga ee asaasyada adag
Barbardhigga dabeecadda kulul-sii-daynta ee sodium hydroxide (NaOH)
Xirfadda tallaabooyinka xasilinta marka la shaqeynayo asaasyada adag

thiosulfate-dissolution-endotherm.title: Dhex-milmitaanka Qabowga ee sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃)
thiosulfate-dissolution-endotherm.description: Sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) markuu biyaha ku dhex milmo heerkulku wuu hoos u dhacaa, hase yeeshee xalalkiisa dheecaan-ka-badan markuu crystalleysto kulaylka ayuu sii daayaa; tani waa moodel caano-guur ah oo xifaalada tamarta-badbaadineed ee isbeddelka xaaladda.
objectives: Cabbirka qaboobidda dhex-milmitaanka ee sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃)
Fahmidda ku-wareejinta tamarta ee xifaalada isbeddelka xaaladda
Xirfadda diyaarinta xalka dheecaan-ka-badan

sodium-bicarbonate-dissolution-endotherm.title: Dhex-milmitaanka Qabowga ee sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃)
sodium-bicarbonate-dissolution-endotherm.description: Sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) waxaa leh milmis hoosaad; markuu biyaha ku dhex milmo heerkulku wuu hoos u dhacaa waxaana indhaha la arki karaa qayb aan milmin oo hadhay, sidaas awgeedna labada muujin — qaboobidda iyo xaddiga milmitaanka — hal mar ayaa la daawanayaa.
objectives: Cabbirka qaboobidda dhex-milmitaanka ee sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃)
Daawashada xaddiga milmitaanka iyo qaybtii hadhay ee aan milmin
Kala-soocidda milmis-xaddiga iyo xawlaha milmitaanka

zinc-copper-sulfate-calorimetry.title: Cabbirka Kuleylka Falcelinta Beddelka: Zinc iyo copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄)
zinc-copper-sulfate-calorimetry.description: Markii dufanka zinc (Zn) la galiyo xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), midabka buluugga ah ayaa baaba'a, naxaas (Cu) cas ah ayaa soo baxaa, heerkulkuna si muuqata ayuu u kororaa; isbeddelka heerkulka ayaa loo isticmaali karaa qiyaasidda enthalpy-change-ka falcelinta beddelka.
objectives: Qiyaasidda enthalpy-change-ka falcelinta beddelka iyadoo la adeegsanayo isbeddelka heerkulka
Daawashada isbeddelka midabka iyo sii-daynta kulaylka hal mar
Xirfadda adeegsiga kalorimitar fudud

magnesium-hydrochloric-calorimetry.title: Qiyaasta kulaylka falcelinta xarig maqniisiyam ah iyo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl)
magnesium-hydrochloric-calorimetry.description: Marka xarig maqniisiyam ah la dhigo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl), gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) ayaa si xoog leh u soo baxa hana kulaylku si dhakhso ah u koro; biyihii kulaylka ilaalisa ayaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu ururiyo xogta koritaanka kulaylka si loo xisaabiyo kulaylka falcelinta ee unugga walxaha.
objectives: Qiyaasta kulaylka soo baxa ee falcelinta bir-macdanta iyo aashitada
U baddalida kulaylka falcelinta unugga walxaha
Falanqaynta khaladaadka nidaamka ee uu keeno lunaanta kulaylka

sodium-peroxide-water-exotherm.title: Kulaylka iyo oksiijinta soo baxa ee sodium peroxide iyo biyo
sodium-peroxide-water-exotherm.description: Marka sodium peroxide la dhigo biyaha, xumbo ayaa soo baxa kulaylkuna si weyn ayuu u koreeyaa; kulaylka soo baxa ayaa ku filan in uu shito xabo qori ah oo dhammaatay, taasoo muujinaysa in walxadu tahay labadaba wax soo saara oksijiin iyo wax soo saara kulayl.
objectives: Isla mar ahaantaana u daawasho labada muujin: soo baxa oksiijinta iyo soo baxa kulaylka
Xaqiijinta in kulaylka soo baxa uu shito xabo qori ah oo dhammaatay
Bartida xeerarka ammaanka ee qaadashada walxaha peroxide ah

thermite-iron-oxide-enthalpy.title: Kulaylka iyo qiyaasta isbedelka enthalpiga ee falcelinta thermite
thermite-iron-oxide-enthalpy.description: Marka Aluminiyam budo ah iyo iron(III) oxide la isku dhalaalo oo la shito, dhinac walba sharar ayaa ka kacaa, bir dhalaalaysa ayaa soo baxa, kulaylkuna si xoog leh ayuu u soo baxaa; heerkulka walxaha la soo saaro ayaa loo isticmaali karaa in si qiyaas ah loogu xisaabiyo isbedelka enthalpiga.
objectives: U go'aaminta xooggaga kulaylka soo baxa adoo ka fiirsanaya muujinta dhalaalka
Qiyaasta heerka enthalpiga adoo ku tiirsanaya xaaladda walxaha la soo saaray
Bartida tallaabooyinka ammaanka ee falcelimaha heerkulka sare

nickel-hydroxide-green-identification.title: Aqoonsiga ion niikelka adoo ku tiirsanaya radka cagaaran ee weecidda
nickel-hydroxide-green-identification.description: Marka sodium hydroxide (NaOH) la soo dhejiyo xalka Niikel sulfeet, waxaa soo baxa weecid cagaar-tufaax ah oo ah niikelka hiidrooksaydka (nickel(II) hydroxide); astaamaha midabka ayaa si cad u muuqda, taasoo u sahleysa aqoonsiga tooska ah ee ion niikelka.
objectives: Bartida aqoonsiga weecidda astaamaha midabka ee ion niikelka
Barasho kala soocida bir-macdan-kala-guurka ee isla qoyskan adoo ku tiirsanaya midabka
Hab-raacinta howlaha soo dhejiyo iyo daawasho

cobalt-hydroxide-pink-identification.title: Aqoonsiga ion cobaltka adoo ku tiirsanaya weecidda guduudka ah
cobalt-hydroxide-pink-identification.description: Marka cobalt(II) chloride xal ah la ku daro saldhig, waxaa soo baxa weecid cas-guduud ah oo cobalt hydroxide ah; haddii muddada la dhigo, oksidaadku waxay u badashaa midabka bunni, taasoo la isbarbar dhigi karta weecidda cagaar-tufaax ah ee niikelka.
objectives: Bartida aqoonsiga weecidda astaamaha midabka ee ion cobaltka
Daawasho koritaanka midabka ee weecidda marka ay hewa ku oksidaato
Isbarbar dhigida iyo kala soocida laba ionood: cobaltka iyo niikelka

manganese-hydroxide-brown-identification.title: Aqoonsiga ion manganiiska adoo ku tiirsanaya weecidda caddaan-u-badelata bunniga
manganese-hydroxide-brown-identification.description: Marka manganese(II) sulfate (MnSO₄) la ku daro saldhig, waxaa marka hore soo baxa weecid cad oo manganese hydroxide ah, ka bacdi marka hewa la taabsato si degdeg ah ayay u noqotaa bunni-madow; bodbodaanta midabka ayaa ah calaamadda lagu garto ion manganiiska.
objectives: Bartida aqoonsiga weecidda isbedelka midabka ee ion manganiiska
Duubida xilliyada wareegga caddaanta-ilaa-bunniga
Fahamka dabeecadda fudud ee oksidaadka ee manganese heerka hoose

silver-chromate-mohr-endpoint.title: Tilmaamaha dhammaadka ee chromate silfar ee hab Mohr
silver-chromate-mohr-endpoint.description: Marka potassium chromate loo isticmaalo tilmaame ah in lagu tiiriyo chloride, ka dib marka ion chloride dhammaato, ionka Lacag (silfar) iyo chromate ayaa waxay soo saaraan weecid cas-toob ah oo ah silver chromate, taasoo calaamad u ah in tiirinta dhamaatay.
objectives: Fahamka mabaadi'da tilmaamaha dhammaadka ee tiirinta weecidda
Daawasho muuqaalka dhammaadka cas-toob ah
Bartida shuruudaha hawlgalka ee hab Mohr

lead-chromate-yellow-identification.title: Aqoonsiga ion rasaasta (lead) adoo ku tiirsanaya weecidda huruud-dhalaalaysa
lead-chromate-yellow-identification.description: Marka potassium chromate la soo dhejiyo xalka lead(II) nitrate, waxaa soo baxa weecid huruud-dhalaalaysa ah oo lead chromate ah — taasoo ah tiinta hore ee loo yaqaanno «chrome yellow» — islamarkaana ah calaamadda caadiga ah ee lagu garto ion rasaasta (lead).
objectives: Bartida aqoonsiga ion rasaasta (lead) adoo isticmaalaya midabka chromate
Garan dabeecadda kiimikada ee tiinta chrome yellow
Barasho shuruudaha farsamaynta qashinka bir-macdan-culus

barium-chromate-pale-yellow.title: Cabbirka midabka jaale-cagaarka ah ee kloroomeetka baariyamka
barium-chromate-pale-yellow.description: Marka la soo daro potassium chromate xalliyaanka barium chloride (BaCl₂), ayaa si deg deg ah u samaysma qansax jaale-cagaar ah oo ah kloroomeetka baariyamka. Midabkan ayaa si toos ah looga sooci karaa qansaxa cad ee nadiifka ah ee sulfate baariyamka.
objectives: Bartida kala-soocida ayanaha baariyamka adoo isticmaalaya kloroomeetyada
Is-barbardhigga midabka labada nooc ee qansaxyada baariyamka
Fahmida qiimaha midabka qansaxku leeyahay cilmi-baarista tayada ah

strontium-sulfate-white-identification.title: Kala-soocida qansaxa sulfate ah ee ayaanka strontiyamka
strontium-sulfate-white-identification.description: Marka sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄) la ku daro xalliyaanka strontium chloride (kloriidhka strontiyamka), ayaa samaysma qansax cad oo ah sulfate strontiyamka. Karboonka ka dhaleeceyntiisa waxay u dhexeysaa tan kaalsiymka iyo tan baariyamka, taasoo u oggolaanaysa in la sameeyo qansax-dejin tillaabo-tillaabo ah.
objectives: Bartida kala-soocida ayaanka strontiyamka adoo isticmaalaya sulfaatada
Tartiibinta xallinta sulfaatada macdanta dhulka ee alkaline ah
Fahmida ficirka soocida qansax-dejinta tillaabo-tillaabo ah

strontium-carbonate-acid-soluble.title: Samaynta qansaxa karbooneetka strontiyamka iyo xallintiisa aashitada ah
strontium-carbonate-acid-soluble.description: Marka sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) la ku daro strontiyamka naytareetka (strontium nitrate), ayaa samaysma qansax cad oo karbooneet ah. Marka dib aashito la siiyo, qansaxu wuu dhalaalaa oo xumbo ayuu soo saara, taasoo laba tillaabood oo muuqata ku xaqiijinaysa in ay tahay karbooneet.
objectives: Samaynta iyo xaqiijinta qansaxa karbooneetka strontiyamka
Adeegsiga xallinta aashitada si loo hubiyo walxaha qansaxka
Bartida caqliga falanqaynta laba-tillaaboodka ah

zinc-hydroxide-white-identification.title: Qansaxa cad ee ayaanka sink-ga iyo xaqiijinta dabeecaddiisa laba-dhinacka ah
zinc-hydroxide-white-identification.description: Marka sodium hydroxide (NaOH) xaddi ku filan ah la ku daro zinc sulfate (sinkyga sulfeetka), ayaa samaysma qansax cad oo ah sinkyga hiidrooksaydka (zinc hydroxide). Haddii NaOH dheeraad ah la sii daro, qansaxu mar kale wuu dhalaalaa, taasoo muujinaysa dabeecadda laba-dhinacka ah — oo ah calaamadda aqoonsiga ayaanka sink-ga.
objectives: Bartida kala-soocida ayaanka sink-ga adoo isticmaalaya qansax-dejinta
Xaqiijinta xallinta laba-dhinacka ah ee sinkyga hiidrooksaydka (zinc hydroxide)
Fahanka muhiimadda xukumida xaddiga reagents-ka

silver-phosphate-yellow-identification.title: Kala-soocida ayanaha fosfeetka adoo isticmaalaya lacagta dahabi-dhalaalaysa ee silver-ka
silver-phosphate-yellow-identification.description: Marka silver nitrate (AgNO₃) la ku daro xalliyaanka sodium phosphate (soodiyamka fosfeetka), ayaa samaysma qansax jaalle ah oo ah fosfeet Lacag (silfar). Qansaxan wuxuu ku dhalaalaa aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) oo la wasakheeyay, taasoo u oggolaanaysa in looga sooco lacagta kloriidhka (silver chloride) ee cad.
objectives: Bartida kala-soocida tayada ah ee ayanaha fosfeetka
Adeegsiga xallinta aashitada si loo kala saaro qansaxyada silver-ka
Hagida xallinta qashinka silver-ka si ammaan ah

lead-sulfide-black-identification.title: Kala-soocida ayaanka sulfaydka adoo isticmaalaya gacmo-ridda madow ee rasaasta
lead-sulfide-black-identification.description: Marka lead(II) nitrate (rasaasta naytareetka) la ku daro xalliyaanka sodium sulfide (sodium sulfide, Na₂S), ayaa si dhakhso leh u samaysma qansax madow oo ah sulfide rasaasta. Midabku aad buu u qoto dheer yahay, xatta xaddiga yar oo ayaan sulfayd ah ayaa si cad u muuqda.
objectives: Bartida kala-soocida xasaasiyad sare leh ee ayaanka sulfaydka
Garan ficirka shaqada warqadaha baaritaanka sulfide rasaasta
Baridda maaraynta ammaan ahaaneed ee xalliyaadka sulfayd-ka ah

lead-iodide-yellow-identification.title: Kala-soocida ayaanka rasaasta adoo isticmaalaya qansaxa iodide ah ee jaalle-dhalaalaya
lead-iodide-yellow-identification.description: Marka potassium iodide (KI) la ku daro muunada la baaranayo oo ku jirta xalliyaan aashito nitric ah (HNO₃) oo la wasakheeyay, ayaa samaysma qansax jaalle oo dhalaalaya oo ah iodide rasaasta — taasoo xaqiijinaysa joogitaanka ayaanka rasaasta. Natiijadan waxaa lagu xaqiijin karaa hab potassium chromate-ka oo la barbardhigo.
objectives: Bartida kala-soocida ayaanka rasaasta adoo isticmaalaya iodide-ka
Is-xaqiijinta natiijooyinka hab kloroomeet-ka iyo kan iodide-ka
Fahmida saamaynta aashitooyinta xalliyaanka kala-soocida

lithium-chloride-flame-crimson.title: Kala-soocida dab-midabka qoriga ah ee saldhiga lithiyamka
lithium-chloride-flame-crimson.description: Lithium chloride (kloriidhka lithiyamka) marka biyaha lagu daro wuxuu si yar u kululeeyaa. Marka xalliyaankiisa la gubto oo xarig balaatiin ah la isticmaalo, dabku wuxuu muujiyaa midab qorrax-cas ah oo khaas ah, taasoo si fudud looga sooci karo midabka huruuda ee soodiyamka iyo guduudka-banaananka ee potassium-ka marka la sameeyo barbar-dhig hal qaybeed ah.
objectives: Bartida astaamaha midabka dab-gubashada ee lithiyamka
Dhammaystirka barbar-dhigga dab-midabka macdanta alkaline ah
Hagida nadiifinta iyo gubashada xarig balaatiin ah si habboon

dichromate-ferrous-titration.title: Dhammaadka Midabka ee Titration-ka Potassium Dichromate iyo Iron(II) Sulfate (FeSO₄)
dichromate-ferrous-titration.description: Marka potassium dichromate lagu daadsho xalka iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄), chromium-ka lixaad (VI) ee midabka oranjigu wuxuu u yaraadaa chromium-ka saddexaad (III) ee midabka cagaarka ah waxaana kulaylku kordhaa; isbeddelka midabku wuxuu calaamadeeyaa dhammaadka titration-ka.
objectives: Ku bartaan habka potassium dichromate ee cabbirka iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄)
Ogaanshaha dhammaadka markii midabku ka beddelo oranjigu cagaar
Barbardhigga faa'iidooyinka iyo curyaannimada habkan marka loo eego habka potassium permanganate (KMnO₄)

permanganate-ferrous-titration.title: Tilmaamaha Naftiisa ee Titration-ka Potassium Permanganate (KMnO₄) iyo Iron(II) Sulfate (FeSO₄)
permanganate-ferrous-titration.description: Xaaladda aashitada ah, marka potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) lagu daadsho xalka iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄), midabka guduuda-beereedda ah wuxuu si degdeg ah u baaba'aa; dhibcaha ugu dambeysa ee aan baaba'in ayaa calaamadeysa dhammaadka, isagoo aan u baahnayn tilmaame dibadeed.
objectives: Fahanka mabda'a tilmaamaynta naftiisa ee habka potassium permanganate (KMnO₄)
Si sax ah u ogaanshaha dhammaadka marka midabka guduuda-beereedda aanu baaba'in
Falanqaynta saamaynta xoogsanaanta aashitada titration-ka

oxalate-permanganate-standardization.title: Cabbirka Xoogga Xalka Potassium Permanganate (KMnO₄) Adoo Isticmaalaya Oxalic Acid
oxalate-permanganate-standardization.description: Xalka oxalic acid ee aashitada ah oo kulul ayaa loo isticmaalaa standardization-ka potassium permanganate (KMnO₄); marka midabka guduuda-beereeddu baaba'do kulaylkuna kordhaa, xoogga saxda ah ee potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) waxaa laga xisaabiyaa cabbirka la isticmaalay.
objectives: Isticmaalka walxaha tixraaca ee cabbirka oxidizer-ka xooggiisa
Maaraynta heerkulka titration-ka kulul
Xisaabinta natiijooyinka standardization-ka iyo kala-duwanaanshaha xisaabeedka

iodine-thiosulfate-standardize.title: Standardization-ka Xalka Iodine (I₂) adoo Isticmaalaya Sodium Thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃)
iodine-thiosulfate-standardize.description: Marka sodium thiosulfate (Na₂S₂O₃) lagu daadsho xalka buniga-huruudda ah ee iodine (I₂), midabku si tartiib ah ayuu u dhacaa ilaa uu noqdo midab la'aan; dhammaadku waa cad yahay, waxaana ah howsha aasaasiga ah ee standardization-ka iodometric.
objectives: Bartaan habka standardization-ka iodometric
Garashada dhammaadka marka midabku ka beddelo buniga-huruudda midab la'aanta
Fahamka waqtiga saxda ah ee ku darista xabag (xoogaa) ahaan tilmaame

ammonium-alkali-gas-endotherm.title: Gaarista Gaaska Ammonia (Ammonia Gas) iyo Hoos u Dhaca Heerkulka
ammonium-alkali-gas-endotherm.description: Marka ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) la isku daray sodium hydroxide (NaOH), waxaa soo baxa gaaska ammonia (ammonia gas) ee cufan waxaana heerkulku hoos u dhacaa; marka litmus cas oo qoyan uu u beddelo buluug, labada calaamadood waa xaqiijinaan ammonia.
objectives: Xaqiijinta ammonium root adoo isticmaalaya labada calaamadood: gaasku ka soo baxa iyo litmus-ku buluug noqonaysa
Duubasho hoos u dhaca heerkulka falcelinta endothermic-ka
Bartaan qaabka saxda ah ee ur-urinta gaas khataraha leh

sulfite-acid-gas-identification.title: Aqoonsiga Sulfite adoo Isticmaalaya Baxa Gaaska iyo Baaba'inta Midabka
sulfite-acid-gas-identification.description: Marka aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) lagu darsado sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃), waxaa soo baxa sulfur dioxide oo cufan kulaylkuna kordhaa; marka gaaska lagu gudbiiyo xalka fuchsin, midabkiisu wuu baaba'aa, taasoo xaqiijinaysa joogitaanka sulfite.
objectives: Bartaan aqoonsiga sulfite adoo isticmaalaya baxa gaaska
Xaqiijinta sulfur dioxide adoo isticmaalaya baaba'inta midabka fuchsin
Hirgalinta tallaabooyinka ximaayadda gaasyada waxqabadka leh

iron3-thiocyanate-colorimetry.title: Cabbirka Bir-ka Colorimetry Adoo Isticmaalaya Potassium Thiocyanate (KSCN)
iron3-thiocyanate-colorimetry.description: Iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) iyo potassium thiocyanate (KSCN) waxay sameeyaan murwaad casaan-dhiig ah; qotodheerida midabku waxay kordheysaa xoogga bir-ka, marka la barbardhigo heerarka midabka caadiga ah, bir-ku si qadar-ahaan ayaa loogu qiyaasi karaa.
objectives: Diyaarinta heerarka midabka caadiga ah
Qiyaasida qadaraynta bir-ka adoo isticmaalaya moodada visual colorimetry
Falanqaynta ilaha khaladaadka habka colorimetry

tin-silver-nitrate-galvanic.title: Xaqiijinta Kala-duwanaanshaha Korontada ee Tin iyo Lacag (Silfar) Adoo Isticmaalaya Beddelka
tin-silver-nitrate-galvanic.description: Marka Tin xaashi ah la dhigo xalka silver nitrate (AgNO₃), Lacag (silfar) ah oo xidid-xididka ah ayaa ka soo baxa dusha kulaylkuna kordhaa; tani waxay muujineysaa in korontada caadiga ah ee Tin xaashi ah ay ka hooseyso ta Lacag (silfar), sidaas awgeed Tin-ku wuxuu si iskiis ah u lumiyaa elektarooniyada.
objectives: Go'aaminta sarraynta korontada caadiga ah ee habka beddelka
Daawashada soo baxa fidooddiyada Lacag (silfar) iyo kulaylka
Bartaan hindisaha diyaarinta biraha electrodes inta kahor tijaabada

nickel-copper-sulfate-galvanic.title: Xaqiijinta Kala-duwanaanshaha Korontada ee Nickel-Naxaas
nickel-copper-sulfate-galvanic.description: Marka xaashi nickel ah la dhigo xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), wejigeeda ayaa lagu dabooli karaa lakab cas oo naxaas ah, kulaylna waa soo baxa; midabka buluugga ah ee xalka ayaa fifiqa, taasoo si cad u muujinaysa in nickel uu ka hormaro naxaas (Cu) silsilada korontada.
objectives: Go'aaminta kala-duwanaanshaha korontada ee u dhexeeya nickel iyo naxaas (Cu)
Daawashada sida lakabka beddelka ah ee naxaas loogu sameeyo wejigeeda
Fahamka xiriirka u dhexeeya falcelinta iskood u dhacda iyo xoogga korontada (EMF) ee unugga

tin-copper-sulfate-galvanic.title: Xaqiijinta Kala-duwanaanshaha Korontada ee Tin-Naxaas
tin-copper-sulfate-galvanic.description: Marka Tin xaashi ah la dhigo xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), si tartiib ah ayaa naxaas cas ka soo baxaa kulaylna yar ayaa la dareemaa; falcelinta waxay ka gaaban tahay ta zinc, taasoo tilmaamaysa in kala-duwanaanshaha korontada yaryahay haddii la barbar dhigo, xoogga wadiduna uu gaabsado.
objectives: Barbar-dhigga xawaaraha falcelinta xaaladaha kala-duwanaan ee korontada ah
Fahamka saamaynta xoogga korontada (EMF) ee ku tiirsanaanta xoogga wadida
Diiwaangelinta xogta waqtiga ee hannaanka beddel-falcelinta

cadmium-copper-sulfate-galvanic.title: Xaqiijinta Kala-duwanaanshaha Korontada ee Kaadmiyam-Naxaas
cadmium-copper-sulfate-galvanic.description: Marka Kaadmiyam xaashi ah la dhigo xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), naxaas cas ayaa beddelka loo soo saara kulaylna waa soo baxa; kaadmiyam waa walaxda taban ee baytariyada nickel-kaadmiyam, tijaabadani waxay caddaynaysaa sida uu hawl-yar u lumiyo elektroonada.
objectives: Xaqiijinta heerka firfircoonida ee kaadmiyam silsilada korontada
Xiriirinta doorka walaxda taban ee baytariyada nickel-kaadmiyam
Fulinta nidaamyada ilaalinta iyo dib-u-soo-celinta macdanta culus

nickel-silver-nitrate-galvanic.title: Xaqiijinta Kala-duwanaanshaha Korontada ee Nickel-Lacag (Silfar)
nickel-silver-nitrate-galvanic.description: Marka xaashi nickel ah la dhigo xalka silver nitrate (AgNO₃), lakab lacag (silfar) ah oo cawl-cawl ah ayaa wejigeeda ka soo baxa kulaylna waa la dareemaa; marka la barbardhigo kooxda tin-lacag, waxaa suurtagal ah in la kala saaro xukumka korontada ee nickel, tin, iyo lacag (silfar) saddexdoodaba.
objectives: Kala-saarista xukumka korontada ee saddexda macdanta
Daawashada hannaanka sameynta lakabka lacag (silfar) ah
Xirfadlaysiinta dib-u-soo-celinta xalalka macdanta qaaliyan

lead-copper-sulfate-galvanic.title: Xaqiijinta Kala-duwanaanshaha Korontada ee Rasaas-Naxaas
lead-copper-sulfate-galvanic.description: Marka xaashi rasaas ah la dhigo xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), naxaas cas ayaa wejigeeda ka soo baxa kulaylna waa soo baxa; rasaasta (lead) waa walaxda taban ee baytariyada rasaas-aashito, tijaabadani waxay xoojinaysaa jiritaanka caadada luminta elektroonadeed.
objectives: Xaqiijinta in rasaasta (lead) ay ka hormarto naxaas (Cu) silsilada korontada
Xiriirinta doorka walaxda taban ee baytariyada rasaas-aashito
Nidaaminta habboon ee xalalka rasaasta ka kooban

lead-silver-nitrate-galvanic.title: Xaqiijinta Kala-duwanaanshaha Korontada ee Rasaas-Lacag (Silfar)
lead-silver-nitrate-galvanic.description: Marka xaashi rasaas ah la dhigo xalka silver nitrate (AgNO₃), geeddi-geeddi cad oo lacag (silfar) ah ayaa ka soo baxa kulaylna waa la dareemaa; qaabka geeddi-geeddi waa cad yahay, taasoo u adeegta muujinta la arki karo ee kiristaalka korontada ee soo kobcaya.
objectives: Daawashada qaabka iyo habka kobcista geeddi-geeddi bedelka ah
Fahamka bilowga kiristaalka korontada iyo sida uu u kordhaa
Xirfadlaysiinta qaadashada iyo isticmaalka xalalka milixda lacag (silfar)

magnesium-silver-nitrate-galvanic.title: Beddel-Falcelinta Xoogga Badan ee Magnesium-Lacag (Silfar)
magnesium-silver-nitrate-galvanic.description: Marka xarig maqniisiyam ah la dhigo xalka silver nitrate (AgNO₃), lacag (silfar) badan ayaa si deg-deg ah ka soo baxa harkana cad ayaa la dareemaa; kala-duwanaanshaha korontada ayaa ah kan ugu weyn, sidaas darteed falcelinta ayaa ugu xoogga badan, waxaana la barbar dhigi karaa kooxda rasaas-lacag.
objectives: Barbar-dhigga xoogga falcelinta xaaladaha kala-duwanaan ee korontada ah
Diiwaangelinta tirada koritaanka heerkulka si qiyaas ah
Dhisidda xiriir la taaban karo oo u dhexeeya EMF iyo xawaaraha falcelinta

magnesium-copper-sulfate-galvanic.title: Xaqiijinta Aasaasiga ah ee Falcelinta Unugga Korontada ee Magnesium-Naxaas
magnesium-copper-sulfate-galvanic.description: Marka xarig maqniisiyam ah la dhigo xalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄), naxaas cas ayaa si dhakhso ah loo soo saara harkana si muuqata ayaa soo baxa; midabka buluugga ah ee xalka ayaa si degdeg ah u fifiqa, taasoo aasaaska u ah falcelinta iskood u dhacda ee unugga korontada ee magnesium-naxaas.
objectives: Xaqiijinta falcelinta iskood u dhacda ee unugga korontada ee magnesium-naxaas
Daawashada hannaanka fifiqa ee midabka buluugga ah ee xalka
Fahamka qaybinta shaqada ee labada qudhqudh ee unugga korontada

aluminum-copper-sulfate-galvanic.title: Xaashi aluminium ah iyo CuSO₄: Galvanic cell, beddelka iyo daboolka passivation
aluminum-copper-sulfate-galvanic.description: Xaashi aluminium ah oo la dhigo xallaalka copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) waxay u baahan tahay in daboolka oxide ah la tirtiro ka hor inta aanay naxaas (Cu) cas soo bixin oo kulaylku saarin, taasoo tilmaamaysa in daboolka passivation uu joojin karo falcelinta electrode.
objectives: Fahamka sida daboolka passivation uu u joojin karo falcelinta electrode
Bartida hab-diyaarinta hordhaca ah ee lagu tirtiro daboolka
Daawashada sida beddelku u bilaabmo daboolka la tirtiray ka dib

ferric-chloride-copper-etching.title: Iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) oo lagu qoodo xaashi naxaas ah si loogu sameeyo goobaabka circuit
ferric-chloride-copper-etching.description: Xaashi naxaas ah oo la dhigo xallaalka iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) ayaa si tartiib ah u dhalaalaaya, xallaalka midabka bunni-jaallaha ahna wuxuu u rogmadaa midab cagaar-buluug ah waxaana kulaylku saara, taasoo ah mabda'a kiimikada ee lagu daabacaayo circuit-ka.
objectives: Fahamka wareejinta elektaroonigga ee sida FeCl₃ uu naxaas (Cu) u qooddo
Bartida xaaladaha xoogga iyo heerkulka xallaalka qoodista
Diyaarinta hababka saxda ah ee lagu soo celiyo qashinka xallaalka naxaasta ah

ferric-sulfate-copper-etching.title: Tijaabada barbardhigga: Birta(III) sulfeet oo lagu qooddo naxaas (Cu)
ferric-sulfate-copper-etching.description: Xallaalka Birta(III) sulfeet wuxuu sidoo kale ku dhalaalaayaa naxaas (Cu) oo kulaylku saara, taasoo muujinaysa in qoodista ay ku xidantahay awoodda oxidation ee ion-ka Fe³⁺ ee birta saddexaad ee valence ah ee saddexaad, ee aanay ku xidnayn nooca anion-ka.
objectives: Xaqiijinta saamaynta anion-ka ku yeeshaan qoodista
Barbardhigga xawaaraha labada nooc ee xallaalka qoodista
Soo koobista sida awoodda oxidation ay u go'aamiso in falcelinta dhici karto iyo in kale

iron-ferric-comproportionation-cell.title: Falcelinta comproportionation ee bir (Fe) iyo Fe³⁺
iron-ferric-comproportionation-cell.description: Musmaaro bir ah oo la dhigo xallaalka iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃), bir (Fe) waxaa laga soo saarnaa elektaroonigga oo Fe³⁺ waxaa lagu celiyo, isla curiyaha labada ion-kiisuba waxay u rogmadaan Fe²⁺ iyadoo kulaylku saaro, xallaalkana wuxuu ka beddelaa bunni-jaalle ilaa cagaar-fudud.
objectives: Fahamka jihada wareejinta elektaroonigga ee falcelinta comproportionation
Daawashada geedi socodka isbeddelka midabka bunni-jaallaha ah ilaa cagaar-fudud
Bartida sida loo xaqiijiyo natiijada adoo adeegsanaya baarista Fe²⁺

tin-hydrochloric-hydrogen-electrode.title: Dhaqdhaqaaqa electrode: Tin xaashi ah iyo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) oo soo saara gaaska hydrogen
tin-hydrochloric-hydrogen-electrode.description: Tin xaashi ah oo la dhigo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) ayaa si tartiib ah uga soo baxa hydrogen gas si yar oo kulaylna saara, xawaare aad uga hooseeya ta magnesium iyo aluminium, taasoo ka muujinaysa in potential-ka tin uu aad ugu dhow yahay kan hydrogen.
objectives: Cabbirka xawaaraha soo saarka hydrogen gas iyo kala-soocidda
Ka soo dib-u-celinta qiimaha potential-ka electrode adoo ka bilaabmaya xawaaraha
Bartida akhris-qaadista saxda ah ee hababka cabbirka gaaska

nickel-hydrochloric-hydrogen-electrode.title: Dhaqdhaqaaqa electrode: Xaashi nickel ah iyo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) oo soo saara gaaska hydrogen
nickel-hydrochloric-hydrogen-electrode.description: Xaashi nickel ah iyo aashito hydrochloric ah (HCl) ayaa si tartiib ah uga soo baxa gaaska hydrogen (hydrogen gas) iyadoo kulaylku yar yahay, isbarbardhigga nickel iyo tin wuxuu u oggolaanayaa in la faahfaahiyo tartiibbiga potential-ka dhowr birood oo ku dhow hydrogen.
objectives: Faahfaahinta tartiibbiga potential-ka biraha ku dhow hydrogen
Barbardhigga xawaaraha soo saarka hydrogen gas ee nickel iyo tin
Falanqaynta sida xaaladda dusha sare ay ugu xad-gudubto xawaaraha

zinc-nickel-chloride-displacement.title: Xaqiijinta tartiibbiga awoodda: Graniyuulada zinc oo beddelaya nickel(II) chloride
zinc-nickel-chloride-displacement.description: Graniyuulada zinc oo la dhigo xallaalka nickel(II) chloride ayaa bedelaysa nickel (Ni) cadeynta ah oo kulaylku saara, xallaalkana wuxuu dhalaalaa midabkiisu, taasoo xaqiijinaysa in zinc uu ka horreeyo nickel (Ni) tartiibbiga firfircoonaanta.
objectives: Xaqiijinta tartiibbiga firfircoonaanta zinc iyo nickel (Ni)
Daawashada soo baxa qulqulka nickel (Ni) ee midabka dambas ah
Bartida sida loo isticmaalo dhalaalka midabka si loo go'aamiyo hoos u dhaca xoogga

iron-nickel-chloride-displacement.title: Xaqiijinta farqiga potential-ka yar: Bir (Fe) oo beddelaya nickel(II) chloride
iron-nickel-chloride-displacement.description: Musmaaro bir ah oo la dhigo xallaalka nickel(II) chloride ayaa si gaabis ah uga bedelaysa nickel (Ni) iyadoo kulaylku aad u yar yahay, farqiga potential-ka labadooduna wuu yar yahay sidaas darteedna falcelinta waa gaabis, taasoo u baahan daawasho waqti dheer.
objectives: Daawashada beddelka gaabiska ah ee dhaca farqiga potential-ka yar
Diiwaan gelinta isbeddelada muuqaalka waqti dheer
Fahamka farqiga u dhexeeya macquulnimada thermodynamic iyo xawaaraha kinetic

magnesium-nickel-sulfate-displacement.title: Magnesium oo beddelaya Niikel Sulfeet si degdeg ah
magnesium-nickel-sulfate-displacement.description: Marka xarig maqniisiyam ah la dhigo xalka Niikel sulfeet, niikel midab madow-cagaaran ah ayaa si degdeg ah u soo baxa, hana kulaylka xaluulku si cad u koro. Tani waxay la barbardhigantaa kooxda bir-niikel si loo muujiyo saamaynta farqiga korontada ee ku timid xawaaraha falcelinta.
objectives: La barbardhig xawaaraha beddelka kooxaha leh farqiyada kala duwan ee korontada
Xisaabi kala duwanaanshaha kulaylka soo baxa
Aasaasi xiriir tayo ahaan ah oo u dhaxeeya xawaare iyo quwadda korontada (EMF)

zinc-cobalt-chloride-displacement.title: Zinc oo xaqiijinaya taxanaha korontada iyada oo la beddelo cobalt chloride
zinc-cobalt-chloride-displacement.description: Marka graniyuulada zinc la dhigo xalka cobalt(II) chloride, cobalt madow ayaa soo baxa oo kulaylku soo baxaa, midabkii guduudka-roseynta xaluulkuna si tartiib ah ayuu u dhumaa. Tijaabadan waxaa loo isticmaali karaa marka lala barbardhigo kooxda niikel si loo kala saaro taxanaha korontada.
objectives: Xaqiiji tartanka firfircoonaanta zinc iyo cobalt
Fiiri sida midabka guduudka-roseynta u lumayo iyo sida cobalt u soo baxa
Dhamays tir taxanaha korontada ee saddexda curiye ee kooxda bir (Fe)

cadmium-silver-nitrate-displacement.title: Kaadmiyam oo beddelaya silver nitrate si loo arko qaabka laanlaanta crystalka
cadmium-silver-nitrate-displacement.description: Marka Kaadmiyam xaashi ah la dhigo xalka silver nitrate (AgNO₃), laanlaanyo lacag (silfar) ah oo qurxoon ayaa ka soo baxa, kulaylkuna soo baxaa. Farqiga korontada ee kaadmiyam-silver waa weyn yahay, markaa xawaaraha beddelku waa ka dhakhso badan yahay kooxda rasaasta (lead)-silver.
objectives: Fiiri qaabka laanlaanta crystalka ee beddelka kaadmiyam-silver
Is bar bar dhig xawaaraha soo baxa ee kooxaha leh farqiyada kala duwan ee korontada
Dhaqan geli ficil-xumida difaaca kaadmiyam si hufan

aluminum-silver-nitrate-displacement.title: Aluminium oo beddelaya silver nitrate si loo arko dahaadh lacag ah
aluminum-silver-nitrate-displacement.description: Marka xaashi aluminium ah oo lakabkiisa oxide laga saaray la dhigo xalka silver nitrate (AgNO₃), wejigiisu si degdeg ah ayuu ugu daboolmaa dahaadh lacag (silfar) ah oo kulaylku soo baxaa. Tani waa muuqaal fudud oo ah silver-plating kiimikada ah oo aan baatari u baahnayn.
objectives: Gabi silver-plating kiimikadeed iyada oo la adeegsanayo falcelinta beddelka
Fahm saamaynta saarista lakabka oxide ee tayada dahaadha
Baro sida xalka silver nitrate (AgNO₃) loogu soo ceshado

nickel-copper-chloride-displacement.title: Nickel oo beddelaya copper(II) chloride si loo eego saamaynta anionka
nickel-copper-chloride-displacement.description: Marka xaashi nickel ah la dhigo xalka copper(II) chloride, naxaas (Cu) midab casaan ah ayaa soo baxa oo kulaylku soo baxaa. Natiijadu waxay la mid tahay kooxaha kale ee naxaas (Cu) saaliga ah, taasoo xaqiijinaysa in beddelku keliya uu ku xidhnaado farqiga korontada ee labo biraha.
objectives: Xaqiiji in anionku uusan saameyn karin dhacnaanshaha beddelka
Barbardhig xawaaraha falcelinta labada nooc ee milixda naxaas (Cu)
Soo koobi waxyaabaha go'aaminaya falcelinta beddelka
